c026-p_kai/b34482e2.text: I was on a fare to Bamburi.

c026-p_chiku/9540dbea.speaker: c026-p_chiku
c026-p_chiku/9540dbea.text: I saw what I saw. I didn't see a tall man.

c026-p_chiku/dcb0f00e.speaker: c026-p_chiku
c026-p_chiku/dcb0f00e.text: Rajab? He came after the police. Ten past ten. Now he is telling the police a story.

c027-p_catherine/0427fcc7.speaker: c027-p_catherine
c027-p_catherine/0427fcc7.text: Riziki? I can't believe it. Such a good girl.

c027-p_catherine/4c97ab22.speaker: c027-p_catherine
c027-p_catherine/4c97ab22.text: Pension statements? The staff can ask for those any time. Nothing to hide.

c027-p_catherine/e3c6e970.speaker: c027-p_catherine
c027-p_catherine/e3c6e970.text: That guest shouted at her in front of everybody yesterday morning. About a watch.

c027-p_catherine/17bf101a.speaker: c027-p_catherine
c027-p_catherine/17bf101a.text: I left the hotel at six and was home in Nyali all evening.

c027-p_catherine/732873c1.speaker: c027-p_catherine
c027-p_catherine/732873c1.text: Riziki was a good girl. Very emotional.

c027-p_catherine/b4021a56.speaker: c027-p_catherine
c027-p_catherine/b4021a56.text: I came back to finish payroll. It's the end of the month. I was in my office. I never went near the quarters.

c027-p_anthony/333cfb78.speaker: c027-p_anthony
c027-p_anthony/333cfb78.text: I accused her of stealing my watch. It was in my own safe. I owe that girl an apology.

c027-p_anthony/4a3feb81.speaker: c027-p_anthony
c027-p_anthony/4a3feb81.text: I was at the bar all night. I owe that girl an apology.

c027-p_kache/71fd558f.speaker: c027-p_kache
c027-p_kache/71fd558f.text: I can't talk. I have orders.

c027-p_kache/aaf85dd7.speaker: c027-p_kache
c027-p_kache/aaf85dd7.text: She lent me money for my mother's hospital bill. We argued about when I'd pay. She said don't worry. She always said don't worry.

c027-p_kache/775ca007.speaker: c027-p_kache
c027-p_kache/775ca007.text: I was in the kitchen until two.

c027-p_neema/7c57f20e.speaker: c027-p_neema
c027-p_neema/7c57f20e.text: She said she was going to fix it. For everybody.

c027-p_neema/2368ad4a.speaker: c027-p_neema
c027-p_neema/2368ad4a.text: Mama Catherine HR. Riziki said she was the one who signs everything.

c027-p_jumaa/7eacb319.speaker: c027-p_jumaa
c027-p_jumaa/7eacb319.text: Managers sign too. Everyone signs at my gate.

c027-p_jumaa/e2aee66d.speaker: c027-p_jumaa
c027-p_jumaa/e2aee66d.text: Madam HR came back at half past ten. At ten to eleven she walked to the quarters with her handbag. At night. She never does that.

c028-p_twaha/55c19faa.speaker: c028-p_twaha
c028-p_twaha/55c19faa.text: Babu was beside me. The whole time. I can see him from my keyboard.

c028-p_twaha/b3638662.speaker: c028-p_twaha
c028-p_twaha/b3638662.text: Auntie Amina booked every wedding we ever played. She was family.

c028-p_twaha/a5a4655c.speaker: c028-p_twaha
c028-p_twaha/a5a4655c.text: Babu was on stage beside me the whole second set. I can see him from my keyboard.

c028-p_twaha/a4e48074.speaker: c028-p_twaha
c028-p_twaha/a4e48074.text: Babu's hands get tired. For a year I have played his oud parts from a recording so he can rest. Nobody is supposed to know. Tonight he went out for a few minutes. That's all. That's all it was.

c028-p_mzee/c4f248cb.speaker: c028-p_mzee
c028-p_mzee/c4f248cb.text: A long silence. Then: "Fifty-two years." Nothing more.

c028-p_mzee/b0dacbe0.speaker: c028-p_mzee
c028-p_mzee/b0dacbe0.text: She paid me. She always paid me. She said thank you.

c028-p_mzee/eae89a18.speaker: c028-p_mzee
c028-p_mzee/eae89a18.text: Amina is my daughter's friend. I held her at her naming ceremony.

c028-p_moha/d06efa24.speaker: c028-p_moha
c028-p_moha/d06efa24.text: Don't look at me. I wasn't even inside.

c028-p_moha/152b1c01.speaker: c028-p_moha
c028-p_moha/152b1c01.text: The old men are finished, that's just business. Those two families have always fought anyway. Ask anyone.

c028-p_moha/e0503c64.speaker: c028-p_moha
c028-p_moha/e0503c64.text: I was setting up outside. I was live the whole time.

c028-p_mwanaisha/e3f95a7a.speaker: c028-p_mwanaisha
c028-p_mwanaisha/e3f95a7a.text: I sang. I sang the whole time.

c028-p_mwanaisha/1ba2482a.speaker: c028-p_mwanaisha
c028-p_mwanaisha/1ba2482a.text: Only the Mzee uses a feather risha. Everyone else uses plastic. He cuts his own.

c028-p_mwanaisha/b6284dff.speaker: c028-p_mwanaisha
c028-p_mwanaisha/b6284dff.text: I wanted to be manager. I wanted to save us. Not like this. Never like this.

c028-p_zainab/0c6f4681.speaker: c028-p_zainab
c028-p_zainab/0c6f4681.text: My mother booked this band. I booked this band.

c028-p_zainab/5ec897d8.speaker: c028-p_zainab
c028-p_zainab/5ec897d8.text: He played at my wedding. There is no feud between those families. There is only love.

c028-p_zainab/b06a902b.speaker: c028-p_zainab
c028-p_zainab/b06a902b.text: My niece filmed the whole second set. Take it. Look at it.

c029-p_bramwel/5d15d178.speaker: c029-p_bramwel
c029-p_bramwel/5d15d178.text: Nuru? No. No, I was with her group this afternoon.

c029-p_bramwel/234831fd.speaker: c029-p_bramwel
c029-p_bramwel/234831fd.text: Jealousy. She wanted my clients. The association listens to her because she's the secretary.

c029-p_bramwel/9247074e.speaker: c029-p_bramwel
c029-p_bramwel/9247074e.text: He empties his shoulder bag on a bench without being asked. "Souvenirs. Copies. Everybody knows.

c029-p_bramwel/cfc8b8b2.speaker: c029-p_bramwel
c029-p_bramwel/cfc8b8b2.text: I guided the Nakuru group from three until five. I never left them.

c029-p_bramwel/0094c9d0.speaker: c029-p_bramwel
c029-p_bramwel/0094c9d0.text: Those coins are souvenirs. I tell people they're copies.

c029-p_bramwel/e53884ae.speaker: c029-p_bramwel
c029-p_bramwel/e53884ae.text: I had to meet a buyer. Nuru took over. Then she texted me, and I went. Quarter to five. I offered her money to drop the complaint. She laughed. I left her standing there.

c029-p_athumani/71761de2.speaker: c029-p_athumani
c029-p_athumani/71761de2.text: I lost the contract fairly. She was better. I told her so at the meeting.

c029-p_athumani/b855e4d2.speaker: c029-p_athumani
c029-p_athumani/b855e4d2.text: I was at the port with a cruise group.

c029-p_pius/5d813464.speaker: c029-p_pius
c029-p_pius/5d813464.text: I sell to guides. What they tell the tourists is their business.

c029-p_pius/e896b7db.speaker: c029-p_pius
c029-p_pius/e896b7db.text: I sell them as replicas. Replicas. He pays me, I pay him, we're square. He owes me nothing.

c029-p_pius/5f7a6400.speaker: c029-p_pius
c029-p_pius/5f7a6400.text: I sell to guides. What they say to tourists is their business.

c029-p_leah/997e73a3.speaker: c029-p_leah
c029-p_leah/997e73a3.text: The guide lady? Oh no. Oh no.

c029-p_leah/b9604cdc.speaker: c029-p_leah
c029-p_leah/b9604cdc.text: He left us at the bastions, about five to four, and said a colleague would finish. Then she came. She was wonderful with the children.

c029-p_leah/8ecb106b.speaker: c029-p_leah
c029-p_leah/8ecb106b.text: Ask Mr Mbogo, our driver. We walked straight back to him.

c029-p_swabri/76d0b816.speaker: c029-p_swabri
c029-p_swabri/76d0b816.text: Every group, every guide, every change. I write it down.

c030-p_gichuru/d3ef2824.speaker: c030-p_gichuru
c030-p_gichuru/d3ef2824.text: A tragedy. Eight years with us. Those stairs are steep in the dark.

c030-p_gichuru/f97b2e4c.speaker: c030-p_gichuru
c030-p_gichuru/f97b2e4c.text: Our security people are very thorough. A fall. I approved it this morning.

c030-p_gichuru/dee5a500.speaker: c030-p_gichuru
c030-p_gichuru/dee5a500.text: A long silence. Then: "A man with a bad leg. They call him Fundi. He brings cash. He never uses a phone. I don't know any other name. I want a lawyer.

c030-p_gichuru/44c02db7.speaker: c030-p_gichuru
c030-p_gichuru/44c02db7.text: I was home in Nyali all night. I heard about Naomi this morning like everyone else.

c030-p_gichuru/c68ded75.speaker: c030-p_gichuru
c030-p_gichuru/c68ded75.text: That container is printing paper. I've seen the invoice.

c030-p_gichuru/7fc99376.speaker: c030-p_gichuru
c030-p_gichuru/7fc99376.text: I came to collect a file. From my office. Twenty minutes. I didn't see her. I didn't even know she was on shift.

c030-p_gichuru/693a4dad.speaker: c030-p_gichuru
c030-p_gichuru/693a4dad.text: I don't open cartons. I sign what I'm given. The invoice says paper. Paper is paper.

c030-p_odera/a886f291.speaker: c030-p_odera
c030-p_odera/a886f291.text: I didn't go near the office block.

c030-p_odera/cec76d9e.speaker: c030-p_odera
c030-p_odera/cec76d9e.text: She signed my overtime on Friday. All of it. She was fair. I shouted at her last week and she was still fair.

c030-p_odera/a4f74e28.speaker: c030-p_odera
c030-p_odera/a4f74e28.text: I was on the stacker all night.

c030-p_fatma/b154bc94.speaker: c030-p_fatma
c030-p_fatma/b154bc94.text: I wanted her job. I didn't want her dead. And it was her job I wanted, not his.

c030-p_fatma/e67e9552.speaker: c030-p_fatma
c030-p_fatma/e67e9552.text: I was on the ship until three.

c030-p_mazrui/ee81472e.speaker: c030-p_mazrui
c030-p_mazrui/ee81472e.text: My security said she fell. I believed them.

c030-p_mazrui/31ece91d.speaker: c030-p_mazrui
c030-p_mazrui/31ece91d.text: Yes. I didn't want police in my yard. For my own reasons. Not hers. Look at the notice; it is about storage fees.

c030-p_gladys/8f2d6a0c.speaker: c030-p_gladys
c030-p_gladys/8f2d6a0c.text: She sent me this. Look at it. Look at what she sent me.

c030-p_ramadhan/382dc842.speaker: c030-p_ramadhan
c030-p_ramadhan/382dc842.text: I write everybody. Every quarter of an hour. Everybody.

c030-p_ramadhan/c9e6039b.speaker: c030-p_ramadhan
c030-p_ramadhan/c9e6039b.text: Odera? He was on his stacker at the far end all night. I could hear it.

pool-f-elder-4/cd320384.speaker: pool-f-elder-4
pool-f-elder-4/cd320384.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

pool-f-elder-4/69c1f36a.speaker: pool-f-elder-4
pool-f-elder-4/69c1f36a.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

pool-f-elder-4/641728ab.speaker: pool-f-elder-4
pool-f-elder-4/641728ab.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

pool-asian-f-any-1/f69579ec.speaker: pool-asian-f-any-1
pool-asian-f-any-1/f69579ec.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

pool-asian-f-any-1/24d13132.speaker: pool-asian-f-any-1
pool-asian-f-any-1/24d13132.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

pool-asian-f-any-1/3dafcf53.speaker: pool-asian-f-any-1
pool-asian-f-any-1/3dafcf53.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

mwalimu/838df5f6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/838df5f6.text: New tools. Phone records need a court order: a stamp, and a reason tying that number to this case.

mwalimu/6c45189a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6c45189a.text: A mast tells you the neighbourhood, not the door. Use it to narrow. Never to pin.

mwalimu/79f83035.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/79f83035.text: From now on Halima wants to know why. Who and why are judged separately. Get one right and she'll tell you.

mwalimu/47df04d7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/47df04d7.text: A sign under the counter, a number on it. Ask a regular customer what she paid to.

mwalimu/7f5499fb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7f5499fb.text: He says Mwembe Tayari from half past twelve. A mast tells you the neighbourhood, not the door. Which neighbourhood was his phone in?

mwalimu/d86559e2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d86559e2.text: Something is missing from her drawer. What would a July statement show?

mwalimu/e1df1b65.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e1df1b65.text: A hundred and twelve payments to his number, and the statement that would expose them is gone.

mwalimu/fb5af69d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fb5af69d.text: A mast tells you the neighbourhood. You found the door anyway.

halima/9464c2bd.speaker: halima
halima/9464c2bd.text: The mast puts him on Biashara Street during prayers, and he admits the shop. He did it.

halima/b8645e09.speaker: halima
halima/b8645e09.text: Doesn't hold up. A nephew who shouted on Tuesday was in front of three hundred people on Friday. Who was on that street?

halima/48660d5d.speaker: halima
halima/48660d5d.text: No. Read his phone against his story. Where was it at one o'clock?

halima/5e79c935.speaker: halima
halima/5e79c935.text: Three hundred and forty thousand shillings, two glasses of tea. Clean.

halima/e52b5a67.speaker: halima
halima/e52b5a67.text: He did it. Now tell me why, or his lawyer will tell the court a story.

halima/23bef5dd.speaker: halima
halima/23bef5dd.text: That motive isn't his. Whose statement is missing from that drawer, and what was in it?

mwalimu/eac77291.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/eac77291.text: Two women sign M.M. One of them can't have been in Likoni at ten to seven.

mwalimu/ada472fe.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ada472fe.text: The 06:40 ferry puts you on the island by ten to seven. Where was her phone until twenty-six past?

mwalimu/3ac02446.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3ac02446.text: Read the dead woman's chats. Who was sending her money?

mwalimu/3e0740f2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3e0740f2.text: Five thousand last week, from a married man. Whose husband?

mwalimu/f6b5052d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f6b5052d.text: You crossed the water in your head before anyone crossed it on the ferry. Good.

halima/c8bd217e.speaker: halima
halima/c8bd217e.text: Her call brought Agnes in, her phone never left Likoni until 07:26, and she paid a boda from the door. That will hold.

halima/261f04c9.speaker: halima
halima/261f04c9.text: Doesn't hold up. Two women sign M.M. Which one was on the island at 06:35?

halima/413c3c26.speaker: halima
halima/413c3c26.text: No. A bitter ex-husband in Nyali can't be at Likoni by 07:18. Check the water between them.

halima/d4cb4237.speaker: halima
halima/d4cb4237.text: Five thousand a month to another woman. The court will understand the why. It won't excuse it.

halima/b9dee599.speaker: halima
halima/b9dee599.text: She did it. But that isn't why. Read the dead woman's phone again.

halima/2ba46c7d.speaker: halima
halima/2ba46c7d.text: That motive belongs to somebody else in this case.

mwalimu/b356cce3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b356cce3.text: Someone said they were coming at saa tisa na nusu. In Swahili time, hours start at six in the morning. Do the sum.

mwalimu/7f30c9fe.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7f30c9fe.text: Turmeric stains cotton and won't wash out. Whose white cloth is drying today?

mwalimu/a94c8a82.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a94c8a82.text: What needed two signatures, and who wouldn't give hers?

mwalimu/c725aedf.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c725aedf.text: Forty million on the table, and one word written across it.

mwalimu/680404ad.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/680404ad.text: Transfer documents. Mvua is selling the paperwork now, not just the plots.

halima/fca190b5.speaker: halima
halima/fca190b5.text: Saa tisa na nusu, a tuk-tuk to the door, and turmeric that doesn't wash out. That will hold.

halima/f9c0532b.speaker: halima
halima/f9c0532b.text: Doesn't hold up. The girl lied to hide a job interview. Who walked through that unattended door?

halima/60826e29.speaker: halima
halima/60826e29.text: No. A developer who threatens in public sues in private. Who was in the shop?

halima/e2f5b84d.speaker: halima
halima/e2f5b84d.text: Forty million and one word written across it. The why is in her handwriting.

halima/782ee609.speaker: halima
halima/782ee609.text: She did it, but not for that. Read the trust deed: what needed two signatures?

halima/c15dfaf6.speaker: halima
halima/c15dfaf6.text: That's someone else's grievance, or none at all.

mwalimu/c84c3053.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c84c3053.text: Before you read the phone, read the man. Ask his son how his father talked to people.

mwalimu/694e2299.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/694e2299.text: Lay the two phones side by side. Where did each one go at twenty to two?

mwalimu/664d2dc5.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/664d2dc5.text: What is pinned above his bunk?

mwalimu/85b36bf0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/85b36bf0.text: An offer refused, and a midnight visit about the mooring.

mwalimu/48c3d535.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/48c3d535.text: You read the man before you read the phone. Good.

halima/865a03ac.speaker: halima
halima/865a03ac.text: A man who couldn't read sent a text from Kisauni. So did the man who rowed out at midnight. That will hold.

halima/1682eb96.speaker: halima
halima/1682eb96.text: Doesn't hold up. You haven't even shown me this was a murder. Who sent that SMS?

halima/c436d3d2.speaker: halima
halima/c436d3d2.text: No. A sacked crewman on night watch didn't carry the captain's phone to Kisauni.

halima/31eb1bd7.speaker: halima
halima/31eb1bd7.text: HAPANA, written twice so they'd understand. They understood.

halima/172c9e5e.speaker: halima
halima/172c9e5e.text: He did it. But that's a rumour, not a reason. What did Khamis keep refusing?

halima/7967ad96.speaker: halima
halima/7967ad96.text: Paid in full, nothing on file. Try again.

mwalimu/a2c1ee53.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a2c1ee53.text: Halima, by text: "A reversal fails when the money's already out. Whoever withdrew it in three minutes knew exactly what they had."

mwalimu/7ab94f4f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7ab94f4f.text: Put the number on the scrap of paper next to the number on the confirmation.

mwalimu/b4fcfbeb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b4fcfbeb.text: The porter saw a pink pouch. Whose pouch has a broken clip?

mwalimu/ca25646f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ca25646f.text: Read the three messages from Monday afternoon in order.

mwalimu/61ff9256.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/61ff9256.text: The reversal failed because the money was gone in three minutes.

mwalimu/4f6a1bae.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4f6a1bae.text: Three minutes. Remember how fast people decide what kind of person they are.

halima/6428a934.speaker: halima
halima/6428a934.text: Out in three minutes, a call on Tuesday, the Kongowea mast, and a pouch with a broken clip. That will hold.

halima/0799d9ba.speaker: halima
halima/0799d9ba.text: Doesn't hold up. The lorry driver threatened her, but he was an hour up the Taveta road. Who was behind those sheds?

halima/e5de99df.speaker: halima
halima/e5de99df.text: No. Read the number on the scrap of paper against the number the money went to.

halima/45687437.speaker: halima
halima/45687437.text: A reversal fails when the money's already out. Whoever withdrew it in three minutes knew exactly what they had.

halima/7e5b81ae.speaker: halima
halima/7e5b81ae.text: She did it, but that isn't why. Read the reversal message.

halima/e2faf2e3.speaker: halima
halima/e2faf2e3.text: There's no police report, and her phone is in her apron. Try again.

mwalimu/efe6bc80.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/efe6bc80.text: Ask the coconut seller what she saw, and when the witness arrived.

mwalimu/46a854d3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/46a854d3.text: A fare paid at 21:28, and a woman in red climbing in at 21:30.

mwalimu/6661d376.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6661d376.text: What did the tuk-tuk need fixing in January? Then search the archive for her name.

mwalimu/75abf6fe.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/75abf6fe.text: A smashed front on 2 January. A hit-and-run on New Year's night. Her son.

halima/2b9eb333.speaker: halima
halima/2b9eb333.text: Two files, then. His and her son's. Get me the garage.

halima/548f3ce4.speaker: halima
halima/548f3ce4.text: Doesn't hold up. There is no tall man in a cap. Who paid the witness?

halima/28ba2fd1.speaker: halima
halima/28ba2fd1.text: No. A rival in Bamburi and an owner at a committee table. Who got into that tuk-tuk at half past nine?

halima/509cfd28.speaker: halima
halima/509cfd28.text: The second of January. A smashed fork and a new windscreen. She wasn't wrong about that.

halima/fdb47d57.speaker: halima
halima/fdb47d57.text: She did it. But the fare was paid in advance. Look further back. Much further back.

halima/23648cac.speaker: halima
halima/23648cac.text: That reason belongs to someone else, or to a man who doesn't exist.

mwalimu/ba84f55b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ba84f55b.text: Who called her at 22:41, and where did she say she was going?

mwalimu/7ec8323b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7ec8323b.text: She says home in Nyali from six. The staff gate keeps a book, and managers sign it too.

mwalimu/730b2cd3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/730b2cd3.text: Read the staff list carefully. Then ask for her records.

mwalimu/744c3ed8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/744c3ed8.text: A monthly salary for a man who doesn't exist, landing on her number.

mwalimu/4adc8155.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4adc8155.text: Pensions, ghost workers, beachfront plots. Count how often that till turns up near people with no power.

halima/1ee88d5e.speaker: halima
halima/1ee88d5e.text: A call at 22:41, the gate book, and the guard who saw her walk to the quarters. That will hold.

halima/e365c09d.speaker: halima
halima/e365c09d.text: Doesn't hold up. The loud guest was at the bar all night apologising. Who called her to the laundry?

halima/0b0e1c1e.speaker: halima
halima/0b0e1c1e.text: No. Read the gate book. Managers sign too.

halima/6e968806.speaker: halima
halima/6e968806.text: A ghost on the payroll for two years, and a welfare rep with the statements. Clean.

halima/99a3f742.speaker: halima
halima/99a3f742.text: She did it. But not over a watch or a loan. What was in that empty folder?

halima/7a41c0a4.speaker: halima
halima/7a41c0a4.text: Read the staff list. Who is Mwaka Kenga?

mwalimu/91a3732c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/91a3732c.text: Watch the second set. Listen to the oud, and look at who is playing it.

mwalimu/513ffdb1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/513ffdb1.text: A feather plectrum under the stand. Ask the singer who still cuts his own.

mwalimu/4fcf0d9a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4fcf0d9a.text: Read what she sent the DJ at ten to ten.

mwalimu/fcd9c002.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fcd9c002.text: After today, the old men are finished.

mwalimu/c301a345.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c301a345.text: Some cases you solve and wish you hadn't. Solve them anyway.

halima/813ab220.speaker: halima
halima/813ab220.text: Fifty years of music, and seven minutes. I'll ask the court to remember both.

halima/e09244cb.speaker: halima
halima/e09244cb.text: Doesn't hold up. The DJ was live on camera in the car park. Watch the wedding video again: whose chair is empty?

halima/05927088.speaker: halima
halima/05927088.text: No. Listen to the oud, then look at the chair.

halima/e3b93dc5.speaker: halima
halima/e3b93dc5.text: After today, the old men are finished. She wrote it herself.

halima/0c905d5b.speaker: halima
halima/0c905d5b.text: He did it. But she had paid him, at 23:05. That isn't why.

halima/35a46bb2.speaker: halima
halima/35a46bb2.text: There is no feud. Read her message to the DJ.

mwalimu/86433027.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/86433027.text: Every group is written down at the ticket window. Who handed group fourteen to whom, and when?

mwalimu/9ebcb140.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9ebcb140.text: She asked him to meet at the ruined house. He said sawa. What did he leave behind?

mwalimu/f5d476e0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f5d476e0.text: Read the letter in her bag.

mwalimu/972d6275.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/972d6275.text: A hearing about fake antiquities, and a bag of fakes.

mwalimu/b611c238.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b611c238.text: A fake has a seam if you look closely enough. So do people.

halima/6dd36af1.speaker: halima
halima/6dd36af1.text: He left his group, said "sawa" to her message, and dropped one of his own fakes beside her. That will hold.

halima/e841e42f.speaker: halima
halima/e841e42f.text: Doesn't hold up. The man who lost the cruise contract had forty passengers watching him. Who answered her message?

halima/bfc70a71.speaker: halima
halima/bfc70a71.text: No. Read the register: who handed the group over at five to four?

halima/ae2f1ddc.speaker: halima
halima/ae2f1ddc.text: A coin with a mould seam, a hearing next Saturday, and the secretary who reported him. Clean.

halima/25f2b627.speaker: halima
halima/25f2b627.text: He did it. But he asked her to take the group. That isn't why.

halima/dd44aef5.speaker: halima
halima/dd44aef5.text: Commissions settled, tips written up. Read the letter in her bag.

mwalimu/ce437ffb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ce437ffb.text: The company says she arrived at six. Read the gate log: when did she arrive, and who else drove in?

mwalimu/075f29f2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/075f29f2.text: Lay the two phones side by side. Where did hers go at 23:52?

mwalimu/b1d95f5d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b1d95f5d.text: Open the container she wouldn't sign for.

mwalimu/41f8f2cd.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/41f8f2cd.text: Si printing paper. Ona. Look at what she sent her sister.

mwalimu/233510f4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/233510f4.text: The oval is waiting for a seal. Take the Pattern File off the wall.

mwalimu/07e4bf10.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/07e4bf10.text: Only one pin on the wall is a seal. Lay it over the oval.

mwalimu/4fe58bb0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4fe58bb0.text: Bahati. ... Go to Nakuru, Detective. I will sign the posting tonight.

halima/eb822e2f.speaker: halima
halima/eb822e2f.text: In at 23:05, a cry at 23:35, out at 23:50, and her phone followed his to Nyali. That will hold.

halima/e091789a.speaker: halima
halima/e091789a.text: Doesn't hold up. The owner wanted the police gone for his own reasons. Who drove in after she sent that message?

halima/74f9d09f.speaker: halima
halima/74f9d09f.text: No. Read the stacker moves: Odera never left the far end of the yard.

halima/d78bacaa.speaker: halima
halima/d78bacaa.text: Fourteen months of Mvua money, and one clerk who wouldn't sign. Clean.

halima/064aada0.speaker: halima
halima/064aada0.text: He did it. But not over overtime or a debt. Look in the container.

halima/8f155807.speaker: halima
halima/8f155807.text: That's somebody else's grievance. Read her last message.

halima/5c2dd45b.speaker: halima
halima/5c2dd45b.text: Paper from the sea, a seal from River Road, buyers in Komarock and Kitengela. This isn't a gang, Amani. It's a factory.

halima/e2da8cf0.speaker: halima
halima/e2da8cf0.text: Every one of those pins shows the till. Which one is a seal?

halima/4142d51c.speaker: halima
halima/4142d51c.text: Lay the pins over the empty oval. Only one fits.

c031-p_kimaiyo/24fb1109.speaker: c031-p_kimaiyo
c031-p_kimaiyo/24fb1109.text: That valuer. Yes. She cheated me. I have nothing else to say.

c031-p_kimaiyo/68a876bf.speaker: c031-p_kimaiyo
c031-p_kimaiyo/68a876bf.text: Those trees are mine. I planted them on my land. What does it matter when?

c031-p_kimaiyo/27522059.speaker: c031-p_kimaiyo
c031-p_kimaiyo/27522059.text: I wrote what I felt. Old men are allowed to write letters.

c031-p_kimaiyo/370e90a2.speaker: c031-p_kimaiyo
c031-p_kimaiyo/370e90a2.text: I haven't been up to the crater in years. I was on my farm all afternoon.

c031-p_kimaiyo/94aa426a.speaker: c031-p_kimaiyo
c031-p_kimaiyo/94aa426a.text: I never touched her. She was standing there when I left.

c031-p_kimaiyo/0f853b12.speaker: c031-p_kimaiyo
c031-p_kimaiyo/0f853b12.text: I went up to talk to her. Only talk. I asked her to look again at my trees. She laughed. I came down. She was standing there when I left.

c031-p_duncan/02cb9e72.speaker: c031-p_duncan
c031-p_duncan/02cb9e72.text: I sent her an angry email this morning. I'll never be able to take it back.

c031-p_duncan/29ca0509.speaker: c031-p_duncan
c031-p_duncan/29ca0509.text: She was the only honest valuer we had. That's why she was slow.

c031-p_duncan/84a0f86e.speaker: c031-p_duncan
c031-p_duncan/84a0f86e.text: Valuers never handle money. Finance pays after she signs. She signed what she saw, and she saw everything.

c031-p_duncan/893f8ca1.speaker: c031-p_duncan
c031-p_duncan/893f8ca1.text: I was on the pad all afternoon. The email was about drilling delays.

c031-p_philemon/5b660e1b.speaker: c031-p_philemon
c031-p_philemon/5b660e1b.text: I manage cows. I don't manage Mzee.

c031-p_philemon/6d836735.speaker: c031-p_philemon
c031-p_philemon/6d836735.text: Mzee told us to plant them at night. Two weeks before the date. I said it was wrong. He said, "It's my land.

c031-p_philemon/cdb61559.speaker: c031-p_philemon
c031-p_philemon/cdb61559.text: He had never met her before the valuation. No family, no history. Only that paper.

c031-p_philemon/302d283c.speaker: c031-p_philemon
c031-p_philemon/302d283c.text: Ask Chepkoech. She milks beside me every evening.

c031-p_philemon/40f06493.speaker: c031-p_philemon
c031-p_philemon/40f06493.text: I was milking with the workers.

c031-p_sammy/21cffe91.speaker: c031-p_sammy
c031-p_sammy/21cffe91.text: I write every car. Every one. That's my job.

c031-p_sammy/7ede5460.speaker: c031-p_sammy
c031-p_sammy/7ede5460.text: Mzee Rotich? Yes, he came up at twelve past four. An old man in a green sweater walked up to the viewpoint after that. Then he came back fast and drove away.

c031-p_ivy/08a67c50.speaker: c031-p_ivy
c031-p_ivy/08a67c50.text: The clipboard was just lying there. Nobody leaves a clipboard. So I looked.

c032-p_hesbon/a5edfc7b.speaker: c032-p_hesbon
c032-p_hesbon/a5edfc7b.text: I'm a trained sprayer. I follow the rules.

c032-p_hesbon/2319aed5.speaker: c032-p_hesbon
c032-p_hesbon/2319aed5.text: Fourteen? I haven't sprayed Rosetox this month. Take my prints. Take them.

c032-p_hesbon/db99d1ae.speaker: c032-p_hesbon
c032-p_hesbon/db99d1ae.text: The store was locked all day. The key never left my belt.

c032-p_hesbon/11095857.speaker: c032-p_hesbon
c032-p_hesbon/11095857.text: I left it open when I went for breakfast. Twenty minutes. Everybody does. If the farm finds out, I'm finished. Please.

c032-p_wambui/fe2cfa4d.speaker: c032-p_wambui
c032-p_wambui/fe2cfa4d.text: Twenty years I have been here. I trained that girl myself.

c032-p_wambui/760e98af.speaker: c032-p_wambui
c032-p_wambui/760e98af.text: Somebody wrote on the notice. Not me. People are angry for me.

c032-p_wambui/26318205.speaker: c032-p_wambui
c032-p_wambui/26318205.text: I filled her flask as a welcome. Is that a crime now?

c032-p_wambui/a4189d81.speaker: c032-p_wambui
c032-p_wambui/a4189d81.text: I will not give fingerprints like a thief. I have a lawyer's number.

c032-p_wambui/b86e98df.speaker: c032-p_wambui
c032-p_wambui/b86e98df.text: I have never been inside the chemical store.

c032-p_wambui/d14ab825.speaker: c032-p_wambui
c032-p_wambui/d14ab825.text: I was happy for her. I trained her myself.

c032-p_wambui/f43ecc26.speaker: c032-p_wambui
c032-p_wambui/f43ecc26.text: ...I went in for gloves. Only gloves. At half past seven.

c032-p_samuel/52a941de.speaker: c032-p_samuel
c032-p_samuel/52a941de.text: Nine years I ran that farm. Now they call me?

c032-p_samuel/9b3a5a84.speaker: c032-p_samuel
c032-p_samuel/9b3a5a84.text: She trained Caroline. Then Caroline got the job. You understand?

c032-p_samuel/8e916d84.speaker: c032-p_samuel
c032-p_samuel/8e916d84.text: I was at the labour office all morning.

c032-p_tabitha/c9bdfc9c.speaker: c032-p_tabitha
c032-p_tabitha/c9bdfc9c.text: I make the tea. Everybody's cup, twenty years.

c032-p_tabitha/f76f2ef4.speaker: c032-p_tabitha
c032-p_tabitha/f76f2ef4.text: In twenty years she never filled anybody's flask. Not one. They didn't even eat together.

c032-p_tabitha/6a71eb24.speaker: c032-p_tabitha
c032-p_tabitha/6a71eb24.text: That boy eats breakfast every morning at seven-twenty. Like a clock.

c032-p_daudi/78a59bb3.speaker: c032-p_daudi
c032-p_daudi/78a59bb3.text: I write what I see. Every round.

c032-p_daudi/c364aab9.speaker: c032-p_daudi
c032-p_daudi/c364aab9.text: The store door was open at half past seven and nobody inside. I wrote it. I thought the sprayer was coming back.

c032-p_daudi/f1af3f17.speaker: c032-p_daudi
c032-p_daudi/f1af3f17.text: The boy with the tank. He follows Hesbon all day.

c033-p_kyalo/5d2701cf.speaker: c033-p_kyalo
c033-p_kyalo/5d2701cf.text: Onsongo? Dead? Then my money is in the lake for good.

c033-p_kyalo/5faef15c.speaker: c033-p_kyalo
c033-p_kyalo/5faef15c.text: Nine hundred thousand. My savings and my chama's money. Under a metre of water.

c033-p_kyalo/47e82b97.speaker: c033-p_kyalo
c033-p_kyalo/47e82b97.text: He said it would go back down. The lake doesn't listen to brokers.

c033-p_kyalo/dd658760.speaker: c033-p_kyalo
c033-p_kyalo/dd658760.text: My chama is paid. Every month. I'm not a thief.

c033-p_kyalo/c5ffbffa.speaker: c033-p_kyalo
c033-p_kyalo/c5ffbffa.text: I haven't seen him since August. He won't even take my calls.

c033-p_kyalo/bdc6d4c6.speaker: c033-p_kyalo
c033-p_kyalo/bdc6d4c6.text: I was working late on a pickup's brakes, here, all night.

c033-p_kyalo/376ed41d.speaker: c033-p_kyalo
c033-p_kyalo/376ed41d.text: He came here. Half past eight. He told me my money was in the lake with my plot, and he laughed. Then he left. That's all.

c033-p_kyalo/20254819.speaker: c033-p_kyalo
c033-p_kyalo/20254819.text: I took the pickup out. To test the brakes. You have to test brakes.

c033-p_nico/187c2326.speaker: c033-p_nico
c033-p_nico/187c2326.text: He sold me water too. I prayed for him all night. I didn't kill him.

c033-p_nico/85007209.speaker: c033-p_nico
c033-p_nico/85007209.text: I shouted in his office. A man is allowed to shout when he's robbed.

c033-p_nico/f6789148.speaker: c033-p_nico
c033-p_nico/f6789148.text: Ask Pastor Waithera. I led the singing until five.

c033-p_nico/b1644d40.speaker: c033-p_nico
c033-p_nico/b1644d40.text: I was at church all night.

c033-p_rael/81977038.speaker: c033-p_rael
c033-p_rael/81977038.text: Ask me what you want. I begged him to stop.

c033-p_rael/a07f86cf.speaker: c033-p_rael
c033-p_rael/a07f86cf.text: He went to Lanet to tell a buyer there would be no refund. A mechanic. He said the man was angry.

c033-p_rael/b3c119b4.speaker: c033-p_rael
c033-p_rael/b3c119b4.text: I was at Grace's. Call her.

c033-p_rael/2468dada.speaker: c033-p_rael
c033-p_rael/2468dada.text: I was at my sister's in town.

c033-p_barack/cbc8fda3.speaker: c033-p_barack
c033-p_barack/cbc8fda3.text: Every morning I see this estate under the water. This morning there was a man.

c033-p_barack/0d41592f.speaker: c033-p_barack
c033-p_barack/0d41592f.text: No boat went out last night. We are the only boats here, and we went out at four.

c034-p_gerald/364c3db2.speaker: c034-p_gerald
c034-p_gerald/364c3db2.text: I saw them. Two of them. With wire cutters.

c034-p_gerald/f64ec5e5.speaker: c034-p_gerald
c034-p_gerald/f64ec5e5.text: Fifteen years I worked for Mzee. Fifteen years.

c034-p_gerald/98105acf.speaker: c034-p_gerald
c034-p_gerald/98105acf.text: At six I saw two herders cutting the fence with wire cutters. I ran to report it.

c034-p_gerald/bb527e62.speaker: c034-p_gerald
c034-p_gerald/bb527e62.text: Nobody paid me. It was my own idea, to scare Mzee into selling.

c034-p_gerald/05e940cd.speaker: c034-p_gerald
c034-p_gerald/05e940cd.text: ...There were no herders. I cut it. Before dawn. With the workshop cutters. I needed the money.

c034-p_andrew/29adf95a.speaker: c034-p_andrew
c034-p_andrew/29adf95a.text: This is a nightmare. Clare is driving up now. Whatever you need.

c034-p_andrew/6b906140.speaker: c034-p_andrew
c034-p_andrew/6b906140.text: It was a good offer. He was sitting on land he couldn't afford to run. I was trying to help.

c034-p_andrew/ce74c74b.speaker: c034-p_andrew
c034-p_andrew/ce74c74b.text: A conservation trust. Well. That's what he wanted.

c034-p_andrew/9a0f223f.speaker: c034-p_andrew
c034-p_andrew/9a0f223f.text: I was asleep at the hotel in Nakuru until Clare called me at eight.

c034-p_andrew/3a8c8988.speaker: c034-p_andrew
c034-p_andrew/3a8c8988.text: Robert was a stubborn old man, but I loved him.

c034-p_andrew/9018312d.speaker: c034-p_andrew
c034-p_andrew/9018312d.text: I went for a drive to clear my head. I never went near the ranch.

c034-p_andrew/dee42c0a.speaker: c034-p_andrew
c034-p_andrew/dee42c0a.text: I went for a drive. To clear my head. Is that a crime now?

c034-p_kasaine/9eb65cc1.speaker: c034-p_kasaine
c034-p_kasaine/9eb65cc1.text: Every time something happens on a ranch, the radio says herders.

c034-p_kasaine/bc8c75ca.speaker: c034-p_kasaine
c034-p_kasaine/bc8c75ca.text: Bolt cutters? We don't cut fences. We go through the old gate. Ask the ranch's own guard.

c034-p_kasaine/10b009e0.speaker: c034-p_kasaine
c034-p_kasaine/10b009e0.text: We were at the water point. Ask the attendant. Our names are in his book.

c034-p_clare/f3732267.speaker: c034-p_clare
c034-p_clare/f3732267.text: I knew he was changing the will. I was relieved, actually.

c034-p_clare/0cff6bcd.speaker: c034-p_clare
c034-p_clare/0cff6bcd.text: We haven't spoken since Friday. He wanted Dad to sell. Dad wouldn't. That's all it ever was.

c034-p_clare/afd9cd2f.speaker: c034-p_clare
c034-p_clare/afd9cd2f.text: I was in Nairobi, at work.

c034-p_sankau/a376ab3c.speaker: c034-p_sankau
c034-p_sankau/a376ab3c.text: This is not how herders cross. I have watched this fence for twenty years.

c034-p_sankau/d40af4ec.speaker: c034-p_sankau
c034-p_sankau/d40af4ec.text: Ole Sopia's families water at the borehole every morning. Ten kilometres away. Their names are in the attendant's book.

c034-p_nelson/134e9ed9.speaker: c034-p_nelson
c034-p_nelson/134e9ed9.text: I saddled him myself. At ten to six.

c034-p_nelson/12e5b06a.speaker: c034-p_nelson
c034-p_nelson/12e5b06a.text: The hammer was on the board when I swept. Ten past five. When I came back to saddle, the outline was empty.

c035-p_ronald/3dd678ae.speaker: c035-p_ronald
c035-p_ronald/3dd678ae.text: Dr. Wanjohi? That's terrible. I was in the library.

c035-p_ronald/a3642118.speaker: c035-p_ronald
c035-p_ronald/a3642118.text: Anyone can make a WhatsApp group. Anyone can type a number.

c035-p_ronald/ab1461ef.speaker: c035-p_ronald
c035-p_ronald/ab1461ef.text: Kit seven is mine this term. Lots of people borrow things from it.

c035-p_ronald/77787787.speaker: c035-p_ronald
c035-p_ronald/77787787.text: I was in the library from two until six.

c035-p_ronald/24438c10.speaker: c035-p_ronald
c035-p_ronald/24438c10.text: I went to the lab. To ask her to give me a chance. She wasn't there. I left. That's all.

c035-p_elkanah/4dcc3b6f.speaker: c035-p_elkanah
c035-p_elkanah/4dcc3b6f.text: I check the ovens every Friday. Every Friday.

c035-p_elkanah/191ad0b2.speaker: c035-p_elkanah
c035-p_elkanah/191ad0b2.text: That oven is old. They're all old. I asked for new ones three years running.

c035-p_elkanah/c491da0e.speaker: c035-p_elkanah
c035-p_elkanah/c491da0e.text: I checked that oven this morning. It was earthed. The RCD was working.

c035-p_elkanah/a402cb88.speaker: c035-p_elkanah
c035-p_elkanah/a402cb88.text: The RCD kept tripping. I took it out in June so the ovens would run. I filled the checklist every Friday without checking. I have been afraid every day since June.

c035-p_kenneth/1e61b0ec.speaker: c035-p_kenneth
c035-p_kenneth/1e61b0ec.text: I hope you are not here because I disagreed with a colleague about marks.

c035-p_kenneth/7ba5592a.speaker: c035-p_kenneth
c035-p_kenneth/7ba5592a.text: It was professional. She was usually right. I walked out because she was right.

c035-p_kenneth/85bb16a5.speaker: c035-p_kenneth
c035-p_kenneth/85bb16a5.text: I was in senate all afternoon.

c035-p_nelly/84c86eef.speaker: c035-p_nelly
c035-p_nelly/84c86eef.text: The turnstiles never lie. Students try.

c035-p_nelly/73d86de5.speaker: c035-p_nelly
c035-p_nelly/73d86de5.text: Omwenga? He swiped out at twenty to four. I remember because he usually stays until we close.

c035-p_brenda/a0c201b0.speaker: c035-p_brenda
c035-p_brenda/a0c201b0.text: I was waiting for my practical. I saw him go in.

c035-p_brenda/d3bba227.speaker: c035-p_brenda
c035-p_brenda/d3bba227.text: The robotics boy. He had his robotics bag. He went into the soil lab and came out maybe ten minutes later. He didn't look at me.

c035-p_joshua/ba98cf55.speaker: c035-p_joshua
c035-p_joshua/ba98cf55.text: Thirty years I keep these buildings lit. This was done. It didn't happen.

c035-p_joshua/7cf1452f.speaker: c035-p_joshua
c035-p_joshua/7cf1452f.text: That RCD would have saved her. It was taken out months ago. Look at the dust.

c036-p_vivian/ab5d2cd8.speaker: c036-p_vivian
c036-p_vivian/ab5d2cd8.text: Susan? Dead? I was in town all evening. I have nothing against that woman.

c036-p_vivian/c975f2cb.speaker: c036-p_vivian
c036-p_vivian/c975f2cb.text: Two lorries. Two hundred thousand in fines and my Nairobi buyer gone. Because of a bag.

c036-p_vivian/3211db5c.speaker: c036-p_vivian
c036-p_vivian/3211db5c.text: I was in Nakuru town all evening.

c036-p_vivian/d6347a02.speaker: c036-p_vivian
c036-p_vivian/d6347a02.text: I have nothing against that woman.

c036-p_vivian/4bfa5cbc.speaker: c036-p_vivian
c036-p_vivian/4bfa5cbc.text: I went to the co-op to talk to her. She wouldn't listen. She went back to counting. I left. I never touched that door.

c036-p_benjamin/259f3a42.speaker: c036-p_benjamin
c036-p_benjamin/259f3a42.text: I was at the gate all night. Every hour, signed.

c036-p_benjamin/28dffe4d.speaker: c036-p_benjamin
c036-p_benjamin/28dffe4d.text: That is our lock. The key is twelve. It stays in the office.

c036-p_benjamin/6699574d.speaker: c036-p_benjamin
c036-p_benjamin/6699574d.text: I was at the gate all night. I signed every hour.

c036-p_benjamin/fc7afe2c.speaker: c036-p_benjamin
c036-p_benjamin/fc7afe2c.text: I was at the bar. The match. I signed the whole night's book when I came back at eleven. The gate was empty. I'm sorry. God, I'm sorry.

c036-p_hosea/11c6ecd2.speaker: c036-p_hosea
c036-p_hosea/11c6ecd2.text: I lost the chair to her. I did not lose my mind.

c036-p_hosea/a839e850.speaker: c036-p_hosea
c036-p_hosea/a839e850.text: We fought for years about the chair. Not about this. Never this.

c036-p_hosea/3a351e9f.speaker: c036-p_hosea
c036-p_hosea/3a351e9f.text: Ask Mama Njambi. I have sat by her husband every night since Friday.

c036-p_hosea/0702ba74.speaker: c036-p_hosea
c036-p_hosea/0702ba74.text: I was at a wake in Elburgon.

c036-p_agnetta/1a70bda6.speaker: c036-p_agnetta
c036-p_agnetta/1a70bda6.text: It isn't ours. Ours is brass.

c036-p_agnetta/788e61e3.speaker: c036-p_agnetta
c036-p_agnetta/788e61e3.text: Mondays she stays late and counts every sack. She says the brokers count with their own bags.

c036-p_jared/13c5e429.speaker: c036-p_jared
c036-p_jared/13c5e429.text: At the impound she said, "That woman will regret this." I wrote it in the file.

c037-p_kirimi/163a043e.speaker: c037-p_kirimi
c037-p_kirimi/163a043e.text: Terrible. Terrible. I left at five. The askari saw Ezra go at nine.

c037-p_kirimi/ca7d59af.speaker: c037-p_kirimi
c037-p_kirimi/ca7d59af.text: Every loan goes through committee. I sign what the committee recommends.

c037-p_kirimi/55fab81d.speaker: c037-p_kirimi
c037-p_kirimi/55fab81d.text: Take my prints. I have nothing to hide. I hold that paperweight at every board meeting.

c037-p_kirimi/c804a965.speaker: c037-p_kirimi
c037-p_kirimi/c804a965.text: I left the office at five and was home in Milimani by half past.

c037-p_kirimi/7b9a3b86.speaker: c037-p_kirimi
c037-p_kirimi/7b9a3b86.text: Ezra left at nine. The askari saw him.

c037-p_kirimi/ed4045fd.speaker: c037-p_kirimi
c037-p_kirimi/ed4045fd.text: I stayed late on some files. I went to the chemist and I went home. I didn't see Ezra after five.

c037-p_lemaron/67ad0da4.speaker: c037-p_lemaron
c037-p_lemaron/67ad0da4.text: I saw him go. Nine o'clock. The coat, the hat. He waved.

c037-p_lemaron/6a20020c.speaker: c037-p_lemaron
c037-p_lemaron/6a20020c.text: Every hour I write. I wrote him out at nine.

c037-p_lemaron/fd6e352d.speaker: c037-p_lemaron
c037-p_lemaron/fd6e352d.text: Mr Kamande came out at nine in his coat and hat, and waved.

c037-p_lemaron/fb1a1915.speaker: c037-p_lemaron
c037-p_lemaron/fb1a1915.text: ...I didn't see his face. The hat. He walked a bit bent. Mr Kamande walks very straight. But it was late. It was his coat.

c037-p_eunice/82cdd91e.speaker: c037-p_eunice
c037-p_eunice/82cdd91e.text: He ate at eight. Every night of our marriage.

c037-p_eunice/2f06600e.speaker: c037-p_eunice
c037-p_eunice/2f06600e.text: At ten to six he called. "I'll be late, I have to deal with Kirimi." Those were the words.

c037-p_wilfred/8379e6fa.speaker: c037-p_wilfred
c037-p_wilfred/8379e6fa.text: I know how this looks. The deputy. Ask me.

c037-p_wilfred/f444cd5d.speaker: c037-p_wilfred
c037-p_wilfred/f444cd5d.text: Nobody questions the treasurer. He was here before any of us. Before the building.

c037-p_wilfred/4a9259f1.speaker: c037-p_wilfred
c037-p_wilfred/4a9259f1.text: I was at the club dinner.

c037-p_jemimah/0db73cce.speaker: c037-p_jemimah
c037-p_jemimah/0db73cce.text: I shouted. I owe them money. I don't kill people.

c037-p_jemimah/72241b1b.speaker: c037-p_jemimah
c037-p_jemimah/72241b1b.text: Ask Hellen next door. We sat on the bench together.

c037-p_jemimah/c5a257fe.speaker: c037-p_jemimah
c037-p_jemimah/c5a257fe.text: I was at my shop, then home.

c038-p_mary/54b25d5b.speaker: c038-p_mary
c038-p_mary/54b25d5b.text: Dorothy? I delivered at half past six and went home.

c038-p_mary/d17ce242.speaker: c038-p_mary
c038-p_mary/d17ce242.text: One point zero two nine. That is good milk. Three days she poured it out in front of everyone.

c038-p_mary/6cdd4113.speaker: c038-p_mary
c038-p_mary/6cdd4113.text: I won't give my fingerprints. I'm not a thief.

c038-p_mary/677c998d.speaker: c038-p_mary
c038-p_mary/677c998d.text: I delivered at half past six and went home. I didn't go back.

c038-p_mary/9929f469.speaker: c038-p_mary
c038-p_mary/9929f469.text: I never touched those cans. I brought my own.

c038-p_zakayo/62a2fb84.speaker: c038-p_zakayo
c038-p_zakayo/62a2fb84.text: I bring my milk. I go home.

c038-p_zakayo/3ddb7927.speaker: c038-p_zakayo
c038-p_zakayo/3ddb7927.text: Yes, I paid her. Two hundred a day. Everyone who waters pays. I'm ashamed. I didn't hurt her.

c038-p_zakayo/670a2dc3.speaker: c038-p_zakayo
c038-p_zakayo/670a2dc3.text: Call my son. We were cutting fodder.

c038-p_hudson/4722fb08.speaker: c038-p_hudson
c038-p_hudson/4722fb08.text: Missing litres, yes, I shouted. It was the meter. We fixed it.

c038-p_hudson/82213b73.speaker: c038-p_hudson
c038-p_hudson/82213b73.text: It was the cooling-tank meter. Fixed on Friday. Check the log.

c038-p_hudson/e487b2f9.speaker: c038-p_hudson
c038-p_hudson/e487b2f9.text: I was in Nyahururu at the dairy board.

c038-p_peris/55f880f1.speaker: c038-p_peris
c038-p_peris/55f880f1.text: I left at ten. She was fine. She was alone.

c038-p_peris/d1923f06.speaker: c038-p_peris
c038-p_peris/d1923f06.text: Mama Amoit? Her milk is always good. I didn't understand why it was rejected.

c039-p_cecilia/8d0f5d63.speaker: c039-p_cecilia
c039-p_cecilia/8d0f5d63.text: Twenty years, Jacob and I. On a handshake.

c039-p_cecilia/71ef60d5.speaker: c039-p_cecilia
c039-p_cecilia/71ef60d5.text: I brought him honey for his chest. Is that a crime? I ate from the same honey myself.

c039-p_cecilia/d29bfdf8.speaker: c039-p_cecilia
c039-p_cecilia/d29bfdf8.text: Suppliers come and go. I buy what the mill needs at the best price.

c039-p_cecilia/da462109.speaker: c039-p_cecilia
c039-p_cecilia/da462109.text: I've never bought rat poison in my life. We use traps at the mill.

c039-p_cecilia/a1800f43.speaker: c039-p_cecilia
c039-p_cecilia/a1800f43.text: I ate from the same honey myself. Here, take my jar.

c039-p_cecilia/93eb1b72.speaker: c039-p_cecilia
c039-p_cecilia/93eb1b72.text: The mill has rats. I bought pellets for the store, on Friday. That proves nothing at all.

c039-p_barnabas/f61f58d8.speaker: c039-p_barnabas
c039-p_barnabas/f61f58d8.text: I led a strike. I didn't lead a murder.

c039-p_barnabas/96972c9d.speaker: c039-p_barnabas
c039-p_barnabas/96972c9d.text: We wanted fair pay. A dead boss doesn't pay anybody.

c039-p_barnabas/870a67a6.speaker: c039-p_barnabas
c039-p_barnabas/870a67a6.text: I never went to his house.

c039-p_allan/684eb7d0.speaker: c039-p_allan
c039-p_allan/684eb7d0.text: I came the moment Mum called.

c039-p_allan/1ac04945.speaker: c039-p_allan
c039-p_allan/1ac04945.text: I asked him for money last month. He said yes. He always said yes.

c039-p_allan/2df9aa8c.speaker: c039-p_allan
c039-p_allan/2df9aa8c.text: I came home on Saturday evening.

c039-p_pamela/834b4879.speaker: c039-p_pamela
c039-p_pamela/834b4879.text: She brought it on Saturday. A gift. For his chest.

c039-p_pamela/0db5ba7e.speaker: c039-p_pamela
c039-p_pamela/0db5ba7e.text: Every morning from Sunday, one spoon in his tea. I don't touch honey. I'm diabetic.

c039-p_gedi/e9be9728.speaker: c039-p_gedi
c039-p_gedi/e9be9728.text: We did everything we could. By Thursday it was already in him for days.

c039-p_gedi/c648c6fe.speaker: c039-p_gedi
c039-p_gedi/c648c6fe.text: The bleeding started on Wednesday, at home. This poison works slowly. The dose that killed him was given days before.

c040-p_calvin/72deb483.speaker: c040-p_calvin
c040-p_calvin/72deb483.text: Titus? Terrible. I'm in Nairobi; I'll come up on Sunday.

c040-p_calvin/5a98c876.speaker: c040-p_calvin
c040-p_calvin/5a98c876.text: He was paid well. Re-establishment is routine. Surveyors sign them every day.

c040-p_calvin/9f976ca0.speaker: c040-p_calvin
c040-p_calvin/9f976ca0.text: Mvua? Investors. Everyone has investors. ...Fundi brings the money. A man at the registry fixes the maps. Nobody meets the one at the top.

c040-p_calvin/40c54791.speaker: c040-p_calvin
c040-p_calvin/40c54791.text: I was in Nairobi from Friday morning until Sunday.

c040-p_calvin/4a1378dc.speaker: c040-p_calvin
c040-p_calvin/4a1378dc.text: Titus was paid well. I'm sorry for his family.

c040-p_calvin/9df8c684.speaker: c040-p_calvin
c040-p_calvin/9df8c684.text: I came back early. I drove past the farm. I didn't see him.

c040-p_calvin/a4f77f08.speaker: c040-p_calvin
c040-p_calvin/a4f77f08.text: ...I came back early. I drove past the farm. I didn't see him.

c040-p_elias/da93346f.speaker: c040-p_elias
c040-p_elias/da93346f.text: I drive. That's all I do.

c040-p_elias/d88d00ac.speaker: c040-p_elias
c040-p_elias/d88d00ac.text: I drive him everywhere. He doesn't drive himself. Never.

c040-p_elias/8c43b588.speaker: c040-p_elias
c040-p_elias/8c43b588.text: I drove Mr Calvin to Nairobi on Friday afternoon. We stayed until Sunday.

c040-p_elias/a9c85458.speaker: c040-p_elias
c040-p_elias/a9c85458.text: We were at the farm. Mr Calvin hit him with the beacon. I only drove. I helped lift him. I have not slept. The bar is in the quarry at Kiamaina, with the wallet.

c040-p_simon/bedf9198.speaker: c040-p_simon
c040-p_simon/bedf9198.text: Titus? I shouted at him. Is he...?

c040-p_simon/fef0a811.speaker: c040-p_simon
c040-p_simon/fef0a811.text: I shouted at him. He was right about my fence and I was wrong. I owe him an apology I can't give now.

c040-p_simon/291d25ce.speaker: c040-p_simon
c040-p_simon/291d25ce.text: Ask the elders here. Twenty people, six hours, arguing about cows.

c040-p_simon/77c8ac5a.speaker: c040-p_simon
c040-p_simon/77c8ac5a.text: I was at my nephew's ruracio in Subukia.

c040-p_nicholas/a3bd16f7.speaker: c040-p_nicholas
c040-p_nicholas/a3bd16f7.text: Bahati Highlands? I worked for them for a month.

c040-p_nicholas/3e6078b6.speaker: c040-p_nicholas
c040-p_nicholas/3e6078b6.text: They dropped me because I asked for more money to sign. Titus wouldn't sign for any money. That's the difference between us.

c040-p_nicholas/a87e7df0.speaker: c040-p_nicholas
c040-p_nicholas/a87e7df0.text: I was with a client in Rongai.

c040-p_priscilla/ec318c26.speaker: c040-p_priscilla
c040-p_priscilla/ec318c26.text: He said he was going to photograph fourteen.

c040-p_priscilla/e12037a1.speaker: c040-p_priscilla
c040-p_priscilla/e12037a1.text: Thursday night he kept saying, "Mwenda was right. They moved Mwenda's beacons." I didn't know who Mwenda was.

c040-p_hannah/618f5a4f.speaker: c040-p_hannah
c040-p_hannah/618f5a4f.text: He sat here for two days.

c040-p_hannah/cc5184cd.speaker: c040-p_hannah
c040-p_hannah/cc5184cd.text: FB 4471. Withdrawn by the registry eleven years ago. It never came back. The microfilm is the only copy left.

c040-p_wesley/d336eb40.speaker: c040-p_wesley
c040-p_wesley/d336eb40.text: I collect milk on this road every morning. Every morning.

c040-p_wesley/60c6503a.speaker: c040-p_wesley
c040-p_wesley/60c6503a.text: His pockets were turned out. I thought, robbers. Everybody thinks robbers on this road.

pool-european-m-any-1/f273b5b4.speaker: pool-european-m-any-1
pool-european-m-any-1/f273b5b4.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

pool-european-m-any-1/213db77a.speaker: pool-european-m-any-1
pool-european-m-any-1/213db77a.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

pool-european-m-any-1/9224481b.speaker: pool-european-m-any-1
pool-european-m-any-1/9224481b.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

pool-european-f-any-1/5d7f5e15.speaker: pool-european-f-any-1
pool-european-f-any-1/5d7f5e15.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

pool-european-f-any-1/6b4b5bc7.speaker: pool-european-f-any-1
pool-european-f-any-1/6b4b5bc7.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

pool-european-f-any-1/18ffe0bc.speaker: pool-european-f-any-1
pool-european-f-any-1/18ffe0bc.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

mwalimu/0fc0b8b8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0fc0b8b8.text: New tools, Detective. A pathologist, a lab, and a clock. Detaining someone gives you 24 hours. Use them, don't waste them.

mwalimu/7a3a83bc.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7a3a83bc.text: Dr. Chebii doesn't guess. Read what she found, and also what she didn't.

mwalimu/2545ca43.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2545ca43.text: The clock is running. Take what you need from him, send it to the lab, and keep working while it cooks.

mwalimu/fa702aa4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fa702aa4.text: Every car on the rim road is in a book at the gate. Read it against what the old man told you.

mwalimu/165153e6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/165153e6.text: Her last photo shows someone in green. Look at what he wears, and think about what a lab could do with it.

mwalimu/fbb112b8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fbb112b8.text: Dr. Chebii found bruises before she found anything else. Where are they?

mwalimu/154d6af5.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/154d6af5.text: Gripped from the front by both arms, and no blow to the head first. Say what that is.

mwalimu/21a4adbd.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/21a4adbd.text: Read her file on his farm. Then look at what she was photographing.

mwalimu/f80a2d7e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f80a2d7e.text: Fresh planting rings, two weeks before the deadline. Who loses three and a half million?

mwalimu/b2c58fc2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b2c58fc2.text: Dr. Chebii says you read her report twice before you asked her a question. Good. Pathologists notice that.

halima/6350c2c0.speaker: halima
halima/6350c2c0.text: The gate book puts him on the rim, and his own sweater is under her nails. That will hold.

halima/c26407f7.speaker: halima
halima/c26407f7.text: Doesn't hold up. An angry email from the crater floor isn't a man on the rim. Who walked up that path at twenty past four?

halima/115f6ed9.speaker: halima
halima/115f6ed9.text: No. Read the gate book against what he told you.

halima/48a1f610.speaker: halima
halima/48a1f610.text: Gripped by both arms from the front, no blow first. Pushed. Yes.

halima/537c502f.speaker: halima
halima/537c502f.text: The pathologist disagrees with you. Read what she found on the arms, and what she didn't find on the head.

halima/87b0e0c8.speaker: halima
halima/87b0e0c8.text: An accident doesn't leave fingertip bruises. Try again.

halima/611da026.speaker: halima
halima/611da026.text: Nine hundred seedlings planted at night. That's the reason, and the court will understand it.

halima/f497c1fa.speaker: halima
halima/f497c1fa.text: He signed the route two years ago. That isn't it.

halima/5eff293d.speaker: halima
halima/5eff293d.text: Who gains, and from what paper? Look at the valuation.

mwalimu/81dbf49e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/81dbf49e.text: Ask the tea lady about the flasks. She knows everyone's cup.

mwalimu/d03ef7c2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d03ef7c2.text: Someone filled that flask who never filled flasks. Then there are two sets of prints on a bottle only sprayers touch.

mwalimu/f96460a3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f96460a3.text: Dr. Chebii names a class of chemical. Find it on the farm.

mwalimu/2cc9ffc4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2cc9ffc4.text: Organophosphate signs, and 80 ml missing from a bottle nobody sprayed. Where did the 80 ml go?

mwalimu/8a5d7e05.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8a5d7e05.text: Read the notice board, and read what someone wrote under it.

mwalimu/f1c4294b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f1c4294b.text: She trained the woman who got her job.

mwalimu/2e9a88a2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2e9a88a2.text: The frightened one lied and the calm one killed. Remember which was which.

halima/d964d01d.speaker: halima
halima/d964d01d.text: Her prints on a bottle she's never allowed to touch, and her hands on the flask at 10:15. That will hold.

halima/6de68871.speaker: halima
halima/6de68871.text: Doesn't hold up. The sprayer lied about a door, not a death. Whose hands filled that flask?

halima/d0d08354.speaker: halima
halima/d0d08354.text: No. Count the bottle, then read who stood at the urn at a quarter past ten.

halima/9ff55ff1.speaker: halima
halima/9ff55ff1.text: Organophosphate, in her tea. The pathologist and the lab agree.

halima/cb7c4ecd.speaker: halima
halima/cb7c4ecd.text: A hot greenhouse doesn't put insecticide in a thermos. Read the autopsy again.

halima/7e2db03f.speaker: halima
halima/7e2db03f.text: Fumigation was eight days ago. Try again.

halima/5d9b6bab.speaker: halima
halima/5d9b6bab.text: Twenty years, written on a notice board. That's the reason.

halima/a2e308fc.speaker: halima
halima/a2e308fc.text: That grudge belongs to a man who was at the labour office. Not her reason.

halima/5e13e5c3.speaker: halima
halima/5e13e5c3.text: The ledger reconciles. Look at the notice board instead.

mwalimu/8029c45f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8029c45f.text: His widow knows where he went last night. Then ask his phone.

mwalimu/7de872dd.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7de872dd.text: The phone sat in Lanet until eleven. A pickup in a Lanet garage did 38 km it shouldn't have.

mwalimu/c2083c16.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c2083c16.text: Send the lake water with the lung fluid. Lake Nakuru isn't ordinary water.

mwalimu/10681b62.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/10681b62.text: Clean, chlorinated, no algae. Where do you find a lot of clean water in one place?

mwalimu/2e976a1b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2e976a1b.text: Read the file for plot 47 and the note pinned to it.

mwalimu/79c62a47.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/79c62a47.text: Nine hundred thousand, and the chama loan still being paid. For a plot under the lake.

mwalimu/189f7abd.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/189f7abd.text: Every flooded plot in this country seems to have the same seal on it.

halima/63dea4fe.speaker: halima
halima/63dea4fe.text: His phone sat in Lanet, a pickup did 38 km on untested brakes, and the watch is in his tank. That will hold.

halima/2e34fc58.speaker: halima
halima/2e34fc58.text: Doesn't hold up. The loudest buyer sang all night in front of a congregation. Where did the broker's phone go?

halima/da6982a0.speaker: halima
halima/da6982a0.text: No. Follow the phone, then follow the odometer.

halima/f1be05ec.speaker: halima
halima/f1be05ec.text: Drowned in drinking water, held by the neck, carried to the lake. Yes.

halima/0ecf3aff.speaker: halima
halima/0ecf3aff.text: The lake killed nobody. Read the water results.

halima/0825f77b.speaker: halima
halima/0825f77b.text: No blow, no boat. What was in his lungs?

halima/9b413e86.speaker: halima
halima/9b413e86.text: Nine hundred thousand shillings under a metre of water. The court will understand it, and still convict.

halima/a2554af2.speaker: halima
halima/a2554af2.text: His chama is paid. That isn't it.

halima/490654f2.speaker: halima
halima/490654f2.text: That grievance belongs to someone who was singing all night.

mwalimu/abd0561e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/abd0561e.text: Before you believe the radio, read the water-point book. Then ask who pays a foreman to lie.

mwalimu/6a2a695d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6a2a695d.text: Twenty thousand at ten past five, from a man who left his hotel at ten to five.

mwalimu/9617d860.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9617d860.text: Look at the tool board in the tack room. Something is missing from its outline.

mwalimu/13e04bdb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/13e04bdb.text: Square wounds, and none of the injuries a fall from a horse makes. He never fell.

mwalimu/d8b08570.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d8b08570.text: Read what is on Robert's desk, and what appointment is clipped to it.

mwalimu/c3e51f3d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c3e51f3d.text: A trust on Monday means no sale, ever. Who wanted the sale?

mwalimu/f40bfa42.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f40bfa42.text: The radio said herders by eight in the morning. You said no by the evening. Hold on to that.

halima/f35e81ea.speaker: halima
halima/f35e81ea.text: He paid the foreman, left the hotel at ten to five, his tyres are at the cut and the hammer is under his seat. That will hold.

halima/5783dbe2.speaker: halima
halima/5783dbe2.text: Doesn't hold up. The radio decided this before you did. Open the water-point book before you open your mouth.

halima/a1cefb3b.speaker: halima
halima/a1cefb3b.text: No. The foreman is a liar and a vandal. Who paid him?

halima/3a409aa0.speaker: halima
halima/3a409aa0.text: Two square blows from a standing man, and no fall at all. Staged. Yes.

halima/76834bc1.speaker: halima
halima/76834bc1.text: Read what Dr. Chebii did NOT find: no fractures, no hoof marks.

halima/769700f9.speaker: halima
halima/769700f9.text: Herders with sticks don't leave square wounds.

halima/45d93397.speaker: halima
halima/45d93397.text: A will signed on Monday would have ended the sale for ever. That's the reason.

halima/2bceef3a.speaker: halima
halima/2bceef3a.text: The cattle count reconciles. Try again.

halima/3c88c8bf.speaker: halima
halima/3c88c8bf.text: There is no divorce. Read the study, not the gossip.

mwalimu/77d82a0d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/77d82a0d.text: The library turnstiles keep times. Then ask who was waiting outside the soil lab.

mwalimu/f404b48b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f404b48b.text: Out at 15:40, into the lab at 15:50 with a robotics bag. Whose kit has side-cutters?

mwalimu/cf454c54.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/cf454c54.text: The electrician has the back panel off. Let him tell you what was done.

mwalimu/345bde59.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/345bde59.text: A fresh cut and a wire bent to the case. Old wiring doesn't do that by itself.

mwalimu/738ab8f0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/738ab8f0.text: She was the exams officer. Read what was on her phone.

mwalimu/81a9bdf1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/81a9bdf1.text: A leaks group's number, and the same number on a club contact list.

mwalimu/268e8ba3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/268e8ba3.text: A boy. Twenty years old. Sometimes it is.

halima/92c30dc8.speaker: halima
halima/92c30dc8.text: He left the library, was seen going in with his bag, and his side-cutters cut that wire. Charge the boy.

halima/90585169.speaker: halima
halima/90585169.text: Doesn't hold up. The technician lied about a switch, not a wire. Who was in that lab at ten to four?

halima/021ab9be.speaker: halima
halima/021ab9be.text: No. Sort your liars: one hid negligence, one hid a killing.

halima/302abafe.speaker: halima
halima/302abafe.text: A cut earth, a live wire bent to the case, and no switch to save her. Deliberate. Yes.

halima/0f7fecc8.speaker: halima
halima/0f7fecc8.text: Old wiring doesn't cut itself. Ask the electrician.

halima/b779a424.speaker: halima
halima/b779a424.text: The pathologist found electrical burns. Read them.

halima/ea5c3a9a.speaker: halima
halima/ea5c3a9a.text: Expulsion and a criminal report on Thursday. That's the reason. And send the college a letter about that switch.

halima/21194190.speaker: halima
halima/21194190.text: He has a B+ average. That isn't it.

halima/4265a1b9.speaker: halima
halima/4265a1b9.text: That quarrel belongs to a man who was in senate. Read her phone.

mwalimu/c5f02b4e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c5f02b4e.text: The co-op's own lock is hanging in the office. So whose lock was on the door?

mwalimu/c6bbf26c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c6bbf26c.text: Her phone at the co-op while the yard was empty, and a key on her ring that fits.

mwalimu/32d75a87.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/32d75a87.text: Read her phone. Then read the autopsy's time of death.

mwalimu/bab3127d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bab3127d.text: No signal in stone, and she lived for hours after the door shut. The cold did it.

mwalimu/bd9c0b78.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bd9c0b78.text: Ask the county officer what he impounded last week, and on whose complaint.

mwalimu/d22bb2f9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d22bb2f9.text: 130 kg bags, two lorries, and "that woman will regret this".

mwalimu/480ca878.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/480ca878.text: Three degrees. Go and stand in the sun for a minute, Detective.

halima/350ea0dc.speaker: halima
halima/350ea0dc.text: Her phone at the co-op, her key, her prints on the lock. That will hold.

halima/b01f2cb3.speaker: halima
halima/b01f2cb3.text: Doesn't hold up. The guard lied about where he was, not about a lock. Whose key opens that padlock?

halima/838e3b9d.speaker: halima
halima/838e3b9d.text: No. The election rival sat at a wake all night. Follow the impound.

halima/8d5c0869.speaker: halima
halima/8d5c0869.text: Locked in, no signal, three degrees. Hypothermia. Yes.

halima/767ee2ab.speaker: halima
halima/767ee2ab.text: The vents were open at six. Read the log.

halima/a5a9ce53.speaker: halima
halima/a5a9ce53.text: No injuries at all. Read what Dr. Chebii found.

halima/2e551cfc.speaker: halima
halima/2e551cfc.text: Two lorries and a buyer lost over a 50 kg bag. That's the reason.

halima/29bd457c.speaker: halima
halima/29bd457c.text: The ledger is paid in full. Try again.

halima/9c40b982.speaker: halima
halima/9c40b982.text: That grudge was settled at a ballot box, and its owner was at a wake.

mwalimu/bb044a5d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bb044a5d.text: His coat is on its hook. Coats have pockets.

mwalimu/b5099e02.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b5099e02.text: He was dead before supper, yet someone in his coat bought tablets at 21:05. Whose member number?

mwalimu/b180e133.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b180e133.text: The heavy thing on the strong-room floor. Ask Dr. Chebii to look at it beside the wound.

mwalimu/726e0b43.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/726e0b43.text: One blow, a rounded edge, and a paperweight that fits.

mwalimu/8afdab4c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8afdab4c.text: Read what Ezra was about to send in the morning.

mwalimu/4641e42d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4641e42d.text: Forty-one loans, seventeen dead borrowers, twenty-four who never existed. One signature.

mwalimu/cee403c1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/cee403c1.text: People see the coat. Detectives see who's inside it.

halima/edac5691.speaker: halima
halima/edac5691.text: His member number in the dead man's coat, his phone in town until half nine, his signature on 41 ghost loans. That will hold.

halima/e4b4ea9e.speaker: halima
halima/e4b4ea9e.text: Doesn't hold up. The deputy was signing a dinner bill in front of thirty people. Who was wearing that coat?

halima/42fbb795.speaker: halima
halima/42fbb795.text: No. The askari didn't lie, but he didn't see a face. Whose tablets are in the pocket?

halima/58327005.speaker: halima
halima/58327005.text: One blow, a rounded brass edge, before half past seven. Yes.

halima/3ed2294b.speaker: halima
halima/3ed2294b.text: He was dead before supper. He never came back to the office late.

halima/1d144bc8.speaker: halima
halima/1d144bc8.text: Dr. Chebii found a blow, not suffocation.

halima/55045d02.speaker: halima
halima/55045d02.text: Seventeen dead members and twenty-four who never lived, all signed by the treasurer. That's the reason.

halima/bf0d0701.speaker: halima
halima/bf0d0701.text: The land purchase was unanimous. That isn't it.

halima/0a9baa09.speaker: halima
halima/0a9baa09.text: That ambition belongs to a man at a club dinner.

mwalimu/304da394.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/304da394.text: Someone called Dorothy at five past ten. Read her phone.

mwalimu/42c7939b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/42c7939b.text: A boda dropped her at the centre at 10:20, and her phone stayed until 10:40.

mwalimu/09f42911.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/09f42911.text: Dr. Chebii counted the blows and measured their shape.

mwalimu/91799211.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/91799211.text: Two blows with a heavy rounded rim, and a dented can on the floor.

mwalimu/dbaf6c89.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/dbaf6c89.text: Drag every reading onto the wall chart. Whose good milk was rejected?

mwalimu/32407af4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/32407af4.text: Watered milk accepted, good milk rejected, and a column headed "B".

halima/cbc38ac8.speaker: halima
halima/cbc38ac8.text: Her call, her boda, her phone at the centre, and her hands on the base of that can. That will hold.

halima/82da2fd7.speaker: halima
halima/82da2fd7.text: Doesn't hold up. The man who paid bribes was cutting fodder with his son. Who came back after ten?

halima/9d71a158.speaker: halima
halima/9d71a158.text: No. Read her phone, then follow the boda.

halima/339b67b0.speaker: halima
halima/339b67b0.text: Two blows with a can rim. Yes.

halima/a695a227.speaker: halima
halima/a695a227.text: No fluid in the lungs. Not the tank.

halima/3b433753.speaker: halima
halima/3b433753.text: Two blows, not a fall. Read the autopsy.

halima/258f62c7.speaker: halima
halima/258f62c7.text: Good milk poured away because she wouldn't pay. The court will understand. It will still convict.

halima/d51c351f.speaker: halima
halima/d51c351f.text: The missing litres were a meter fault. Try again.

halima/b1d14cbe.speaker: halima
halima/b1d14cbe.text: Fear of exposure is the briber's problem, and he was at home.

mwalimu/9b3c3e95.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9b3c3e95.text: This poison works slowly. Ask his wife what he was given in the week before.

mwalimu/b7958cb1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b7958cb1.text: Rat poison bought on Friday; a jar of honey given on Saturday. Same woman.

mwalimu/5b9480c6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5b9480c6.text: Send the jar on the kitchen shelf to the lab, and the card beside it to your notebook.

mwalimu/931a6c88.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/931a6c88.text: Blood that won't clot, and the same poison in the honey. One spoon a day.

mwalimu/b0c871a7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b0c871a7.text: Read the letter on Jacob's desk, then the list on the office wall.

mwalimu/e678bfd4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e678bfd4.text: A circled name on a blacklist, and eleven invoices from it, all approved by one partner.

halima/4827fdff.speaker: halima
halima/4827fdff.text: Rat poison bought on Friday, honey given on Saturday, her own jar clean, and her card on the poisoned one. That will hold.

halima/cff984e1.speaker: halima
halima/cff984e1.text: Doesn't hold up. A strike leader who never entered the house can't put anything in a jar on its shelf.

halima/b42a1ee9.speaker: halima
halima/b42a1ee9.text: No. Work backwards from Wednesday. Who gave him something on Saturday?

halima/7cb509f8.speaker: halima
halima/7cb509f8.text: The same poison in his blood and in the honey, and pellet dye in the jar. Yes.

halima/a71296c3.speaker: halima
halima/a71296c3.text: The bleeding began at home on Wednesday, before the hospital ever saw him.

halima/18465be5.speaker: halima
halima/18465be5.text: The canteen samples are clean. Try again.

halima/25f94949.speaker: halima
halima/25f94949.text: Eleven invoices from a blacklisted supplier, and a report ready to send. That's the reason.

halima/df99d6fc.speaker: halima
halima/df99d6fc.text: The profit shares were paid in full. That isn't it.

halima/66ed6fbf.speaker: halima
halima/66ed6fbf.text: The title is his alone and undisputed.

mwalimu/896117bb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/896117bb.text: Titus wrote a note on his contract. Read whose company it is, and ask his phone where he went.

mwalimu/5d6a9463.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5d6a9463.text: Two phones, the same mast at Block 9, the same mast on the road at 19:25.

mwalimu/fb1401a2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fb1401a2.text: Read the lividity. Then compare the soil on his clothes with the soil on the verge.

mwalimu/6dc3c789.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6dc3c789.text: Stripes 4 cm apart, red soil on a grey verge. He died somewhere else and rode to the road.

mwalimu/d5e45500.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d5e45500.text: Open his glovebox. He carried two maps of the same land.

mwalimu/52b14638.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/52b14638.text: "Amendment is false." Every beacon moved, and he wouldn't sign.

mwalimu/6991106a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6991106a.text: Read the name at the bottom of the field book, Detective. Slowly.

mwalimu/880e6ab6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/880e6ab6.text: FB 4471, J. Mwenda. And a line in a drawer at Shimanzi: "Bahati — old matter — closed 12 yrs".

halima/0433cd36.speaker: halima
halima/0433cd36.text: Two phones on the same mast, a pickup bed with his blood in it, and his prints on the bar. The driver lifted; Calvin struck.

halima/750e5868.speaker: halima
halima/750e5868.text: Doesn't hold up. The driver lifted him. Who held the bar? The lab can tell you.

halima/4ad9c098.speaker: halima
halima/4ad9c098.text: No. A farmer who shouted at a market was at a ruracio all night. Follow the phones.

halima/e9930889.speaker: halima
halima/e9930889.text: Red soil on a grey verge, stripes on his side, a beacon bar in a quarry. Killed at the farm, moved to the road.

halima/40d4e5bc.speaker: halima
halima/40d4e5bc.text: The verge is grey murram. Read the soil.

halima/a497ba0c.speaker: halima
halima/a497ba0c.text: There are stripes on his side. What was he lying on for an hour?

halima/6fdd2a81.speaker: halima
halima/6fdd2a81.text: "Will not sign. Amendment is false." That's the reason.

halima/96d6126b.speaker: halima
halima/96d6126b.text: The wallet is in the quarry with the bar. It was never a robbery.

halima/481ef33c.speaker: halima
halima/481ef33c.text: The deposit was paid. That isn't it.

halima/6fd47d0e.speaker: halima
halima/6fd47d0e.text: Amani. That's your father's name on the field book. Do you want me to take this one to court myself?

halima/ebb8ad3e.speaker: halima
halima/ebb8ad3e.text: Read the name at the bottom of the field book in his glovebox.

halima/235de311.speaker: halima
halima/235de311.text: That pin is a different crime. Who surveyed Block 9 first?

c041-p_geoffrey/eafc5159.speaker: c041-p_geoffrey
c041-p_geoffrey/eafc5159.text: Phoebe? Pole sana. I was here all morning. Ask anyone.

c041-p_geoffrey/e49127d0.speaker: c041-p_geoffrey
c041-p_geoffrey/e49127d0.text: That engine was reconditioned from scrap. Parts from five engines. Serial numbers on scrap mean nothing, Inspector.

c041-p_geoffrey/048abfe2.speaker: c041-p_geoffrey
c041-p_geoffrey/048abfe2.text: Every mechanic on this lake has propellers. Anyone can scratch two letters.

c041-p_geoffrey/05c7e268.speaker: c041-p_geoffrey
c041-p_geoffrey/05c7e268.text: I was at my workshop in town from half past six.

c041-p_geoffrey/0b101fac.speaker: c041-p_geoffrey
c041-p_geoffrey/0b101fac.text: That engine was reconditioned from scrap. I have papers.

c041-p_geoffrey/aedb6474.speaker: c041-p_geoffrey
c041-p_geoffrey/aedb6474.text: ...I went to Dunga to explain the papers. She wouldn't listen. I left her at her desk.

c041-p_dismas/f9466318.speaker: c041-p_dismas
c041-p_dismas/f9466318.text: I left her at 06:45 with her book. Go and find who did this.

c041-p_dismas/ef81f6f0.speaker: c041-p_dismas
c041-p_dismas/ef81f6f0.text: We fought about numbers last week. The numbers were wrong. Mine, not hers. We fixed it on Saturday.

c041-p_dismas/61f91314.speaker: c041-p_dismas
c041-p_dismas/61f91314.text: A propeller? Then it's in the water. My boys dive for dropped engines every week. Give them an hour.

c041-p_dismas/90992d88.speaker: c041-p_dismas
c041-p_dismas/90992d88.text: I was at the fisheries office by seven.

c041-p_elisha/1b8506e5.speaker: c041-p_elisha
c041-p_elisha/1b8506e5.text: I fish. I came in at quarter past eight and the beach was screaming.

c041-p_elisha/a557e2f4.speaker: c041-p_elisha
c041-p_elisha/a557e2f4.text: I paid him one hundred and eighty thousand for that engine. My whole savings. I didn't know. I swear I didn't know.

c041-p_benta/6a2f6c08.speaker: c041-p_benta
c041-p_benta/6a2f6c08.text: Every morning, seven o'clock, chai and one mandazi. Today she didn't finish the mandazi. She said a mechanic was coming.

c041-p_seline/2279c8dc.speaker: c041-p_seline
c041-p_seline/2279c8dc.text: She spreads her own fish. Every day. Look at the basket.

c041-p_seline/3629e701.speaker: c041-p_seline
c041-p_seline/3629e701.text: She talked about that book like it was scripture. Every stolen engine on the lake, she wanted it home.

c042-p_sarah/a7d0d3dd.speaker: c042-p_sarah
c042-p_sarah/a7d0d3dd.text: I heard. I won't pretend to cry.

c042-p_sarah/8e1f4b47.speaker: c042-p_sarah
c042-p_sarah/8e1f4b47.text: Yes, that is my tag. I sent it back to him weeks ago. He never answered.

c042-p_sarah/d58ad94f.speaker: c042-p_sarah
c042-p_sarah/d58ad94f.text: Two nights in a cell with my customers' children crying outside. My shop is gone. He sold me poison and called it sugar.

c042-p_sarah/6fe3a959.speaker: c042-p_sarah
c042-p_sarah/6fe3a959.text: I came on the afternoon bus. I only got to Kisumu at two.

c042-p_sarah/71c8ab6b.speaker: c042-p_sarah
c042-p_sarah/71c8ab6b.text: ...I came in the morning. I brought him his rotten sugar so he could see it. He laughed. I left.

c042-p_ben/7910c088.speaker: c042-p_ben
c042-p_ben/7910c088.text: I found him. I pulled two sacks off before I understood.

c042-p_ben/48f26d91.speaker: c042-p_ben
c042-p_ben/48f26d91.text: He paid me badly. Everyone knows it. I wouldn't kill him for that.

c042-p_ben/53e84321.speaker: c042-p_ben
c042-p_ben/53e84321.text: Saturday nights he sewed new sacks in there. Mzee said not to ask. So I didn't ask.

c042-p_yusuf/34e22847.speaker: c042-p_yusuf
c042-p_yusuf/34e22847.text: His business is his business. I sell sugar.

c042-p_yusuf/dc755b5d.speaker: c042-p_yusuf
c042-p_yusuf/dc755b5d.text: I told him five years ago: one day that re-sacking will kill somebody. He laughed. He always laughed.

c042-p_yusuf/14427d10.speaker: c042-p_yusuf
c042-p_yusuf/14427d10.text: I was at my counter all morning.

c042-p_hassan/b7aae326.speaker: c042-p_hassan
c042-p_hassan/b7aae326.text: I took his fee at ten past eleven. He was laughing.

c042-p_hassan/040bcbf2.speaker: c042-p_hassan
c042-p_hassan/040bcbf2.text: Opolot? No stall here, never. Let me check the register. ...No. Nothing.

c042-p_diana/b6138257.speaker: c042-p_diana
c042-p_diana/b6138257.text: That's the sugar. That's the one.

c042-p_diana/1b7fcc05.speaker: c042-p_diana
c042-p_diana/1b7fcc05.text: A sewing machine and new sacks. I'll need that room sealed, Detective.

c043-p_jacktone/c7624ae7.speaker: c043-p_jacktone
c043-p_jacktone/c7624ae7.text: Terrible. Terrible. When they quarrelled at nine I was at the jetty. Ask anyone.

c043-p_jacktone/ba03ae3d.speaker: c043-p_jacktone
c043-p_jacktone/ba03ae3d.text: Twelve years I served this island. Then a letter from Nairobi, and he has my agencies. Yes, I wrote that note. Bread is bread.

c043-p_jacktone/dca08a32.speaker: c043-p_jacktone
c043-p_jacktone/dca08a32.text: A battery? I have bought batteries there a hundred times. Take my fingerprints. Take them. I was at the jetty.

c043-p_jacktone/60d14add.speaker: c043-p_jacktone
c043-p_jacktone/60d14add.text: I was at the jetty from seven o'clock, waiting for my goods.

c043-p_jacktone/12f2ea6e.speaker: c043-p_jacktone
c043-p_jacktone/12f2ea6e.text: When they quarrelled at nine I was at the jetty. Everyone saw me.

c043-p_jacktone/f9ceac84.speaker: c043-p_jacktone
