c043-p_jacktone/f9ceac84.text: I went to the jetty a bit later, yes. I was walking around. I didn't go to his shop.

c043-p_jacktone/39e34946.speaker: c043-p_jacktone
c043-p_jacktone/39e34946.text: ...I went to the jetty a bit later, yes. I was walking around. I didn't go to his shop.

c043-p_celestine/4d4280c5.speaker: c043-p_celestine
c043-p_celestine/4d4280c5.text: I owe him. Everyone knows I owe him. I was singing.

c043-p_celestine/6e1b4594.speaker: c043-p_celestine
c043-p_celestine/6e1b4594.text: He shouted at me on Tuesday, yes. On Wednesday he came to my stall and we signed a plan. Three thousand a week. It's in his book.

c043-p_steve/ac9d2727.speaker: c043-p_steve
c043-p_steve/ac9d2727.text: I'm coming on the first boat. I've been here since Wednesday.

c043-p_steve/d446bd9d.speaker: c043-p_steve
c043-p_steve/d446bd9d.text: Uncle never turned that radio off. Not even to sleep. Every Thursday, the play. He laughed at the same jokes every week.

c043-p_steve/d25dfd89.speaker: c043-p_steve
c043-p_steve/d25dfd89.text: I've been in Mbita since Wednesday.

c043-p_rispa/7b0294b4.speaker: c043-p_rispa
c043-p_rispa/7b0294b4.text: I heard them. God forgive me, I heard them and I didn't go.

c043-p_rispa/9ae4c7e5.speaker: c043-p_rispa
c043-p_rispa/9ae4c7e5.text: His radio? It's always on. Mine too. On Thursday everyone listens to the play. I had mine on that night.

c043-p_selpher/00d40c5c.speaker: c043-p_selpher
c043-p_selpher/00d40c5c.text: He ate everything on his plate. He was laughing.

c043-p_selpher/60a02c4b.speaker: c043-p_selpher
c043-p_selpher/60a02c4b.text: Jacktone? No family of ours. None. Not by blood, not by marriage. Only business.

c043-p_owen/03d1db93.speaker: c043-p_owen
c043-p_owen/03d1db93.text: Ojuka came for his goods. Late. The boat was late too.

c043-p_owen/004ddeff.speaker: c043-p_owen
c043-p_owen/004ddeff.text: About twenty to nine he came. Out of breath, sweating. I thought he'd run from the trading centre.

c044-p_violet/7df28c11.speaker: c044-p_violet
c044-p_violet/7df28c11.text: I didn't leave the house until eight.

c044-p_violet/9acf3d18.speaker: c044-p_violet
c044-p_violet/9acf3d18.text: He wrote her name. Not mine. I asked them to divide it. They said only she could ask. She never asked.

c044-p_violet/eece1709.speaker: c044-p_violet
c044-p_violet/eece1709.text: I didn't leave the house until eight. I heard the news from the neighbours.

c044-p_violet/69eabff2.speaker: c044-p_violet
c044-p_violet/69eabff2.text: ...I went to the canal to wash. That's all. I didn't see her.

c044-p_silas/96d916dc.speaker: c044-p_silas
c044-p_silas/96d916dc.text: A hippo! I told them, fence that canal!

c044-p_silas/0182771e.speaker: c044-p_silas
c044-p_silas/0182771e.text: My brother's land should be with the family. A woman can't hold three paddies. I said so and I'll say it again.

c044-p_silas/f7ebdefc.speaker: c044-p_silas
c044-p_silas/f7ebdefc.text: Ask the traders. I was bidding from half past five. I bought six bags.

c044-p_silas/bb0f4156.speaker: c044-p_silas
c044-p_silas/bb0f4156.text: I was at the rice auction.

c044-p_nahashon/575d8f14.speaker: c044-p_nahashon
c044-p_nahashon/575d8f14.text: I open gates. That's what I do.

c044-p_nahashon/ffd087b7.speaker: c044-p_nahashon
c044-p_nahashon/ffd087b7.text: Yes, she reported me. I've already been warned. I'll lose my job, not my mind. I was at block C, ask the tenants who signed.

c044-p_nahashon/3609c1d6.speaker: c044-p_nahashon
c044-p_nahashon/3609c1d6.text: I was opening the main sluice at block C.

c044-p_oyugi/64e3d8ee.speaker: c044-p_oyugi
c044-p_oyugi/64e3d8ee.text: Kiboko? No. I have seen kiboko for forty years.

c044-p_oyugi/23e44011.speaker: c044-p_oyugi
c044-p_oyugi/23e44011.text: A hippo leaves round prints the size of a plate, four toes, and it eats the rice. This is a drag mark. There's no footprint at all. Here, I'll draw it for you.

c044-p_clement/3ac2d548.speaker: c044-p_clement
c044-p_clement/3ac2d548.text: I wrote her name in this book. I've been thinking about that all morning.

c044-p_clement/47123990.speaker: c044-p_clement
c044-p_clement/47123990.text: She works Jacinta's paddies for a third of the harvest. No debts, no loans. The rules give the paddies to the nominated wife. One widow gets everything, the other gets permission.

c045-p_priya/5f4d490a.speaker: c045-p_priya
c045-p_priya/5f4d490a.text: I went to bed at eleven. I didn't leave our room until morning.

c045-p_priya/21ed71d6.speaker: c045-p_priya
c045-p_priya/21ed71d6.text: He never let anyone touch it. Everyone knows that. ...No, you can't have my phone. My phone is private.

c045-p_priya/7dcd0e44.speaker: c045-p_priya
c045-p_priya/7dcd0e44.text: I went to bed at eleven and didn't leave our room until morning.

c045-p_priya/a0017039.speaker: c045-p_priya
c045-p_priya/a0017039.text: He was asleep. I put the glass down and came back. I never touched his pen.

c045-p_priya/85e57fa4.speaker: c045-p_priya
c045-p_priya/85e57fa4.text: ...I took him his water, as I always do. He was asleep. I came back.

c045-p_rahul/0e318e2d.speaker: c045-p_rahul
c045-p_rahul/0e318e2d.text: Priya was beside me all night. Please, my father is dead, why are you asking about my wife?

c045-p_rahul/87400338.speaker: c045-p_rahul
c045-p_rahul/87400338.text: That is a business matter. I would rather discuss it with a lawyer.

c045-p_rahul/9a78efa8.speaker: c045-p_rahul
c045-p_rahul/9a78efa8.text: Priya was beside me all night.

c045-p_rahul/14123f5b.speaker: c045-p_rahul
c045-p_rahul/14123f5b.text: ...She got up. I don't know for how long. I didn't ask. Please. It was my fault, the money, all of it.

c045-p_anil/76343897.speaker: c045-p_anil
c045-p_anil/76343897.text: Tragic. We were rivals for thirty years. That is not the same as enemies.

c045-p_anil/e01c761f.speaker: c045-p_anil
c045-p_anil/e01c761f.text: I offered to buy. He refused. Old men refuse. My driver took me home; ask him. Eight people were in this garden until one.

c045-p_anil/96bc0d24.speaker: c045-p_anil
c045-p_anil/96bc0d24.text: I left at twenty to eleven and had guests at home.

c045-p_ernest/9503f2a8.speaker: c045-p_ernest
c045-p_ernest/9503f2a8.text: I drove them home at half past ten. I went to my quarters at ten to eleven.

c045-p_ernest/3b11fe35.speaker: c045-p_ernest
c045-p_ernest/3b11fe35.text: Mzee never paid late. My wages and the Christmas money came on the twentieth. Take my fingerprints if you want; take everyone's.

c045-p_ernest/bc7ca119.speaker: c045-p_ernest
c045-p_ernest/bc7ca119.text: I went to my quarters at ten to eleven.

c045-p_sabina/0a55ff93.speaker: c045-p_sabina
c045-p_sabina/0a55ff93.text: Bapuji never let anyone touch his pen.

c045-p_sabina/4351178a.speaker: c045-p_sabina
c045-p_sabina/4351178a.text: I don't know about money. I know there has been no fighting about the children's school, if that's what they tell you. That was settled two years ago.

c045-p_tom/b85f943f.speaker: c045-p_tom
c045-p_tom/b85f943f.text: Table 4 left at half ten. Mr Mehta's table, ten minutes after. There were voices earlier.

c046-p_truphena/8a141dc4.speaker: c046-p_truphena
c046-p_truphena/8a141dc4.text: That poor girl. I saw her lantern going out at eight. She was always too brave on the water.

c046-p_truphena/1e074bc0.speaker: c046-p_truphena
c046-p_truphena/1e074bc0.text: A sacco loan? She never told me. Well. Then she would have paid. Good for her.

c046-p_truphena/c5070d4f.speaker: c046-p_truphena
c046-p_truphena/c5070d4f.text: Valary went out omena fishing at eight. I saw her lantern going out from my door.

c046-p_truphena/f740c7e0.speaker: c046-p_truphena
c046-p_truphena/f740c7e0.text: She owed me. I'd never hurt a borrower.

c046-p_truphena/ebb6c67f.speaker: c046-p_truphena
c046-p_truphena/ebb6c67f.text: Valary never came here. Ask anyone.

c046-p_truphena/cfb619b5.speaker: c046-p_truphena
c046-p_truphena/cfb619b5.text: Maybe I saw another lantern. My eyes are old. I was home all evening, from seven, by myself.

c046-p_calvince/f398375e.speaker: c046-p_calvince
c046-p_calvince/f398375e.text: I took the boat to Mbita. That's my job.

c046-p_calvince/35fc7efc.speaker: c046-p_calvince
c046-p_calvince/35fc7efc.text: She pays me by the trip. I don't ask where the money comes from.

c046-p_calvince/fd5f0632.speaker: c046-p_calvince
c046-p_calvince/fd5f0632.text: I was home with my wife until Mama Truphena called. Ask Dorcas.

c046-p_calvince/585c0998.speaker: c046-p_calvince
c046-p_calvince/585c0998.text: I took the boat to Mbita.

c046-p_calvince/566c55f2.speaker: c046-p_calvince
c046-p_calvince/566c55f2.text: She paid me five thousand to tow Valary's canoe out. She said Valary was drunk and sleeping it off. I didn't look. God forgive me, I didn't look.

c046-p_kizito/6fdace46.speaker: c046-p_kizito
c046-p_kizito/6fdace46.text: I was at the party until after two. There are a hundred photos.

c046-p_kizito/fe6c2e2e.speaker: c046-p_kizito
c046-p_kizito/fe6c2e2e.text: She dumped me. I shouted at her on New Year's Eve. That's all. I would never... look at the photos.

c046-p_kizito/be4566ca.speaker: c046-p_kizito
c046-p_kizito/be4566ca.text: I was at the party in Mbita until after two.

c046-p_japheth/ecd70a90.speaker: c046-p_japheth
c046-p_japheth/ecd70a90.text: She sent us home. She said the moon was fat.

c046-p_rose/2cf43299.speaker: c046-p_rose
c046-p_rose/2cf43299.text: Nobody went out. Nobody. Look at the sky last night.

c047-p_mitchelle/f6573297.speaker: c047-p_mitchelle
c047-p_mitchelle/f6573297.text: I left at midnight. I went home to sleep.

c047-p_mitchelle/91e22ee0.speaker: c047-p_mitchelle
c047-p_mitchelle/91e22ee0.text: I left the disco at midnight and went home to sleep.

c047-p_mitchelle/9de9fff3.speaker: c047-p_mitchelle
c047-p_mitchelle/9de9fff3.text: He was nothing to me any more.

c047-p_mitchelle/dbd31e4b.speaker: c047-p_mitchelle
c047-p_mitchelle/dbd31e4b.text: I told him. He laughed. I walked away and he was smoking.

c047-p_mitchelle/96c88c66.speaker: c047-p_mitchelle
c047-p_mitchelle/96c88c66.text: He read my messages to everyone. My whole village heard. I wanted to tell him what he was. That's all.

c047-p_arnold/cc643247.speaker: c047-p_arnold
c047-p_arnold/cc643247.text: I never left the tent all night. Ask anyone.

c047-p_arnold/89df69b2.speaker: c047-p_arnold
c047-p_arnold/89df69b2.text: The elders will settle it after the burial. That land is my father's side. Brighton had nothing to do with it.

c047-p_arnold/c9c2c07d.speaker: c047-p_arnold
c047-p_arnold/c9c2c07d.text: I never left the funeral tent all night.

c047-p_arnold/715348e6.speaker: c047-p_arnold
c047-p_arnold/715348e6.text: ...I took four sacks. That maize is half mine. I went the back way with my cart at about half past two and came back before the music. I didn't see Brighton.

c047-p_sharleen/15cf45e4.speaker: c047-p_sharleen
c047-p_sharleen/15cf45e4.text: He read her messages. I told him to stop. He didn't. When the lights went I was holding the torch for the DJ's boys. My friends were there.

c047-p_sharleen/51623a2c.speaker: c047-p_sharleen
c047-p_sharleen/51623a2c.text: I was at the generator holding the torch.

c047-p_fidelis/29b90884.speaker: c047-p_fidelis
c047-p_fidelis/29b90884.text: Every track has a time. Everything.

c047-p_turfosa/88b329e5.speaker: c047-p_turfosa
c047-p_turfosa/88b329e5.text: Four hundred people, and I counted my pestles. One is gone.

c048-p_robi/60366d4f.speaker: c048-p_robi
c048-p_robi/60366d4f.text: I was at the ponds from five o'clock. Weigh my reference weight on her scale.

c048-p_robi/77376062.speaker: c048-p_robi
c048-p_robi/77376062.text: Three years. He went down that shaft and they brought him up dead. And she weighed his gold light for six years before that.

c048-p_robi/ff29423b.speaker: c048-p_robi
c048-p_robi/ff29423b.text: I was at the washing ponds from five o'clock.

c048-p_robi/71f2ecae.speaker: c048-p_robi
c048-p_robi/71f2ecae.text: Rosebella was a thief. Weigh my reference weight on her scale.

c048-p_robi/9477f122.speaker: c048-p_robi
c048-p_robi/9477f122.text: She laughed at me and at my husband. She was alive when I left. Then I went to the ponds.

c048-p_robi/56c2b5e1.speaker: c048-p_robi
c048-p_robi/56c2b5e1.text: I went to show her the weight. I told her I'd tell the whole field. She laughed at me and at my husband. Then I went to the ponds.

c048-p_mwikwabe/b4255083.speaker: c048-p_mwikwabe
c048-p_mwikwabe/b4255083.text: Shaft 7 was propped properly. It was inspected last week.

c048-p_mwikwabe/653c403a.speaker: c048-p_mwikwabe
c048-p_mwikwabe/653c403a.text: I was at shaft 12 with my crew all morning. Ask Chacha.

c048-p_mwikwabe/7d271f6f.speaker: c048-p_mwikwabe
c048-p_mwikwabe/7d271f6f.text: The props were rotten. I couldn't afford timber. I told the women to be careful. I didn't kill her, I killed nobody. But I knew that shaft could fall.

c048-p_jairus/7a959b05.speaker: c048-p_jairus
c048-p_jairus/7a959b05.text: Everyone said her scale was light. Nobody could prove it. I was here from half past five. Peter will tell you; he sold to me first.

c048-p_jairus/6d0b60f9.speaker: c048-p_jairus
c048-p_jairus/6d0b60f9.text: I was at the Migori market.

c048-p_boke/ea8afb1c.speaker: c048-p_boke
c048-p_boke/ea8afb1c.text: I heard them. I thought it was the usual morning shouting.

c048-p_nyakerario/3bd8887c.speaker: c048-p_nyakerario
c048-p_nyakerario/3bd8887c.text: Robi came at twenty to seven. Out of breath. Then she went off again.

c049-p_ephantus/bbbe3121.speaker: c049-p_ephantus
c049-p_ephantus/bbbe3121.text: I haven't been to Lwang'ni since Friday. That woman lied about my fish and cost me everything.

c049-p_ephantus/3db881c2.speaker: c049-p_ephantus
c049-p_ephantus/3db881c2.text: Frozen, fresh, who can tell? Fish is fish. She wanted cheaper, she found an excuse.

c049-p_ephantus/78a7ad58.speaker: c049-p_ephantus
c049-p_ephantus/78a7ad58.text: I haven't been to Lwang'ni since Friday. On Tuesday night I was delivering in town.

c049-p_ephantus/6117e15f.speaker: c049-p_ephantus
c049-p_ephantus/6117e15f.text: That woman lied about my fish.

c049-p_ephantus/5b1bab5c.speaker: c049-p_ephantus
c049-p_ephantus/5b1bab5c.text: She laughed. I left. She was counting money when I walked out.

c049-p_ephantus/a04f6609.speaker: c049-p_ephantus
c049-p_ephantus/a04f6609.text: ...I went to ask her to take back what she wrote. She laughed. I left. She was counting money.

c049-p_sylvia/05ad1c94.speaker: c049-p_sylvia
c049-p_sylvia/05ad1c94.text: Our boys fight every night. Roselyne and I drank tea together every morning. I was at my chama, I took the minutes. Here.

c049-p_lazarus/e4e679a7.speaker: c049-p_lazarus
c049-p_lazarus/e4e679a7.text: I left at ten with the others.

c049-p_lazarus/4c2c23bb.speaker: c049-p_lazarus
c049-p_lazarus/4c2c23bb.text: I took three thousand. She caught me and forgave me. She took it from my wages. I'd never touch her.

c049-p_hamisi/659ad26e.speaker: c049-p_hamisi
c049-p_hamisi/659ad26e.text: I closed the front at five past ten. She was counting the money.

c049-p_hamisi/149baefb.speaker: c049-p_hamisi
c049-p_hamisi/149baefb.text: He went with the other cooks, ten o'clock. Ask Everlyne next door, they share a tuk-tuk.

c049-p_norah/6618babe.speaker: c049-p_norah
c049-p_norah/6618babe.text: She brought me five fish. All five had been frozen.

c050-p_benedict/0abce16a.speaker: c050-p_benedict
c050-p_benedict/0abce16a.text: I repair boats. Lots of people's boats are in my yard.

c050-p_benedict/b3352a87.speaker: c050-p_benedict
c050-p_benedict/b3352a87.text: You keep looking for a man. Kivuli is a desk. ...I'll have a lawyer now.

c050-p_benedict/0f8a28f4.speaker: c050-p_benedict
c050-p_benedict/0f8a28f4.text: I was at my garage until midnight, then home. I've never been to Usoma.

c050-p_benedict/fbfe3c2c.speaker: c050-p_benedict
c050-p_benedict/fbfe3c2c.text: Benedict looks at the photograph of the white boat with the blue stripe and says nothing at all.

c050-p_kioko/81928ee5.speaker: c050-p_kioko
c050-p_kioko/81928ee5.text: Fundi was in the garage all night. I was there.

c050-p_kioko/a61c6744.speaker: c050-p_kioko
c050-p_kioko/a61c6744.text: I wasn't there. He told me to say it. I sleep at my mother's. He told me if anyone asks, he was at the garage.

c050-p_alloys/2054e623.speaker: c050-p_alloys
c050-p_alloys/2054e623.text: I was drinking in town. Ask the barman.

c050-p_alloys/d7978428.speaker: c050-p_alloys
c050-p_alloys/d7978428.text: We settled it. Walter even bought the first round.

c050-p_abiud/c1d5c855.speaker: c050-p_abiud
c050-p_abiud/c1d5c855.text: Everyone's saying 'the limping man'. Look at me.

c050-p_abiud/1c08f578.speaker: c050-p_abiud
c050-p_abiud/1c08f578.text: Everyone's saying 'the limping man'. Look at me. You think I could hold a man under water?

c050-p_livingstone/9cce801e.speaker: c050-p_livingstone
c050-p_livingstone/9cce801e.text: I took his statement. Then I told a stranger where his boat was. Write that down.

c050-p_livingstone/3f49b0a1.speaker: c050-p_livingstone
c050-p_livingstone/3f49b0a1.text: I told a caller where his boat was.

c050-p_lorna/2e64d0e1.speaker: c050-p_lorna
c050-p_lorna/2e64d0e1.text: Two paragraphs. I named him. I thought it would protect him.

c050-p_mary/d44ed2b2.speaker: c050-p_mary
c050-p_mary/d44ed2b2.text: He said a buyer was coming with cash. At night. To the boat.

pool-asian-f-any-2/7b3df7f1.speaker: pool-asian-f-any-2
pool-asian-f-any-2/7b3df7f1.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

pool-asian-f-any-2/2e918133.speaker: pool-asian-f-any-2
pool-asian-f-any-2/2e918133.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

pool-asian-f-any-2/3f213d60.speaker: pool-asian-f-any-2
pool-asian-f-any-2/3f213d60.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

pool-asian-m-any-3/48c57ba7.speaker: pool-asian-m-any-3
pool-asian-m-any-3/48c57ba7.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

pool-asian-m-any-3/49fcb891.speaker: pool-asian-m-any-3
pool-asian-m-any-3/49fcb891.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

pool-asian-m-any-3/a05c526a.speaker: pool-asian-m-any-3
pool-asian-m-any-3/a05c526a.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

rc-benedict-mbuvi/eea3c3fb.speaker: rc-benedict-mbuvi
rc-benedict-mbuvi/eea3c3fb.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

rc-benedict-mbuvi/a4cb13f5.speaker: rc-benedict-mbuvi
rc-benedict-mbuvi/a4cb13f5.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

rc-benedict-mbuvi/2ef919a6.speaker: rc-benedict-mbuvi
rc-benedict-mbuvi/2ef919a6.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

mwalimu/1bdd8301.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1bdd8301.text: Every fact has a time. Line them up and the gap will tell you.

mwalimu/084c19ad.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/084c19ad.text: Chai at 07:05. The 07:30 boat came in to an empty beach.

mwalimu/0054808f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0054808f.text: Read her pencil note in the stolen-engine book. She wrote a name.

mwalimu/db591b29.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/db591b29.text: His phone sat at Dunga until 07:29, and a boda rider took him away at 07:27.

mwalimu/45eab991.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/45eab991.text: Dr. Chebii measured the curve of the wounds.

mwalimu/b1075421.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b1075421.text: Curved blades, evenly spaced, and something with three blades in the water.

mwalimu/80d9e36a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/80d9e36a.text: Read the serial plate on Elisha's new engine. Then read it again in her book.

mwalimu/d7708dd0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d7708dd0.text: Same number. Stolen at Usenge. Police post, Monday, eight o'clock.

mwalimu/b951b787.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b951b787.text: Every fact has a time. You lined them up. Do it again tomorrow.

halima/7225ff3c.speaker: halima
halima/7225ff3c.text: Alive with her chai at 07:05, gone before the 07:30 boat. That's your window, and it's tight.

halima/bb8fa526.speaker: halima
halima/bb8fa526.text: She was buying chai at 07:05. Start there.

halima/a906ef79.speaker: halima
halima/a906ef79.text: She never missed a landing. Which one did she miss?

halima/1c11ee52.speaker: halima
halima/1c11ee52.text: His phone at Dunga until 07:29, a boda at 07:27, wet to the knees, and his mark on the propeller. That will hold.

halima/b5cfb272.speaker: halima
halima/b5cfb272.text: The chairman was signing in at the fisheries office at 06:55. Look again.

halima/e64fa925.speaker: halima
halima/e64fa925.text: That boat was on the lake until quarter past eight.

halima/24b1f68f.speaker: halima
halima/24b1f68f.text: Two curved blades, and the propeller that made them. Yes.

halima/45777948.speaker: halima
halima/45777948.text: Every engine on that rack is still chained. Read the wounds.

halima/f6dbffc2.speaker: halima
halima/f6dbffc2.text: Clean edges, no splinters. That isn't wood.

halima/5b0e5c5b.speaker: halima
halima/5b0e5c5b.text: A serial number and a police post at eight o'clock. That's the reason.

halima/a7ce0ecc.speaker: halima
halima/a7ce0ecc.text: That shortfall was corrected on Saturday, and it was the chairman's.

halima/982d4023.speaker: halima
halima/982d4023.text: His invoice was paid. Read her pencil note.

mwalimu/c2eeb343.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c2eeb343.text: One fact sets the earliest time. Another sets the latest. Find both.

mwalimu/df944c09.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/df944c09.text: A fee stamped at 11:10. A shutter down at 11:40.

mwalimu/fc414c87.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fc414c87.text: Read the tag on the sack by the counter. Who sent it back?

mwalimu/42e5609c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/42e5609c.text: The bus list says she arrived at eleven. She says she came at two.

mwalimu/8a2763fe.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8a2763fe.text: Look at the top of the stack, not the bottom.

mwalimu/3917addb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3917addb.text: Tears in the top sacks, and grip bruises on his wrists.

mwalimu/a10e6c6e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a10e6c6e.text: Cut the sack open. What's inside the sack?

mwalimu/85673ccb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/85673ccb.text: Expired sugar in a new bag, and a shop in Busia that lost everything.

mwalimu/44fe50b5.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/44fe50b5.text: Narrow it from both sides. Good.

halima/8720b62d.speaker: halima
halima/8720b62d.text: Laughing with the market master at ten past eleven, shutter down at twenty to twelve. That's the window.

halima/4b2f3c06.speaker: halima
halima/4b2f3c06.text: He paid his fee at 11:10. He was alive then.

halima/82781790.speaker: halima
halima/82781790.text: The shutter was down at 11:40 and nobody answered. Narrow it from that side too.

halima/b5ff86b7.speaker: halima
halima/b5ff86b7.text: In Kisumu from eleven, in his store at quarter past, and her prints in the grease of that hook. Charge her.

halima/88bdadf5.speaker: halima
halima/88bdadf5.text: The helper was getting signatures in Manyatta. Look again.

halima/8a87e73c.speaker: halima
halima/8a87e73c.text: Yusuf was weighing sugar for customers all morning. Who came from Busia?

halima/5ca88127.speaker: halima
halima/5ca88127.text: Torn sacks at the top, grip marks on his wrists, and a hook in her bag. It didn't fall. Yes.

halima/0b8a12e4.speaker: halima
halima/0b8a12e4.text: Sacks don't tear themselves at the top. Read the stack again.

halima/3a3832d3.speaker: halima
halima/3a3832d3.text: Crush asphyxia. Nothing hit his head.

halima/aa5a45d2.speaker: halima
halima/aa5a45d2.text: Charge her. And Amani: make sure Diana gets the back room. Somebody has to answer for that sugar too.

halima/1960ae34.speaker: halima
halima/1960ae34.text: She paid him in full. Read her receipt.

halima/0348a2fd.speaker: halima
halima/0348a2fd.text: She has no stall here. What did she lose?

mwalimu/408fef4f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/408fef4f.text: What was on the radio at nine o'clock on a Thursday?

mwalimu/0cac5de9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0cac5de9.text: The quarrel is in the script. The autopsy says he died hours before it.

mwalimu/c5cad7eb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c5cad7eb.text: Everyone saw him at the jetty at nine. When did he get there?

mwalimu/8ecce916.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8ecce916.text: At the jetty from 20:40. At the back gate at 19:45. Fifty minutes apart.

mwalimu/981a2d20.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/981a2d20.text: One blow from above. What on that shelf is heavy enough?

mwalimu/186ff242.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/186ff242.text: A flat-edged blow, and a battery on the floor out of its place.

mwalimu/c5a70dd0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c5a70dd0.text: Read the letters in the drawer, and the note folded with them.

mwalimu/01aabcfb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/01aabcfb.text: Two agencies, twelve years, one letter. "You stole my bread."

mwalimu/7e0dd0be.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7e0dd0be.text: An alibi for the wrong hour is still an alibi. Until it isn't.

halima/18ce5704.speaker: halima
halima/18ce5704.text: He built an alibi for a murder that happened on the radio.

halima/f9baacb7.speaker: halima
halima/f9baacb7.text: Nine o'clock is when the play was on. When did his agency go quiet?

halima/da29652f.speaker: halima

c051-p_musyoki/76f9cc12.text: She was counting. She was fine when I left.

c051-p_musyoki/251b74e4.speaker: c051-p_musyoki
c051-p_musyoki/251b74e4.text: ...I stayed to load the fan. She was counting. She was fine when I left.

c051-p_simon/caacb7e2.speaker: c051-p_simon
c051-p_simon/caacb7e2.text: Both vehicles left together at 06:20. That's the rule.

c051-p_simon/e340e21b.speaker: c051-p_simon
c051-p_simon/e340e21b.text: I went ahead. We're not supposed to. The breakfast was late. Musyoki stayed behind.

c051-p_graham/203772fc.speaker: c051-p_graham
c051-p_graham/203772fc.text: I fly. The ground is the crew's business.

c051-p_graham/fe530f11.speaker: c051-p_graham
c051-p_graham/fe530f11.text: She said the wind was marginal. She was right. I was lucky. It's in my log; read it.

c051-p_graham/c029403b.speaker: c051-p_graham
c051-p_graham/c029403b.text: I was flying twelve guests over the Mara.

c051-p_zablon/6342f15b.speaker: c051-p_zablon
c051-p_zablon/6342f15b.text: I bought gas from Musyoki. I didn't ask where from.

c051-p_zablon/47f65d7b.speaker: c051-p_zablon
c051-p_zablon/47f65d7b.text: I never met her. I opened the store at half past six this morning. Kerubo opens the kitchen with me every day.

c051-p_nkirote/ffa1437a.speaker: c051-p_nkirote
c051-p_nkirote/ffa1437a.text: She called at twenty-five past six. Then nothing.

c052-p_lucia/8c09e23e.speaker: c052-p_lucia
c052-p_lucia/8c09e23e.text: Poor Richard. He walked that track at night like a young man. He never came here last night. I was asleep by nine.

c052-p_lucia/dce0a518.speaker: c052-p_lucia
c052-p_lucia/dce0a518.text: Yes, he bought my debt. Business. I would have found the money.

c052-p_lucia/dbd02d2f.speaker: c052-p_lucia
c052-p_lucia/dbd02d2f.text: Richard never came here last night. I was asleep by nine.

c052-p_lucia/3b0c293c.speaker: c052-p_lucia
c052-p_lucia/3b0c293c.text: He was standing on the deck when I went in.

c052-p_lucia/b735a299.speaker: c052-p_lucia
c052-p_lucia/b735a299.text: ...He came. He told me my camp was his now. I told him to leave. He was standing on the deck when I went in.

c052-p_lekishon/af7ba663.speaker: c052-p_lekishon
c052-p_lekishon/af7ba663.text: Ask Josephine. I sat by her fire all night. She brought me tea.

c052-p_lekishon/9672eaf7.speaker: c052-p_lekishon
c052-p_lekishon/9672eaf7.text: No visitors came to the camp last night.

c052-p_lekishon/90244796.speaker: c052-p_lekishon
c052-p_lekishon/90244796.text: Mr Richard came along the river path at quarter past nine. Mama told me in the morning to say no one came. She said it would save trouble for the camp.

c052-p_kipchumba/ad93204d.speaker: c052-p_kipchumba
c052-p_kipchumba/ad93204d.text: He fired me. That's all I'll say.

c052-p_kipchumba/0a10d332.speaker: c052-p_kipchumba
c052-p_kipchumba/0a10d332.text: He was going to take Mama Lucia's camp? ...I was in Narok. Here, I'll send you the hotel bill.

c052-p_mumbi/3ffad105.speaker: c052-p_mumbi
c052-p_mumbi/3ffad105.text: He said back in an hour. I thought he'd stayed for a whisky.

c052-p_olekina/b33d9ca5.speaker: c052-p_olekina
c052-p_olekina/b33d9ca5.text: I called it in at twenty to nine.

c052-p_olekina/e4fb58fb.speaker: c052-p_olekina
c052-p_olekina/e4fb58fb.text: Crocodiles take what the river brings. This one came from upstream. The water is slow; he floated.

c053-p_gitonga/ca5464d3.speaker: c053-p_gitonga
c053-p_gitonga/ca5464d3.text: Nashipae! Ten years I have bought their work. I closed at seven and drove to Narok.

c053-p_gitonga/f83c066c.speaker: c053-p_gitonga
c053-p_gitonga/f83c066c.text: That is the market. I take the risk; I carry the stock. They could not reach Nairobi without me.

c053-p_gitonga/d0227593.speaker: c053-p_gitonga
c053-p_gitonga/d0227593.text: I closed my shop at seven and drove to Narok.

c053-p_gitonga/0e0eb9d1.speaker: c053-p_gitonga
c053-p_gitonga/0e0eb9d1.text: I've supported those women for ten years.

c053-p_gitonga/d7702e15.speaker: c053-p_gitonga
c053-p_gitonga/d7702e15.text: Business is business. I left her packing.

c053-p_gitonga/3b94eb51.speaker: c053-p_gitonga
c053-p_gitonga/3b94eb51.text: ...I went to talk to her. Business is business. I left her packing.

c053-p_elvis/4e1d3945.speaker: c053-p_elvis
c053-p_elvis/4e1d3945.text: Boss left for Narok at seven.

c053-p_elvis/965b3a53.speaker: c053-p_elvis
c053-p_elvis/965b3a53.text: He left at ten. He came back from the co-op at nine, sweeping his pickup. He told me what to say.

c053-p_seenoi/7d1486e8.speaker: c053-p_seenoi
c053-p_seenoi/7d1486e8.text: We argued, yes. Then we voted, and I lost, and that was the end of it. Ask my mother-in-law where I was.

c053-p_nasieku/35397104.speaker: c053-p_nasieku
c053-p_nasieku/35397104.text: This colour. Look at this colour.

c053-p_nasieku/46f6e8a8.speaker: c053-p_nasieku
c053-p_nasieku/46f6e8a8.text: We trusted him. We had nobody else to sell to.

c053-p_moseka/8b10f894.speaker: c053-p_moseka
c053-p_moseka/8b10f894.text: I saw her from the bridge at half past six. I called the post.

c054-p_ndwiga/78a87476.speaker: c054-p_ndwiga
c054-p_ndwiga/78a87476.text: My lorry was in my yard all night. I never drove that road.

c054-p_ndwiga/7d91d0a2.speaker: c054-p_ndwiga
c054-p_ndwiga/7d91d0a2.text: A ranger writes many things. Ask him what he meant.

c054-p_ndwiga/3249006b.speaker: c054-p_ndwiga
c054-p_ndwiga/3249006b.text: My lorry was in my Narok yard all night. I never drove that road.

c054-p_ndwiga/e2d9c299.speaker: c054-p_ndwiga
c054-p_ndwiga/e2d9c299.text: The corporal waved us through. He was alive at the boom when we drove on.

c054-p_ndwiga/15f80865.speaker: c054-p_ndwiga
c054-p_ndwiga/15f80865.text: ...We passed the checkpoint. The corporal waved us through.

c054-p_daudi/537b3f60.speaker: c054-p_daudi
c054-p_daudi/537b3f60.text: We didn't go out last night.

c054-p_daudi/613059ab.speaker: c054-p_daudi
c054-p_daudi/613059ab.text: He found the tusks. The boss offered him money. He said no and picked up his radio. The boss hit him. We put him in the lorry. I drove where he told me. I've vomited every hour since.

c054-p_faith/f7dcb0eb.speaker: c054-p_faith
c054-p_faith/f7dcb0eb.text: I was at the north post all night.

c054-p_faith/26d47f15.speaker: c054-p_faith
c054-p_faith/26d47f15.text: We fought about the roster. He was the best of us.

c054-p_kimathi/41b30a13.speaker: c054-p_kimathi
c054-p_kimathi/41b30a13.text: I was asleep in the cab. I can't even open the door from inside.

c054-p_kimathi/e497cbb2.speaker: c054-p_kimathi
c054-p_kimathi/e497cbb2.text: I'm not allowed to touch the third row. Never. Take my fingerprints. Take Daudi's too.

c054-p_kimathi/412b0214.speaker: c054-p_kimathi
c054-p_kimathi/412b0214.text: I was asleep in the cab.

c055-p_fiona/eaad15bb.speaker: c055-p_fiona
c055-p_fiona/eaad15bb.text: I flew in from Nairobi this morning at half past seven. Linda was overworked. Her heart, probably.

c055-p_fiona/073a2114.speaker: c055-p_fiona
c055-p_fiona/073a2114.text: Paperwork errors happen. We would have sorted it out with the authority.

c055-p_fiona/251966fa.speaker: c055-p_fiona
c055-p_fiona/251966fa.text: I flew in from Nairobi this morning at half past seven.

c055-p_fiona/731e26c6.speaker: c055-p_fiona
c055-p_fiona/731e26c6.text: Linda was overworked. Her heart, probably.

c055-p_fiona/d7fa4a1c.speaker: c055-p_fiona
c055-p_fiona/d7fa4a1c.text: I didn't see Linda all night.

c055-p_fiona/9fcd555b.speaker: c055-p_fiona
c055-p_fiona/9fcd555b.text: ...I came in last night. I slept in the owner's room. I didn't want the staff to know I was checking on them. I didn't see Linda.

c055-p_saruni/dc3034f5.speaker: c055-p_saruni
c055-p_saruni/dc3034f5.text: Nobody came to the aircraft all night. They were locked.

c055-p_saruni/a3feea52.speaker: c055-p_saruni
c055-p_saruni/a3feea52.text: Nobody came to the aircraft all night.

c055-p_saruni/3492a089.speaker: c055-p_saruni
c055-p_saruni/3492a089.text: I slept in the shelter. I heard a car about half past five. And the boss's plane was here since Monday evening. She told me not to tell the pilots. I was afraid to say I was asleep.

c055-p_rodgers/57bfdfdc.speaker: c055-p_rodgers
c055-p_rodgers/57bfdfdc.text: She grounded MSK? Good for her. I wanted her job. I'd have got it in two years. I didn't need it today. My hotel will confirm I was there.

c055-p_silvanus/7ac2ad93.speaker: c055-p_silvanus
c055-p_silvanus/7ac2ad93.text: She wouldn't fly MSK. She told me on Thursday.

c055-p_silvanus/365503e1.speaker: c055-p_silvanus
c055-p_silvanus/365503e1.text: Paid? Every hour, every month. Fiona is many things; she pays.

c055-p_silvanus/6c21c223.speaker: c055-p_silvanus
c055-p_silvanus/6c21c223.text: C. Ndegwa? I rang him myself on Friday. He was in South Africa all January. He'll tell you.

c056-p_lenku/25709d0c.speaker: c056-p_lenku
c056-p_lenku/25709d0c.text: I was in Talek all evening. I never saw Kinuthia's car.

c056-p_lenku/6052fb66.speaker: c056-p_lenku
c056-p_lenku/6052fb66.text: A camera? It was his own. He waved it at me and said, "Now you're a thief." Because I read the receipts.

c056-p_lenku/c26d991d.speaker: c056-p_lenku
c056-p_lenku/c26d991d.text: I came home at half past eight. He was lying in the boma. Grandfather was sitting by the fire, very quiet. I drove the car to the road so they would think robbers. I couldn't let them take him.

c056-p_mzee/436cbd4a.speaker: c056-p_mzee
c056-p_mzee/436cbd4a.text: I didn't see that man after the visitors left.

c056-p_mzee/bd684fd6.speaker: c056-p_mzee
c056-p_mzee/bd684fd6.text: He said my grandson would go to prison for his lie. I am old. Let them take me, not the boy.

c056-p_mohamed/d1f78038.speaker: c056-p_mohamed
c056-p_mohamed/d1f78038.text: Kinuthia and I compete. That's all.

c056-p_mohamed/63148fa4.speaker: c056-p_mohamed
c056-p_mohamed/63148fa4.text: Three thousand, and he paid them five hundred? Everyone knew he cheated the villages. Nobody could prove it. I was in Narok; ask the hotel.

c056-p_ruth/ce2f2c3d.speaker: c056-p_ruth
c056-p_ruth/ce2f2c3d.text: We argued about prices. I left at half five.

c056-p_naipanoi/df71314f.speaker: c056-p_naipanoi
c056-p_naipanoi/df71314f.text: Every visitor. Every shilling. Count them.

c057-p_kipkorir/84735fcc.speaker: c057-p_kipkorir
c057-p_kipkorir/84735fcc.text: I left the market at two o'clock and went home. Abdirizak owed me cattle.

c057-p_kipkorir/98d9c468.speaker: c057-p_kipkorir
c057-p_kipkorir/98d9c468.text: Nelson sees everything. ...Here. Take it. It's in the sack.

c057-p_kipkorir/788be6b9.speaker: c057-p_kipkorir
c057-p_kipkorir/788be6b9.text: I left the market at two o'clock and went home.

c057-p_kipkorir/bb725342.speaker: c057-p_kipkorir
c057-p_kipkorir/bb725342.text: Forty head. My whole life. He laughed. He told me to go to court. I'm sixty-seven, Detective. I haven't got time for court.

c057-p_nancy/94c8c40b.speaker: c057-p_nancy
c057-p_nancy/94c8c40b.text: My back room was locked all afternoon.

c057-p_nancy/b235dcc2.speaker: c057-p_nancy
c057-p_nancy/b235dcc2.text: Ask Mzee Kasaine. He sits in that corner from noon. I never left the kettle.

c057-p_nancy/eeea410b.speaker: c057-p_nancy
c057-p_nancy/eeea410b.text: I rented it to them for five hundred. I'm not licensed to rent rooms. I was afraid.

c057-p_omar/ca2984e6.speaker: c057-p_omar
c057-p_omar/ca2984e6.text: Forty head from Kajiado? He told me he'd sold cattle from Kajiado. We have no cattle in Kajiado. ...We fought about a lorry, yes. Lorries, not this. Read my manifests.

c057-p_joan/2d87abc1.speaker: c057-p_joan
c057-p_joan/2d87abc1.text: Look at the spelling. Then look at the border.

c057-p_nelson/4cef7bae.speaker: c057-p_nelson
c057-p_nelson/4cef7bae.text: Half past four. Old Kipkorir and the Somali trader, into Nancy's back room.

c058-p_faisal/9f6319ad.speaker: c058-p_faisal
c058-p_faisal/9f6319ad.text: She was alive in the vehicle. She walked into our tent. She went to bed at half past ten and I read until midnight.

c058-p_faisal/0a685d34.speaker: c058-p_faisal
c058-p_faisal/0a685d34.text: The divorce? A misunderstanding. We would have sorted it out. We always did.

c058-p_faisal/d658a8af.speaker: c058-p_faisal
c058-p_faisal/d658a8af.text: She was alive in the vehicle. She walked into our tent, went to bed at half past ten, and I read until midnight.

c058-p_faisal/09fa9f2f.speaker: c058-p_faisal
c058-p_faisal/09fa9f2f.text: She was tired. I carried her. She was asleep.

c058-p_faisal/c24de1db.speaker: c058-p_faisal
c058-p_faisal/c24de1db.text: ...She was tired. I carried her. She was asleep.

c058-p_sylvester/3e44ef22.speaker: c058-p_sylvester
c058-p_sylvester/3e44ef22.text: Every guest was escorted to their tent and walked in on their own feet.

c058-p_sylvester/c23e65ec.speaker: c058-p_sylvester
c058-p_sylvester/c23e65ec.text: I didn't check. If the conservancy hears guests walk around without escort, we lose our licence.

c058-p_mwanakombo/a8a01c63.speaker: c058-p_mwanakombo
c058-p_mwanakombo/a8a01c63.text: She fired me yesterday. I'm going home.

c058-p_mwanakombo/ce7f8449.speaker: c058-p_mwanakombo
c058-p_mwanakombo/ce7f8449.text: Look at the photos; I'm in all of them. She fired me every month. She always rehired me.

c058-p_mwanakombo/9821da4c.speaker: c058-p_mwanakombo
c058-p_mwanakombo/9821da4c.text: I was at the table the whole time.

c058-p_kakuta/f04a8c1a.speaker: c058-p_kakuta
c058-p_kakuta/f04a8c1a.text: I drove them back. I'll tell you about the bump.

c059-p_robert/2846446f.speaker: c059-p_robert
c059-p_robert/2846446f.text: At three I was at Musiara marsh watching a cheetah hunt. I called it on the radio. Ask anyone.

c059-p_robert/f491e355.speaker: c059-p_robert
c059-p_robert/f491e355.text: A committee of jealous guides. My drivers find the cats. That's why guests pay us.

c059-p_robert/c43f0327.speaker: c059-p_robert
c059-p_robert/c43f0327.text: I may have been on my way. Signals bounce.

c059-p_robert/068d7d03.speaker: c059-p_robert
c059-p_robert/068d7d03.text: Nickson is lying to save himself. I never touched that brace.

c059-p_nickson/66a32b7e.speaker: c059-p_nickson
c059-p_nickson/66a32b7e.text: We were at Musiara all afternoon.

c059-p_nickson/222e93f9.speaker: c059-p_nickson
c059-p_nickson/222e93f9.text: We were at Musiara all afternoon watching the cheetahs.

c059-p_nickson/9398f559.speaker: c059-p_nickson
c059-p_nickson/9398f559.text: We were at the lugga. Mr Robert hit him with the brace. He told me to let the tyre down and set the jack. I did it. I'll say it in court.

c059-p_tobiko/19f105ad.speaker: c059-p_tobiko
c059-p_tobiko/19f105ad.text: I was at lunch with clients.

c059-p_tobiko/2fcb17ed.speaker: c059-p_tobiko
c059-p_tobiko/2fcb17ed.text: Leshan beat me fairly. He was stubborn about cheetahs. He was right.

c059-p_nashilu/d9312a8b.speaker: c059-p_nashilu
c059-p_nashilu/d9312a8b.text: East. West. The hills in between. Nothing crosses.

c060-p_doreen/252d7a9a.speaker: c060-p_doreen
c060-p_doreen/252d7a9a.text: I was in my Narok office all Friday evening, working late. And every transfer was explained to my clients. They signed willingly.

c060-p_doreen/7c1dcce4.speaker: c060-p_doreen
c060-p_doreen/7c1dcce4.text: Salaton was a good man with a temper. He saw a search and assumed the worst.

c060-p_doreen/857ebdee.speaker: c060-p_doreen
c060-p_doreen/857ebdee.text: I was in my Narok office all Friday evening, working late.

c060-p_doreen/5cbbbf38.speaker: c060-p_doreen
c060-p_doreen/5cbbbf38.text: Every transfer was explained to my clients. They signed willingly.

c060-p_doreen/6930262e.speaker: c060-p_doreen
c060-p_doreen/6930262e.text: I took nothing from that room.

c060-p_doreen/1665a679.speaker: c060-p_doreen
c060-p_doreen/1665a679.text: I went to HQ to explain the transfers. Salaton was emotional. He had the originals out in the archive. I left him there.

c060-p_doreen/1694617f.speaker: c060-p_doreen
c060-p_doreen/1694617f.text: They trusted me to read it to them,

c060-p_isaiah/f44888f5.speaker: c060-p_isaiah
c060-p_isaiah/f44888f5.text: I drove Madam home at seven.

c060-p_isaiah/0e7fac47.speaker: c060-p_isaiah
c060-p_isaiah/0e7fac47.text: I drove her to Enkare. I waited in the car. She came out with two file boxes and said drive. In Narok she locked them in the safe. I didn't ask. Madam doesn't like questions.

c060-p_tipape/c60402c4.speaker: c060-p_tipape
c060-p_tipape/c60402c4.text: I was at my nephew's wedding. Ask the whole of Ololulung'a.

c060-p_tipape/88f11fdb.speaker: c060-p_tipape
c060-p_tipape/88f11fdb.text: He reads the search twice, then sits down on the ground. "She told us it was an advance on the lease. She read it to us. Did she read it wrong?

c060-p_tipape/900edf15.speaker: c060-p_tipape
c060-p_tipape/900edf15.text: I was at my nephew's wedding.

c060-p_hugo/8d5914e2.speaker: c060-p_hugo
c060-p_hugo/8d5914e2.text: He is quiet for a long time. "I wanted the lodge concession. I didn't want it like this.

c060-p_lornah/519a8893.speaker: c060-p_lornah
c060-p_lornah/519a8893.text: Salaton told me to hold the 60 payments.

c060-p_jedidah/ae1ffe2d.speaker: c060-p_jedidah
c060-p_jedidah/ae1ffe2d.text: Every one. I wrote her name sixty times.

pool-european-m-any-2/a0aa8219.speaker: pool-european-m-any-2
pool-european-m-any-2/a0aa8219.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

pool-european-m-any-2/0dbe27bb.speaker: pool-european-m-any-2
pool-european-m-any-2/0dbe27bb.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

pool-european-m-any-2/26594e48.speaker: pool-european-m-any-2
pool-european-m-any-2/26594e48.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

pool-european-f-any-2/3332fbd0.speaker: pool-european-f-any-2
pool-european-f-any-2/3332fbd0.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

pool-european-f-any-2/343b4036.speaker: pool-european-f-any-2
pool-european-f-any-2/343b4036.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

pool-european-f-any-2/6b61c62f.speaker: pool-european-f-any-2
pool-european-f-any-2/6b61c62f.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

mwalimu/48a49f0a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/48a49f0a.text: The base logs every call. When did she last speak, and when did vehicle 2 move?

mwalimu/47a2223d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/47a2223d.text: A call at 06:25. A vehicle that sat still until 06:52.

mwalimu/c5c1c487.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c5c1c487.text: Compare the ground where she was found with what's on her boots.

mwalimu/fb8e17cb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fb8e17cb.text: Black clay and long-grass seeds, on a plain of red soil and short grass.

mwalimu/1f83cc92.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1f83cc92.text: Two chase vehicles. One left at 06:20. Where was the other?

mwalimu/4bea000a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4bea000a.text: Vehicle 2 sat at the launch site until 06:52, and its driver is paid weekly by a Talek store.

mwalimu/64a626f1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/64a626f1.text: Dr. Chebii describes the jaw of the tool. What on a balloon crew has a hexagonal jaw?

mwalimu/3acec56d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3acec56d.text: One blow, a hexagonal jaw, and a washed valve wrench in vehicle 2.

mwalimu/b8b11705.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b8b11705.text: Where did her count stop? Read the margin.

mwalimu/ce845ff9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ce845ff9.text: Three tags missing, and three cylinders with filed tags in a Talek store.

mwalimu/d9cf166f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d9cf166f.text: Ground remembers where you stood. Even when the sky doesn't.

halima/f9ac6bb6.speaker: halima
halima/f9ac6bb6.text: Lift-off, her last call at twenty-five past, dead before vehicle 2 moved at 06:52, "found" at 07:35. That's the morning.

halima/2410ceb2.speaker: halima
halima/2410ceb2.text: 20 past 7 is the landing. She never reached it alive.

halima/b7661239.speaker: halima
halima/b7661239.text: She was on the radio at 06:25. Start there.

halima/b1fb0a78.speaker: halima
halima/b1fb0a78.text: Black clay on her boots, curled up somewhere before she was laid flat, and her last call from the launch site. She died where she was counting.

halima/fb7d7d13.speaker: halima
halima/fb7d7d13.text: The landing site is red soil and short grass. Look at her boots.

halima/1e3a4311.speaker: halima
halima/1e3a4311.text: Vehicle 2 didn't move until 06:52. Where was it?

halima/01144ef0.speaker: halima
halima/01144ef0.text: His vehicle sat at the launch site for thirty-two minutes after he says he left, his wrench carries her blood, and his name is on the store's receipts. That will hold.

halima/1b091faf.speaker: halima
halima/1b091faf.text: The pilot was in the air with twelve witnesses.

halima/32c1c14e.speaker: halima
halima/32c1c14e.text: Simon broke the rule and went ahead. Who stayed behind?

halima/5d725a96.speaker: halima
halima/5d725a96.text: A hexagonal jaw, one blow. Yes.

halima/67bc9a38.speaker: halima
halima/67bc9a38.text: No crush injuries. The basket never touched her.

halima/89e8a1f2.speaker: halima
halima/89e8a1f2.text: One blow from a tool with a hexagonal jaw. What opens a gas cylinder?

halima/5e488736.speaker: halima
halima/5e488736.text: Three tags missing and a weekly receipt from Talek. That's the reason.

halima/d16cabc9.speaker: halima
halima/d16cabc9.text: The wind argument was the pilot's, and he was flying.

halima/b2bc0b10.speaker: halima
halima/b2bc0b10.text: He never applied for her job.

mwalimu/ff237b17.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ff237b17.text: His phone went into the river with him. When did it stop?

mwalimu/90cbbac4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/90cbbac4.text: Out of his camp at 21:00. His phone at Mara Bend from 21:12 until 21:50.

mwalimu/5f3805de.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5f3805de.text: What's inside his shoes? The river leaves different sand in different places.

mwalimu/2d3ee610.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2d3ee610.text: Pool silt in his shoes, and a railing post replaced overnight above that pool.

mwalimu/1683ecd6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1683ecd6.text: The gate book is empty, but the river path doesn't pass the gate. Ask the askari again.

mwalimu/9fd02eb7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9fd02eb7.text: "Mama told me to say no one came." And then she admits he did.

mwalimu/352e5a17.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/352e5a17.text: Dr. Chebii found something in the wound that isn't from a crocodile.

mwalimu/ed7fd6c7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ed7fd6c7.text: Mvule splinters, and a cracked mvule post under a tarpaulin.

mwalimu/a261b341.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a261b341.text: Read the letter in Richard's out-tray.

mwalimu/d65f29cf.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d65f29cf.text: He bought her debt. "My camp was his now."

mwalimu/11c2bc77.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/11c2bc77.text: The river takes things. It also puts them down again.

halima/634a6b49.speaker: halima
halima/634a6b49.text: Out of his camp at nine, on her deck at quarter past, his phone in the river by ten to ten, found at twenty to nine. That's the night.

halima/aa835acd.speaker: halima
halima/aa835acd.text: Six o'clock is the gates opening. He was dead long before.

halima/daff4e91.speaker: halima
halima/daff4e91.text: Grey silt from a still pool in his shoes, a fresh post on the railing, and the old one hidden in her workshop. He died on the deck.

halima/04c2eaae.speaker: halima
halima/04c2eaae.text: Crossing point 2 is coarse yellow sand. Read his shoes.

halima/4f7f3cde.speaker: halima
halima/4f7f3cde.text: His phone sat at Mara Bend for forty minutes. He didn't die on the track.

halima/4b1d3cf1.speaker: halima
halima/4b1d3cf1.text: She told her askari to lie, she was on the deck with him, and the post with his blood was under her tarpaulin. That will hold.

halima/fc841b2f.speaker: halima
halima/fc841b2f.text: The askari lied because she told him to. Who told him?

halima/452caa35.speaker: halima
halima/452caa35.text: The bar manager was drinking in Narok until one.

halima/fd1d9e7d.speaker: halima
halima/fd1d9e7d.text: Mvule splinters in the wound and a railing post that went missing overnight. Yes.

halima/e3602396.speaker: halima
halima/e3602396.text: No water in his lungs, and the crocodiles came after death.

halima/2129d6bc.speaker: halima
halima/2129d6bc.text: He bought her debt and came to take her camp. That's the reason.

halima/bb0e1b0c.speaker: halima
halima/bb0e1b0c.text: That's the bar manager's grudge, and he was in Narok.

halima/36a099e5.speaker: halima
halima/36a099e5.text: Read the letter. It says exactly what he wanted.

mwalimu/17b36236.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/17b36236.text: When did the meeting end, and when did his phone leave Talek?

mwalimu/a01aaaed.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a01aaaed.text: Meeting over at 19:30. His phone in Talek until 21:40.

mwalimu/666cdd8e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/666cdd8e.text: Sort the beads in her hair by colour. Which colour exists nowhere else in town?

mwalimu/3e8fef5a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3e8fef5a.text: Enkiteng blue is the co-op's alone, and a turquoise jar is missing from its row.

mwalimu/a4e85b0a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a4e85b0a.text: Read the catalogue printout in her bag. Whose shop is named on it?

mwalimu/624925e7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/624925e7.text: His phone stayed in Talek. His assistant saw him sweep his pickup at nine.

mwalimu/d8af0349.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d8af0349.text: What did Dr. Chebii find in the wound?

mwalimu/b26cd799.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b26cd799.text: Glass, the same thick glass as the shard under the co-op table.

mwalimu/3a8093a4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3a8093a4.text: Compare the two prices: what he paid, and what the catalogue charges.

mwalimu/f31450f7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f31450f7.text: KSh 300 in, KSh 1,500 out, and a contract that went around him.

halima/839046a6.speaker: halima
halima/839046a6.text: Meeting over at half seven, dead before half nine, his phone on the Narok road at ten, found at half six. That's the night.

halima/63f1e18b.speaker: halima
halima/63f1e18b.text: Seven o'clock is his story. His phone says otherwise.

halima/2e2f5f5a.speaker: halima
halima/2e2f5f5a.text: She stayed after the meeting to pack. When did the meeting end?

halima/3755d678.speaker: halima
halima/3755d678.text: Enkiteng blue in her hair, a missing jar, a shard under the table. She died among the beads.

halima/8197e998.speaker: halima
halima/8197e998.text: No struggle in the sand and no fall injuries. The river bed is where she was left.

halima/2ed52b6a.speaker: halima
halima/2ed52b6a.text: Which colour is in her hair, and who owns it?

halima/ee96f7cf.speaker: halima
halima/ee96f7cf.text: In Talek until 21:40, at the store by his own account, and the co-op's colour in his pickup bed. That will hold.

halima/8373adaa.speaker: halima
halima/8373adaa.text: The assistant was selling from the till every twenty minutes.

halima/329c34c7.speaker: halima
halima/329c34c7.text: Seenoi lost a vote, and went home to milk.

halima/20ac241d.speaker: halima
halima/20ac241d.text: Glass in the wound, the same glass as the shard. Yes.

halima/694793a8.speaker: halima
halima/694793a8.text: Her bag and cash weren't touched. No robbers.

halima/0064de56.speaker: halima
halima/0064de56.text: Three hundred shillings in, fifteen hundred out, and a contract that ended it. That's the reason.

halima/d58c9cb9.speaker: halima
halima/d58c9cb9.text: The flyer is on the wall for everyone. What's in her bag?

mwalimu/efed4ab1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/efed4ab1.text: His patrol device reported every five minutes. When did it stop?

mwalimu/c78c62ee.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c78c62ee.text: Where were the lions while he was dying?

mwalimu/65b4dfed.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/65b4dfed.text: The lions 9 km away until 04:05; his device at the checkpoint until 22:41.

mwalimu/7adf76a8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7adf76a8.text: He wrote a name before he stopped writing.

mwalimu/2fc4b908.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2fc4b908.text: A phone at the checkpoint and then in the reserve, and dual tyres at the kill.

mwalimu/f55be739.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f55be739.text: Dr. Chebii says two blows with a metal bar. What heavy bar does a lorry carry?

mwalimu/0c21c699.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0c21c699.text: Two bar blows, and his blood on the jack handle.

mwalimu/c64bfdf5.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c64bfdf5.text: Something pale is caught in that scrap of cement sack.

mwalimu/84bdec7e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/84bdec7e.text: Elephant ivory on the hut floor and in the sack seams.

mwalimu/d1300e17.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d1300e17.text: A collar records everything. So does a ranger, if you ask him properly.

halima/fbb7b906.speaker: halima
halima/fbb7b906.text: Stopped at half ten, dark at 22:41, the lorry in the reserve by twenty to midnight, the lions at five past four. The lions came last.

halima/02766718.speaker: halima
halima/02766718.text: Seven o'clock is when they found him.

halima/f4c97318.speaker: halima
halima/f4c97318.text: The lions reached the kill at 04:05. He was long dead.

halima/ee5956aa.speaker: halima
halima/ee5956aa.text: An unfinished line in the logbook, a device that never left the checkpoint until it died, and ivory on the hut floor. He died at his post.

halima/04b7dbbe.speaker: halima
halima/04b7dbbe.text: The lions were 9 km away and the tracks at the kill are a lorry's.

halima/6465c538.speaker: halima
halima/6465c538.text: His device sat at the checkpoint until 22:41.

halima/ccd6f404.speaker: halima
halima/ccd6f404.text: His lorry at the boom, his phone in the reserve, the corporal's blood on the jack handle and his prints on its grip. That will hold.

halima/cf64cf70.speaker: halima
halima/cf64cf70.text: The driver helped and drove. Whose prints are on the handle?

halima/2770fcc4.speaker: halima
halima/2770fcc4.text: Faith checked in every hour from the north post.

halima/e767dec8.speaker: halima
halima/e767dec8.text: Two blows with a bar, then a zebra for an alibi. Yes.

halima/87508037.speaker: halima
halima/87508037.text: No lion wounds made while he was alive.

halima/b57de6a0.speaker: halima
halima/b57de6a0.text: No gunshot. Two blows with a metal bar.

halima/1b4fbd54.speaker: halima
halima/1b4fbd54.text: Ivory in the cement and half a million refused. That's the reason. Rangers will be at the reconstruction in full uniform.

halima/32df74de.speaker: halima
halima/32df74de.text: The roster was settled on Monday.

halima/9bc6c783.speaker: halima
halima/9bc6c783.text: The post paid for its cement.

mwalimu/b897a02a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b897a02a.text: Machines count. How many hours would a Nairobi round trip add to that meter?

mwalimu/f2236ad1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f2236ad1.text: Landed at Enkare at 18:10 the night before. +0.8, not +1.6.

mwalimu/d3d3dae9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d3d3dae9.text: Look at what she didn't do in that cockpit.

mwalimu/a3b1172e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a3b1172e.text: Saving a report at the cottage at 22:47, then lying flat for hours.

mwalimu/a6afe9ab.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a6afe9ab.text: Who says they flew in this morning? Read the flight plans for last night.

mwalimu/2fb9a7be.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2fb9a7be.text: She slept at the cottage, and the cushion in the company car carries Linda's fibres.

mwalimu/587c6b92.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/587c6b92.text: Dr. Chebii found something in her eyes and her airway.

mwalimu/e19daaaf.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e19daaaf.text: Smothered, and a sofa missing a cushion.

mwalimu/a7bc9b22.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a7bc9b22.text: Read what Linda wrote across the January inspection, in red.

mwalimu/12b0591e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/12b0591e.text: "FALSE": the inspector was in South Africa all January.

mwalimu/1f953e41.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1f953e41.text: An engine counts its hours. So should you.

halima/10fcf2b2.speaker: halima
halima/10fcf2b2.text: Fiona in at ten past six the evening before, Linda writing at 22:47, dead before one, carried out at twenty past five, and a forty-minute "flight from Nairobi". The meters don't lie.

halima/1fef8af9.speaker: halima
halima/1fef8af9.text: 06:00 is when Linda would have started her checklist. She never did.

halima/f656d436.speaker: halima
halima/f656d436.text: Her "arrival" is the last thing that happened, not the first.

halima/daf545f1.speaker: halima
halima/daf545f1.text: Writing at the cottage at 22:47, lying flat for hours, a cushion gone from its sofa. She died at the cottage and was driven to the strip.

halima/0d19537e.speaker: halima
halima/0d19537e.text: Harness open, headset on the hook, checklist blank. She never sat down in that cockpit alive.

halima/a41a400a.speaker: halima
halima/a41a400a.text: At Enkare since the evening, in the cottage that night, and the cushion with Linda's fibres in the company car. That will hold.

halima/43ac2925.speaker: halima
halima/43ac2925.text: The fuel attendant slept at his post. He has no vehicle and no key.

halima/84e88df1.speaker: halima
halima/84e88df1.text: Rodgers was in a Nairobi hotel until seven.

halima/cb7f77d4.speaker: halima
halima/cb7f77d4.text: Smothered, laid flat, then sat upright for the staff to find. Yes.

halima/3d2d057d.speaker: halima
halima/3d2d057d.text: Burst vessels in the eyes and fibres in her airway. That's no heart attack.

halima/3a7d81f1.speaker: halima
halima/3a7d81f1.text: The engine never started. There was no carbon monoxide.

halima/49fc951d.speaker: halima
halima/49fc951d.text: "FALSE — aircraft grounded by PIC." And a report to the authority saved at 22:47. That's the reason.

halima/4d70effe.speaker: halima
halima/4d70effe.text: Her hours were paid. Read the logbook again.

halima/e4d470c2.speaker: halima
halima/e4d470c2.text: Rodgers wanted her job, but he was in Nairobi.

mwalimu/3d367a13.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3d367a13.text: The van's tracker keeps time for the whole evening.

mwalimu/2280b397.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2280b397.text: At the manyatta from 18:40, dead by 19:30, on the road at 21:20.

mwalimu/ff81d7bc.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ff81d7bc.text: What's caught in his clothes? A murram road doesn't leave that.

mwalimu/c96b3ad7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c96b3ad7.text: Cattle hair, dung and fence thorns, and Naipanoi saw them walk to the boma.

mwalimu/2124b4fb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2124b4fb.text: Who walked with Kinuthia when he arrived?

mwalimu/4455b2ff.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4455b2ff.text: The Mzee walked him to the boma. His grandson found him there two hours later.

mwalimu/f1fc5a06.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f1fc5a06.text: A rounded wooden club head. Who carries one as a mark of standing?

mwalimu/40bdbfb3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/40bdbfb3.text: One blow from a club head, and his blood in the grain of the rungu.

mwalimu/dc8ec400.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/dc8ec400.text: Compare the village's receipt book with Kinuthia's own book.

mwalimu/5197083b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5197083b.text: KSh 3,000 charged, KSh 500 paid, and a false complaint against the boy who noticed.

mwalimu/a9b85a97.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a9b85a97.text: He did it for the boy. That's why it's hard. It's still murder.

halima/9c1d5529.speaker: halima
halima/9c1d5529.text: In at twenty to seven, dead within the hour, the boy home at half eight, the van on the road at twenty past nine. That's the evening.

halima/47d3c0e0.speaker: halima
halima/47d3c0e0.text: Six in the morning is when the herder found him.

halima/9c48d532.speaker: halima
halima/9c48d532.text: The van only reached the road at 21:20. He was long dead.

halima/758675f2.speaker: halima
halima/758675f2.text: Cattle hair, fresh dung and boma thorns on a man found on a murram road. He died in the boma.

halima/29dcde70.speaker: halima
halima/29dcde70.text: Nothing on that road but a van and some murram. Look at his jacket.

halima/7c3f4327.speaker: halima
halima/7c3f4327.text: The van sat at the manyatta until 21:10. Where in the manyatta?

halima/5d53af5b.speaker: halima
halima/5d53af5b.text: Seen walking to the boma with him, his rungu carries Kinuthia's blood, and he says so himself. That will hold.

halima/abe08655.speaker: halima
halima/abe08655.text: The grandson was in Talek until 20:20. He moved the body; he didn't strike the blow.

halima/1f648cab.speaker: halima
halima/1f648cab.text: Mohamed was in Narok with a dinner bill.

halima/22ca6cf6.speaker: halima
halima/22ca6cf6.text: One blow from a rounded club head. Yes.

halima/5e00c7ca.speaker: halima
halima/5e00c7ca.text: His wallet and twenty-one thousand shillings were still in his pocket.

halima/845338cf.speaker: halima
halima/845338cf.text: One blow from a club, no trampling.

halima/53b5f4d8.speaker: halima
halima/53b5f4d8.text: He'll stand trial. So will Kinuthia's books, and that false complaint against the boy.

halima/dd30664c.speaker: halima
halima/dd30664c.text: There's no cow sale in any book.

halima/3eef43a1.speaker: halima
halima/3eef43a1.text: Ruth argued and went back to her lodge. Read the two receipt books side by side.

mwalimu/3fa053bf.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3fa053bf.text: The weighing clerk sees everyone who passes. When did he see them?

mwalimu/5d7cd3ab.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5d7cd3ab.text: Into the back room at 16:30. Dead by 17:30.

mwalimu/59125bbf.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/59125bbf.text: He lay somewhere narrow before he was moved. Follow the drag marks back.

mwalimu/4f84802c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4f84802c.text: A scrubbed floor and drag marks out of the tea hotel's back door.

mwalimu/9e193f97.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9e193f97.text: Who was carrying something wrapped in a sack?

mwalimu/373220e1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/373220e1.text: Kipkorir with his iron at 16:30, and the victim's blood in its brand.

mwalimu/4b84f1b5.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4b84f1b5.text: A flat, shaped iron end. What does a cattle broker bring to a new herd?

mwalimu/753c6bd5.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/753c6bd5.text: A shaped iron end, and a branding iron wiped clean.

mwalimu/3766569d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3766569d.text: Unfold the ledger. Read the top of the column first.

mwalimu/15d650e6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/15d650e6.text: "Received", and permits the vet office never issued.

mwalimu/05ff52d3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/05ff52d3.text: Read the headings, not only the numbers.

halima/d9997042.speaker: halima
halima/d9997042.text: In the back room at half four, dead within the hour, the pens empty at six, found at twenty to seven. That's the afternoon.

halima/21b624da.speaker: halima
halima/21b624da.text: Two o'clock is the old man's story, not the afternoon.

halima/21e09cae.speaker: halima
halima/21e09cae.text: When did Nelson see them go in?

halima/d8b0f22e.speaker: halima
halima/d8b0f22e.text: A scrubbed floor, a broken glass and drag marks to the pens. He died in the back room.

halima/c0080319.speaker: halima
halima/c0080319.text: No trampling, and he lay somewhere narrow first. Pen 6 is where he was left.

halima/fa022d1f.speaker: halima
halima/fa022d1f.text: Into the back room with his iron at half four, and Abdirizak's blood in the brand. That will hold.

halima/fd91e338.speaker: halima
halima/fd91e338.text: Nancy never left her kettle. She lied about her licence.

halima/1b10d9a5.speaker: halima
halima/1b10d9a5.text: Omar signed manifests at the lorry park all afternoon.

halima/9b241df8.speaker: halima
halima/9b241df8.text: A flat, shaped iron end. A brand. Yes.

halima/91ccc866.speaker: halima
halima/91ccc866.text: His satchel and its cash are still on him.

halima/b59af06c.speaker: halima
halima/b59af06c.text: Read the top of the column first, Amani. Always.

halima/600c98a0.speaker: halima
halima/600c98a0.text: Unfold the ledger. Which way did the money go?

halima/101bc8f1.speaker: halima
halima/101bc8f1.text: The lorry quarrel was Omar's, and he was at the lorry park.

mwalimu/013e6730.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/013e6730.text: The guests photographed the drumming. Look at the chairs, not the drummers.

mwalimu/22e562fc.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/22e562fc.text: Faisal's chair empty 21:37–21:44. A man with a cushion at 21:41.

mwalimu/869f5d15.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/869f5d15.text: Look at her slippers, then at her feet.

mwalimu/993872de.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/993872de.text: Red soil on bare soles, and her earring on the loo-tent mat.

mwalimu/bfd071f0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bfd071f0.text: Who wouldn't let the askari help?

mwalimu/bf5a3bed.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bf5a3bed.text: "My wife is asleep, I'll carry her." And the missing cushion in his suitcase.

mwalimu/3a004a42.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3a004a42.text: A guide's throwaway line about a bump. Pin it.

mwalimu/de0abe69.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/de0abe69.text: She didn't move at the bump. Smothered, fibres in her airway.

mwalimu/2af72a69.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2af72a69.text: Read the email from her lawyer.

mwalimu/ef39b3ce.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ef39b3ce.text: Petition filed. Board meeting Friday: remove F. Bajaber.

mwalimu/2f4b88eb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2f4b88eb.text: A photograph is a witness that doesn't get tired.

halima/2e59b250.speaker: halima
halima/2e59b250.text: At the table at half nine, dead during the drumming, a bump she didn't feel at ten past ten, carried in at 22:25. The camera saw more than the guests.

halima/9a97aa28.speaker: halima
halima/9a97aa28.text: Half past ten is his story. She never walked into that tent.

halima/bc8822d8.speaker: halima
halima/bc8822d8.text: Who left the table during the drumming, and when?

halima/0247e78d.speaker: halima
halima/0247e78d.text: Red soil on bare feet, her earring on the loo-tent mat, and a man with a cushion walking towards it at 21:41. She died in the loo tent.

halima/858dfb74.speaker: halima
halima/858dfb74.text: Clean slippers and red soil on her soles. She didn't die in tent 7.

halima/709c97d6.speaker: halima
halima/709c97d6.text: She was dead before the vehicle left. Read the guide's remark.

halima/216e13df.speaker: halima
halima/216e13df.text: Out of his chair for seven minutes, photographed with a cushion, the cushion in his suitcase with her fibres on it. That will hold.

halima/ff35688f.speaker: halima
halima/ff35688f.text: The manager lied about his escort rule. He was at camp all night.

halima/fea227d4.speaker: halima
halima/fea227d4.text: The assistant is in every photo at the table.

halima/441f08a3.speaker: halima
halima/441f08a3.text: Smothered with a dinner-chair cushion while the drums were loud. Yes.

halima/75f9181c.speaker: halima
halima/75f9181c.text: Burst vessels and fibres in the airway. She didn't die in her sleep.

halima/c07598b0.speaker: halima
halima/c07598b0.text: Toxicology: a little wine, nothing else.

halima/51c449cc.speaker: halima
halima/51c449cc.text: A divorce petition on Monday and a board meeting on Friday. That's the reason.

halima/07d823d3.speaker: halima
halima/07d823d3.text: She fired her assistant every month.

halima/6b547167.speaker: halima
halima/6b547167.text: Her jewellery is all there but one earring, and we know where that is.

mwalimu/abd64b9b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/abd64b9b.text: Somebody called Leshan in the afternoon. Start there.

mwalimu/4fd18a78.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4fd18a78.text: A call at 14:10. A radio call at 14:55, inside the time of death.

mwalimu/1ce891d8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1ce891d8.text: The east repeater. Musiara can only reach the west one.

mwalimu/bdb2cc4b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bdb2cc4b.text: His own phone tells you which side of the hills he was on.

mwalimu/085a356b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/085a356b.text: East sector until 15:25, and his prints on the brace.

mwalimu/b19c7a44.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b19c7a44.text: A flat tyre with no puncture. What's missing from the valve?

mwalimu/1d0aca90.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1d0aca90.text: A pulled valve core, and a blow before the crush.

mwalimu/2aefb94f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2aefb94f.text: A ban on six Big Five Express vehicles.

mwalimu/2c1dad7a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2c1dad7a.text: Radios lie less than people. The hills see to that.

halima/2b9f33a1.speaker: halima
halima/2b9f33a1.text: A call at ten past two, a meeting at ten to three, a killing and a radio call in the same quarter-hour. The repeater kept the time.

halima/d07cb5b6.speaker: halima
halima/d07cb5b6.text: 17:10 is when he first got to the west. Long after.

halima/db1bae30.speaker: halima
halima/db1bae30.text: The east repeater heard him. He was at the lugga, not 45 km west.

halima/41512b37.speaker: halima
halima/41512b37.text: A handset at Musiara only reaches the west repeater.

halima/7a0bcf65.speaker: halima
halima/7a0bcf65.text: His own phone stayed in the east until 15:25.

halima/dc1f8532.speaker: halima
halima/dc1f8532.text: His call, his phone in the east, Leshan's valve core in his door, his prints on the brace. That will hold.

halima/9d6b9d94.speaker: halima
halima/9d6b9d94.text: The driver let the tyre down. Whose prints are on the brace?

halima/c1beb77a.speaker: halima
halima/c1beb77a.text: Tobiko was at lunch with clients in the north.

halima/d1d1481b.speaker: halima
halima/d1d1481b.text: A blow with a bar first, the crush after. Yes.

halima/1c7f4d85.speaker: halima
halima/1c7f4d85.text: No puncture, a missing valve core. That tyre was let down.

halima/476dacab.speaker: halima
halima/476dacab.text: The crush came after death, with little bleeding.

halima/0a3151f4.speaker: halima
halima/0a3151f4.text: Six vehicles, banned. That's the reason.

halima/d638fd55.speaker: halima
halima/d638fd55.text: Tobiko lost the chair fairly, and says so.

halima/26e5fdd7.speaker: halima
halima/26e5fdd7.text: Tips are recorded weekly. No dispute.

mwalimu/e85a4136.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e85a4136.text: Gates keep diaries, Detective. Start with Friday night's page.

mwalimu/36253f74.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/36253f74.text: In at 21:00, out at 22:40, Narok at 00:45.

mwalimu/9e6ce608.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9e6ce608.text: Two questions here: where he died, and where sixty files went.

mwalimu/a992e271.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a992e271.text: A fringe on a shelf bracket. Two boxes carried upstairs in Narok.

mwalimu/cc327eca.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/cc327eca.text: He wrote a name in his notebook, with two exclamation marks.

mwalimu/36a1a113.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/36a1a113.text: Sixty presentations under one name, and the same name's prints on the lamp.

mwalimu/2a1c7b04.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2a1c7b04.text: A flat-edged circle. Look for something in that room missing a part.

mwalimu/9aace8d6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9aace8d6.text: The lamp's brass base, on the floor.

mwalimu/12042bff.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/12042bff.text: Whose name is on 8,000 acres of Enkare now?

mwalimu/93a1fc23.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/93a1fc23.text: Mvua's, and Salaton called the landowners to see the originals.

mwalimu/bf97ac8b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bf97ac8b.text: Read Eric's paper result. You've seen that batch before.

mwalimu/7ee26b93.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7ee26b93.text: Shimanzi. The container of "printing paper" with an empty oval on every sheet.

halima/aef10d97.speaker: halima
halima/aef10d97.text: A call at five past seven, the gate at nine, the archive by half past, out at twenty to eleven, Narok at a quarter to one. Two hours on a dark road with sixty files in the boot.

halima/93e83cd0.speaker: halima
halima/93e83cd0.text: Seven o'clock is the driver's story. The gate log says otherwise.

halima/43403ec8.speaker: halima
halima/43403ec8.text: When did her phone reach Narok?

halima/89832ddd.speaker: halima
halima/89832ddd.text: Killed among the leases, and the leases locked in her own safe. Thirty-six ways to say it and you found the one.

halima/2a3e5990.speaker: halima
halima/2a3e5990.text: The lamp base and the fringe are in one room. Which?

halima/410e258e.speaker: halima
halima/410e258e.text: Isaiah watched her lock something away in Narok.

halima/c753e145.speaker: halima
halima/c753e145.text: Her call, her car, her scarf on the shelf, her prints on the lamp, his leases in her safe. That will hold in any court in this country.

halima/d605b7a1.speaker: halima
halima/d605b7a1.text: Tipape was dancing at a wedding. Half of Ololulung'a saw him.

halima/78303c49.speaker: halima
halima/78303c49.text: The driver sat at the wheel all night. Naisula passed him three times.

halima/08f060fe.speaker: halima
halima/08f060fe.text: A flat-edged circle, and the lamp has no base. Yes.

halima/02fb3460.speaker: halima
halima/02fb3460.text: A rungu has a round head, not a flat edge.

halima/07e60024.speaker: halima
halima/07e60024.text: No fall injuries. Read the autopsy again.

halima/4b19f6b3.speaker: halima
halima/4b19f6b3.text: Eight thousand acres, and the meeting at ten. That's why it had to be Friday night.

halima/d373a823.speaker: halima
halima/d373a823.text: Her fees were paid every quarter.

halima/178ab32f.speaker: halima
halima/178ab32f.text: The paper came in on a ship we already caught.

halima/6a3bc214.speaker: halima
halima/6a3bc214.text: The transfers carry that seal, yes. But the blank asks about the paper.

halima/ad0eff53.speaker: halima
halima/ad0eff53.text: Read Eric's paper result, then look at the Pattern File.

c061-p_njeri/d4b4193d.speaker: c061-p_njeri
c061-p_njeri/d4b4193d.text: I haven't seen him since the police took my pickup. He sold me a stolen car and laughed at me.

c061-p_njeri/98247bfc.speaker: c061-p_njeri
c061-p_njeri/98247bfc.text: Four letters on a piece of metal. One point two million. And I still pay the bank every month for a car I can't drive.

c061-p_njeri/a41ff528.speaker: c061-p_njeri
c061-p_njeri/a41ff528.text: I haven't seen him since the police took my pickup.

c061-p_njeri/5fb994a4.speaker: c061-p_njeri
c061-p_njeri/5fb994a4.text: He sold me a stolen car and laughed at me.

c061-p_njeri/89419bff.speaker: c061-p_njeri
c061-p_njeri/89419bff.text: I never touched that bar. I left him laughing.

c061-p_njeri/883fb9fb.speaker: c061-p_njeri
c061-p_njeri/883fb9fb.text: I went to ask for my money. One last time. He laughed again. I left.

c061-p_kiarie/1f022a0c.speaker: c061-p_kiarie
c061-p_kiarie/1f022a0c.text: I locked the yard at six and went home. Nobody came after.

c061-p_kiarie/b62e4db9.speaker: c061-p_kiarie
c061-p_kiarie/b62e4db9.text: I went to the bar. I didn't lock it. Anyone could walk in. Don't tell the Mzee.

c061-p_wahome/1d99bb1a.speaker: c061-p_wahome
c061-p_wahome/1d99bb1a.text: I was at the church fundraiser.

c061-p_wahome/6e2e1cd2.speaker: c061-p_wahome
c061-p_wahome/6e2e1cd2.text: I wanted to sell my half because I suspected he dealt in stolen cars. I wanted out. I didn't want him dead.

c061-p_phyllis/197958cd.speaker: c061-p_phyllis
c061-p_phyllis/197958cd.text: I came to see my pickup. I was in the hotel.

c062-p_ndinda/97b82fbc.speaker: c062-p_ndinda
c062-p_ndinda/97b82fbc.text: I left Mama's house at eight on Saturday and drove home. And Thuo found the codicil in her Bible, God rest her.

c062-p_ndinda/61d5ef3a.speaker: c062-p_ndinda
c062-p_ndinda/61d5ef3a.text: Muthoni nursed her. Nobody denies that. But Thuo was like a son.

c062-p_ndinda/cc3eb036.speaker: c062-p_ndinda
c062-p_ndinda/cc3eb036.text: I left Mama's house at eight on Saturday and drove home.

c062-p_ndinda/e6d69d02.speaker: c062-p_ndinda
c062-p_ndinda/e6d69d02.text: Thuo found the codicil in her Bible.

c062-p_ndinda/f0fa8f2d.speaker: c062-p_ndinda
c062-p_ndinda/f0fa8f2d.text: I lit nothing. I carried nothing into that room.

c062-p_ndinda/89cdb1c7.speaker: c062-p_ndinda
c062-p_ndinda/89cdb1c7.text: I have never written that woman's name in my life.

c062-p_ndinda/ce900717.speaker: c062-p_ndinda
c062-p_ndinda/ce900717.text: I stayed to help her to bed. I lit nothing. I left when she slept.

c062-p_ndinda/7112554e.speaker: c062-p_ndinda
c062-p_ndinda/7112554e.text: Ndinda looks at the death register entry and says nothing for the first time.

c062-p_thuo/fdc11804.speaker: c062-p_thuo
c062-p_thuo/fdc11804.text: On my advocate's advice, no comment.

c062-p_thuo/72af498d.speaker: c062-p_thuo
c062-p_thuo/72af498d.text: I found the codicil in Mama's Bible on Monday.

c062-p_thuo/f8ad730e.speaker: c062-p_thuo
c062-p_thuo/f8ad730e.text: Ndinda found it. She gave it to me and told me to say I found it. I didn't ask. He's telling you the truth now. Don't waste it.

c062-p_waweru/8918bc4c.speaker: c062-p_waweru
c062-p_waweru/8918bc4c.text: That will is forged. And I haven't been to Mother's house since Easter.

c062-p_waweru/f228ba0d.speaker: c062-p_waweru
c062-p_waweru/f228ba0d.text: I haven't been to Mother's house since Easter.

c062-p_waweru/b5107926.speaker: c062-p_waweru
c062-p_waweru/b5107926.text: I went on Sunday to shout at her about the will. She'd been dead since the morning. I didn't know. I shouted at a closed door and left.

c062-p_kiragu/38f04a7d.speaker: c062-p_kiragu
c062-p_kiragu/38f04a7d.text: Mama never let a jiko into the house. Never.

c063-p_kaberia/9ef04b5b.speaker: c063-p_kaberia
c063-p_kaberia/9ef04b5b.text: I haven't been to the factory this week. And every slip I hold is genuine. The farmers come to me because the co-op is slow.

c063-p_kaberia/6c3c4fd0.speaker: c063-p_kaberia
c063-p_kaberia/6c3c4fd0.text: I haven't been to the factory this week.

c063-p_kaberia/3524e340.speaker: c063-p_kaberia
c063-p_kaberia/3524e340.text: Every slip I hold is genuine.

c063-p_kaberia/4d4e3189.speaker: c063-p_kaberia
c063-p_kaberia/4d4e3189.text: He was alive when I left. Standing on the edge, shouting.

c063-p_kaberia/6516f888.speaker: c063-p_kaberia
c063-p_kaberia/6516f888.text: I went to talk. He was going to ruin me over a few slips. I left him at the tanks.

c063-p_kaberia/45f98ca4.speaker: c063-p_kaberia
c063-p_kaberia/45f98ca4.text: He looks at the magnified stamp, a grid of dots, and stops talking about the co-op being slow.

c063-p_muthomi/f58c4dde.speaker: c063-p_muthomi
c063-p_muthomi/f58c4dde.text: Kaberia called and said open the gate, it's me. He comes often. I opened and went back to sleep. I didn't write him in. Please, I have children.

c063-p_kathenya/e4fa488c.speaker: c063-p_kathenya
c063-p_kathenya/e4fa488c.text: I told Mutwiri his scale was crooked. I didn't kill him.

c063-p_rose/395aeb06.speaker: c063-p_rose
c063-p_rose/395aeb06.text: Yes, he queried my claims. I answered them. Ask the auditor.

c064-p_doris/eca2bde9.speaker: c064-p_doris
c064-p_doris/eca2bde9.text: He never came to the house on Thursday. I found him on Friday morning. We were legally married.

c064-p_doris/4be64915.speaker: c064-p_doris
c064-p_doris/4be64915.text: Six hundred thousand. Everything I saved from the salon. He said a matatu in his name was a matatu in ours.

c064-p_doris/98de03a6.speaker: c064-p_doris
c064-p_doris/98de03a6.text: He never came to the house on Thursday. I found him on Friday morning.

c064-p_doris/b8673a28.speaker: c064-p_doris
c064-p_doris/b8673a28.text: I made him tea. That's all the flask did.

c064-p_doris/ad18498c.speaker: c064-p_doris
c064-p_doris/ad18498c.text: I found out on Tuesday I was nothing. Not a wife. Not on his papers. Nothing. He came. We shouted. That's all I'll say.

c064-p_doris/ab5ca747.speaker: c064-p_doris
c064-p_doris/ab5ca747.text: They told me to go to the police, So I went home.

c064-p_agatha/e9fc48c0.speaker: c064-p_agatha
c064-p_agatha/e9fc48c0.text: I was home in Runyenjes all night.
