c064-p_agatha/049353cc.speaker: c064-p_agatha
c064-p_agatha/049353cc.text: I went to see her. To see the woman. I knocked once and I was ashamed and I left. He was already quiet in there. I didn't know why.

c064-p_mutugi/1529762a.speaker: c064-p_mutugi
c064-p_mutugi/1529762a.text: I drove him home to Runyenjes at nine.

c064-p_mutugi/9037d86e.speaker: c064-p_mutugi
c064-p_mutugi/9037d86e.text: He told me to say that, always. He went to town. Mama Agatha begged me to tell her the house. I told her. The stage guard saw her go.

c064-p_musili/4e9526ef.speaker: c064-p_musili
c064-p_musili/4e9526ef.text: He owed my boss 400,000. I don't kill people who owe money. Dead men don't pay.

c064-p_rhoda/e29c9ab5.speaker: c064-p_rhoda
c064-p_rhoda/e29c9ab5.text: I hear everything in this compound. Everything.

c065-p_philomena/7a273376.speaker: c065-p_philomena
c065-p_philomena/7a273376.text: I was at home all Friday evening, praying.

c065-p_philomena/964fd772.speaker: c065-p_philomena
c065-p_philomena/964fd772.text: I never touched a stone. I walked away crying.

c065-p_philomena/cf4f0f08.speaker: c065-p_philomena
c065-p_philomena/cf4f0f08.text: I went to beg her. I'm his mother. I knelt on the road. She said no.

c065-p_melvin/c71656d2.speaker: c065-p_melvin
c065-p_melvin/c71656d2.text: The certificate is mine. I sat that exam.

c065-p_melvin/04e0c4ec.speaker: c065-p_melvin
c065-p_melvin/04e0c4ec.text: I failed. Mum bought it. I told her Irene found out. I didn't know she'd go there.

c065-p_kaimenyi/78fb8187.speaker: c065-p_kaimenyi
c065-p_kaimenyi/78fb8187.text: She flagged my tender. She flagged everybody. She was honest. That's all.

c065-p_riungu/54bc53c1.speaker: c065-p_riungu
c065-p_riungu/54bc53c1.text: I was at work in Meru. The girls are with my sister.

c065-p_riungu/32d1000f.speaker: c065-p_riungu
c065-p_riungu/32d1000f.text: I was at work in Meru.

c066-p_desai/832f085a.speaker: c066-p_desai
c066-p_desai/832f085a.text: On my advocate's advice, no comment.

c066-p_desai/dfdce473.speaker: c066-p_desai
c066-p_desai/dfdce473.text: I went home at six on Monday and found him in the morning.

c066-p_desai/df3469c1.speaker: c066-p_desai
c066-p_desai/df3469c1.text: Parcel 2209 is a genuine title. The registry has lost the map.

c066-p_desai/bf0d5657.speaker: c066-p_desai
c066-p_desai/bf0d5657.text: He was alive when I locked up.

c066-p_desai/4e74ef98.speaker: c066-p_desai
c066-p_desai/4e74ef98.text: He came at seven, shouting. I told him I'd refund him. That's all. My client has nothing further.

c066-p_desai/d70e3b6a.speaker: c066-p_desai
c066-p_desai/d70e3b6a.text: Desai looks at Ayugi's report: his own seal, in his own box. Muchiri closes his notebook without writing anything.

c066-p_hilda/56c1130a.speaker: c066-p_hilda
c066-p_hilda/56c1130a.text: I left at five every day. I never typed any titles.

c066-p_hilda/673084a8.speaker: c066-p_hilda
c066-p_hilda/673084a8.text: He gave me a draft and told me to type it on the blank forms. He said the registry was slow and these were copies. I left at 18:40 on Monday. Mr. Chepkwony came up the stairs as I went down.

c066-p_kahuthu/e59d71da.speaker: c066-p_kahuthu
c066-p_kahuthu/e59d71da.text: I surveyed 2209 myself. I walked the beacons.

c066-p_kahuthu/39959d65.speaker: c066-p_kahuthu
c066-p_kahuthu/39959d65.text: Desai paid me 20,000 a signature. I never went. I'm finished, aren't I.

c066-p_ekidor/824a1fe5.speaker: c066-p_ekidor
c066-p_ekidor/824a1fe5.text: I owed him 60,000. I was paying it. I was at fellowship.

c066-p_selly/5f7caa3a.speaker: c066-p_selly
c066-p_selly/5f7caa3a.text: He put everything into that plot. He wanted to build a house to get me back.

c067-p_wakio/43d4e0f8.speaker: c067-p_wakio
c067-p_wakio/43d4e0f8.text: Nkatha came down with us and signed out. She said she was going to see friends in Naro Moru. I'd never met her before this climb.

c067-p_wakio/9101d69d.speaker: c067-p_wakio
c067-p_wakio/9101d69d.text: Nkatha came down with us and signed out. She said she was going to see friends in Naro Moru.

c067-p_wakio/258a4ae9.speaker: c067-p_wakio
c067-p_wakio/258a4ae9.text: I'd never met her before this climb.

c067-p_wakio/0a87f88e.speaker: c067-p_wakio
c067-p_wakio/0a87f88e.text: I never raised my pole to her. She slipped.

c067-p_wakio/98a4cb27.speaker: c067-p_wakio
c067-p_wakio/98a4cb27.text: She killed my brother. She walked him up a mountain until his brain swelled. I asked her one question at the top.

c067-p_wakio/7fda1e15.speaker: c067-p_wakio
c067-p_wakio/7fda1e15.text: She looks at the incident report, her brother's name typed in it, and her mouth goes tight.

c067-p_murimi/bca3b1af.speaker: c067-p_murimi
c067-p_murimi/bca3b1af.text: I saw Nkatha at the gate. She left with us.

c067-p_murimi/919f6a46.speaker: c067-p_murimi
c067-p_murimi/919f6a46.text: Madam said Nkatha went ahead with another group. She paid me to say she came down. I needed the money. The guide's body is up there? On the ridge below the summit path, then. Madam came down from the ridge alone.

c067-p_mwirigi/45be9c34.speaker: c067-p_mwirigi
c067-p_mwirigi/45be9c34.text: I hated losing clients to her. I was on Sirimon.

c067-p_muriungi/0e572d20.speaker: c067-p_muriungi
c067-p_muriungi/0e572d20.text: We fought about her being away so much. I was at work.

c067-p_josphine/26e69d3f.speaker: c067-p_josphine
c067-p_josphine/26e69d3f.text: Three came in. I remember that.

c068-p_jane/5dcf17e0.speaker: c068-p_jane
c068-p_jane/5dcf17e0.text: My husband died two years ago in Uganda. I haven't seen him since.

c068-p_jane/6743f96f.speaker: c068-p_jane
c068-p_jane/6743f96f.text: We did it together. The debts were going to bury us. He lived at the back. On Friday he said half the money or he'd tell them it was me. My father heard him.

c068-p_laban/2b0fcc0b.speaker: c068-p_laban
c068-p_laban/2b0fcc0b.text: I am an old man. I was in my house all evening.

c068-p_laban/75fa35d3.speaker: c068-p_laban
c068-p_laban/75fa35d3.text: I gave him my roof for two years. I hid him from the world for my daughter's sake. And he would send her to prison for money to spend on another woman. I took him to the river to talk. He laughed. I am not sorry for the stick. I am sorry the river did the rest.

c068-p_hellen/201ecfd6.speaker: c068-p_hellen
c068-p_hellen/201ecfd6.text: I don't know any Elphas Shikanda.

c068-p_hellen/f88542f1.speaker: c068-p_hellen
c068-p_hellen/f88542f1.text: Elias. I knew him as Elias. He said he'd have money by Monday.

c068-p_gichuki/b84fd852.speaker: c068-p_gichuki
c068-p_gichuki/b84fd852.text: He owed me 8,000 for sand. I found him. I didn't know it was him.

c069-p_brenda/21095b15.speaker: c069-p_brenda
c069-p_brenda/21095b15.text: The inspector came, checked some packs and left happy. No notice. All my stock comes from Kirinyaga Pharma.

c069-p_brenda/f4f8437f.speaker: c069-p_brenda
c069-p_brenda/f4f8437f.text: The inspector came, checked some packs and left happy. No notice.

c069-p_brenda/7a1888bd.speaker: c069-p_brenda
c069-p_brenda/7a1888bd.text: All my stock comes from Kirinyaga Pharma.

c069-p_brenda/a54f9b4d.speaker: c069-p_brenda
c069-p_brenda/a54f9b4d.text: It was a soda from the fridge. There was nothing in it.

c069-p_brenda/dea31de1.speaker: c069-p_brenda
c069-p_brenda/dea31de1.text: Fine. She found a few batches. I gave her a soda because it was hot. That's not a crime.

c069-p_brenda/48ea74c3.speaker: c069-p_brenda
c069-p_brenda/48ea74c3.text: They're cheaper at the bus park,

c069-p_mark/8fef9dfe.speaker: c069-p_mark
c069-p_mark/8fef9dfe.text: The inspector didn't come in on Thursday.

c069-p_mark/bb61c23e.speaker: c069-p_mark
c069-p_mark/bb61c23e.text: Brenda told me to say that. She told me I'd lose my job and be charged with her. I watched her take a soda from the fridge into the back room before she gave it to the inspector.

c069-p_silas/3ab4c19d.speaker: c069-p_silas
c069-p_silas/3ab4c19d.text: I own it. I don't run it. I was in Nairobi.

c069-p_silas/29cf8027.speaker: c069-p_silas
c069-p_silas/29cf8027.text: Brenda was making profits I didn't understand. I was happy not to understand.

c069-p_abdikadir/d5b5d60c.speaker: c069-p_abdikadir
c069-p_abdikadir/d5b5d60c.text: That isn't our company's invoice. But I've seen that template before, in Meru. Someone sells them.

c069-p_grace/10e1e40b.speaker: c069-p_grace
c069-p_grace/10e1e40b.text: She signed out at four. She said, 'One more chemist and I'm done for the week.'

c070-p_rahab/e07eb2cd.speaker: c070-p_rahab
c070-p_rahab/e07eb2cd.text: On my advocate's advice, no comment.

c070-p_rahab/7db25a33.speaker: c070-p_rahab
c070-p_rahab/7db25a33.text: I haven't been to the estate since the funeral.

c070-p_rahab/4cca06c1.speaker: c070-p_rahab
c070-p_rahab/4cca06c1.text: Mr. Wainaina signed that will in front of me on 14 March.

c070-p_rahab/5a8d6778.speaker: c070-p_rahab
c070-p_rahab/5a8d6778.text: I touched nothing in that room.

c070-p_rahab/f6569f73.speaker: c070-p_rahab
c070-p_rahab/f6569f73.text: I went to offer her a settlement. She was unreasonable. I left her standing.

c070-p_rahab/7a02666f.speaker: c070-p_rahab
c070-p_rahab/7a02666f.text: I'm withdrawing, Detective. I don't represent clients who lie to me about comas.

c070-p_gakuya/3d2d95e6.speaker: c070-p_gakuya
c070-p_gakuya/3d2d95e6.text: I saw Mr. Wainaina sign it with my own eyes.

c070-p_gakuya/18792ae8.speaker: c070-p_gakuya
c070-p_gakuya/18792ae8.text: I sign for whoever pays at the registry door. Thirty thousand. I never met the man. The other witness? There's no other witness. She wrote that name in the car.

c070-p_gichuhi/81a8fe99.speaker: c070-p_gichuhi
c070-p_gichuhi/81a8fe99.text: I hated that she got everything. I was in Nanyuki. And I've never met this Rahab.

c070-p_gichuhi/5e71a34b.speaker: c070-p_gichuhi
c070-p_gichuhi/5e71a34b.text: I hated that she got everything. I was in Nanyuki.

c070-p_gichuhi/e9483b2a.speaker: c070-p_gichuhi
c070-p_gichuhi/e9483b2a.text: She found me in April. Said the new will was real and if I didn't fight it I'd get two million. I signed. I didn't ask how my father signed anything in a coma. I didn't want to know.

c070-p_njogu/38937d3c.speaker: c070-p_njogu
c070-p_njogu/38937d3c.text: I found Mama at the stairs. I was at the workers' meeting till half past nine.

c070-p_njogu/a57de14e.speaker: c070-p_njogu
c070-p_njogu/a57de14e.text: The kitchen soak-pit. Someone's been at the cover. I saw it this morning and thought it was dogs.

c070-p_japhet/4ba2949a.speaker: c070-p_japhet
c070-p_japhet/4ba2949a.text: Everyone's asking for this one this morning.

mwalimu/753c45d8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/753c45d8.text: A guard who sits facing the yard, Amani. Ask him what he saw.

mwalimu/70233224.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/70233224.text: In at 19:10, out at 19:30. And the gate was open from 17:40.

mwalimu/1d9e76de.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1d9e76de.text: Where was he lying, and what was beside him?

mwalimu/b107d7fe.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b107d7fe.text: Beside his desk, the bar on the floor. The jack never left the bay.

mwalimu/75655210.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/75655210.text: An orange reflective jacket. Whose fleet wears orange?

mwalimu/ec413746.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ec413746.text: Her phone at the market at seven, her print under the hook.

mwalimu/66e3e6e1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/66e3e6e1.text: A straight steel bar. Look at the floor.

mwalimu/a8a0ae91.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a8a0ae91.text: Why is her pickup in a police yard?

mwalimu/f0cfcef1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f0cfcef1.text: Stolen in Nairobi, a forged logbook, and a loan she still pays.

mwalimu/dfa1ea8e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/dfa1ea8e.text: Lay the logbook over the genuine one. Then drag its numbers onto the frame.

halima/60f7ed66.speaker: halima
halima/60f7ed66.text: Unlocked at twenty to six, in at ten past seven, out at half past. The guard kept better time than the mechanic.

halima/2203f20e.speaker: halima
halima/2203f20e.text: Six o'clock is the mechanic's story. His bar tab disagrees.

halima/192bbfcf.speaker: halima
halima/192bbfcf.text: When did the woman in the orange jacket go in?

halima/c2b87a7a.speaker: halima
halima/c2b87a7a.text: The office, beside his own desk. Yes.

halima/eca4c165.speaker: halima
halima/eca4c165.text: The jack in the bay hasn't moved off its hook.

halima/1810d9cd.speaker: halima
halima/1810d9cd.text: Her pickup is in the impound yard. He wasn't.

halima/de59e324.speaker: halima
halima/de59e324.text: Her jacket at the gate, her phone at the market, her print under the hook. That will hold.

halima/e5672229.speaker: halima
halima/e5672229.text: The mechanic was at the bar until ten.

halima/449f1c97.speaker: halima
halima/449f1c97.text: The guard never left his gate.

halima/d5807b0e.speaker: halima
halima/d5807b0e.text: A straight steel bar, wiped and left on the floor. Yes.

halima/82cdafbf.speaker: halima
halima/82cdafbf.text: The jack is clean and on its hook.

halima/4b5fa6e5.speaker: halima
halima/4b5fa6e5.text: Thirty-one thousand shillings in a locked box. Not a robbery.

halima/7d62c444.speaker: halima
halima/7d62c444.text: One point two million, a bank loan, and a laugh. That's why.

halima/8ca946eb.speaker: halima
halima/8ca946eb.text: The partner was at the fundraiser all evening.

halima/1620144e.speaker: halima
halima/1620144e.text: Phyllis was at dinner in her hotel.

halima/2718a07e.speaker: halima
halima/2718a07e.text: Four characters on a piece of metal. The frame doesn't lie, Amani. Paper does.

halima/8557dfd8.speaker: halima
halima/8557dfd8.text: The stamp and the signature are good copies. Look at the numbers.

halima/715a46e5.speaker: halima
halima/715a46e5.text: The impound register is the police's own book.

mwalimu/5752520a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5752520a.text: The neighbour's window looks at the gate, Amani.

mwalimu/d9a23a15.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d9a23a15.text: Her car came at half six and left at eleven. The death came later.

mwalimu/2a09f408.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2a09f408.text: Who stuffs a cloth into a window she always leaves open?

mwalimu/b1ca9b94.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b1ca9b94.text: Look at the jiko's leg. Then find its sisters.

mwalimu/4ba6b5eb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4ba6b5eb.text: The same wire in Ndinda's kitchen, and a pencil sheet of Wambui's name.

mwalimu/47b620c2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/47b620c2.text: Ask the man who has worked here thirty years about jikos in the house.

mwalimu/55559f33.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/55559f33.text: Who gains from the paper that appeared on Monday?

mwalimu/3d6a9310.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3d6a9310.text: Everyone says the will is forged. Read the other paper's witnesses.

mwalimu/c01fae23.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c01fae23.text: A witness two years dead. And a pencil line under the ink.

mwalimu/ed976895.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ed976895.text: The loud one is usually only loud.

halima/d7cdda35.speaker: halima
halima/d7cdda35.text: In at half six with porridge, a stove in a sealed room before eleven, gone by eleven. The son came the next afternoon to shout at the dead.

halima/1d7233c7.speaker: halima
halima/1d7233c7.text: Eight o'clock is her story. The neighbour heard the car at eleven.

halima/b92f473a.speaker: halima
halima/b92f473a.text: When did Wambui die, and when did the stove go in? They are not the same time.

halima/7be7156e.speaker: halima
halima/7be7156e.text: Her bedroom, window sealed with a cloth. Yes.

halima/a9bd4069.speaker: halima
halima/a9bd4069.text: Her own jikos never left the kitchen hut.

halima/143bc60d.speaker: halima
halima/143bc60d.text: She died in her bed, not on the road.

halima/102c3b50.speaker: halima
halima/102c3b50.text: Her car until eleven, her wired jiko, her pencil practice of a dead woman's name. That will hold.

halima/5f93c70f.speaker: halima
halima/5f93c70f.text: Thuo was watching football in Karatina with his neighbour.

halima/2dde7533.speaker: halima
halima/2dde7533.text: The son shouted at a door on Sunday. Wambui was already dead.

halima/8fbeea94.speaker: halima
halima/8fbeea94.text: A stove from another woman's kitchen, a sealed window. Not an accident.

halima/cc74be83.speaker: halima
halima/cc74be83.text: Mama never let a jiko into the house. Ask Kiragu why.

halima/f0e9c822.speaker: halima
halima/f0e9c822.text: A codicil only works once the testator can't deny it. That's why she needed her dead.

halima/de0989e9.speaker: halima
halima/de0989e9.text: Muthoni already inherits under the genuine will.

halima/80b039f6.speaker: halima
halima/80b039f6.text: The son was at home in Othaya on Saturday night.

halima/6fc53977.speaker: halima
halima/6fc53977.text: The will everyone shouted about is real. The paper that arrived after the funeral is the lie. Good.

halima/f4ff9f34.speaker: halima
halima/f4ff9f34.text: Advocate Gakii watched her sign the February will.

halima/7098e627.speaker: halima
halima/7098e627.text: There's no stamp on the codicil at all. Look at its witnesses.

mwalimu/79fa1b50.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/79fa1b50.text: The gate book stops at six. Did the gate?

mwalimu/927b70db.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/927b70db.text: A call at 22:35, the gate at 22:40, his phone gone at 23:20.

mwalimu/b94ff67d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b94ff67d.text: Two kinds of footprint at one tank.

mwalimu/315882fb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/315882fb.text: Gumboots and a smart shoe, at tank 3.

mwalimu/1eec11c9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1eec11c9.text: The shoe at the tank, and the file under his sack.

mwalimu/9595c8a7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9595c8a7.text: On the backs of the shoulders. Held down.

mwalimu/8ecbe74f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8ecbe74f.text: Ask the farmers named on the slips.

mwalimu/0832bf85.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0832bf85.text: They never sold. Mutwiri was going to the Co-operative Officer on Friday.

mwalimu/7b216b80.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7b216b80.text: Drag the magnifier over the stamp. Then over the real one.

mwalimu/5eb31ec7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5eb31ec7.text: A halo of ink, or a grid of dots?

mwalimu/b68cb6b9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b68cb6b9.text: Drag the magnifier over every stamp. Every one.

halima/cc3df268.speaker: halima
halima/cc3df268.text: A call, a gate, a tank, and a phone leaving: forty-five minutes. The watchman slept through the middle.

halima/cae1a1ae.speaker: halima
halima/cae1a1ae.text: The gate book stops at six. The gate didn't.

halima/6d06ff60.speaker: halima
halima/6d06ff60.text: When did Kaberia's phone leave the factory?

halima/ea808256.speaker: halima
halima/ea808256.text: Tank 3, where his gumboots and a leather shoe stood together.

halima/4bc95dc9.speaker: halima
halima/4bc95dc9.text: The file was taken from the office. He died at the tanks.

halima/4dd7fad7.speaker: halima
halima/4dd7fad7.text: The stall is where the file went, not where he died.

halima/5374175f.speaker: halima
halima/5374175f.text: His call, his gate, his shoes, his stolen file. That will hold.

halima/51c46bf3.speaker: halima
halima/51c46bf3.text: The watchman was asleep in his hut, and his boots are clean.

halima/188eb514.speaker: halima
halima/188eb514.text: Mzee Kathenya sat at a wake all night.

halima/e315bc35.speaker: halima
halima/e315bc35.text: Two bruises where hands held him. Not a fall.

halima/2dcb409a.speaker: halima
halima/2dcb409a.text: A man who falls doesn't bruise on the backs of his shoulders.

halima/bcc6e927.speaker: halima
halima/bcc6e927.text: No head injury. Read the autopsy.

halima/6724d453.speaker: halima
halima/6724d453.text: Friday, the Co-operative Officer. He wasn't going to let Mutwiri get there.

halima/cafdef45.speaker: halima
halima/cafdef45.text: The chair's claims were passed by the auditor.

halima/aaa8c40d.speaker: halima
halima/aaa8c40d.text: Real rubber stamps leave a halo. His leave a grid. Drag the magnifier over every stamp from now on.

halima/b837be94.speaker: halima
halima/b837be94.text: The dates and names are right. Look closer at the stamp.

halima/9d982248.speaker: halima
halima/9d982248.text: The payout list is printed from the co-op ledger.

mwalimu/7d7fc709.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7d7fc709.text: The landlady hears everything, Amani. Ask her when.

mwalimu/e6065331.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e6065331.text: Shouting at nine, then quiet. A knock at ten.

mwalimu/c1523862.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c1523862.text: The driver says Runyenjes. Where is the body?

mwalimu/2cecba16.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2cecba16.text: The sitting room. The car never left the yard.

mwalimu/672b1a11.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/672b1a11.text: Who washes a flask and loses its lid?

mwalimu/f796c10e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f796c10e.text: The tea cloth in her bin, and whose blood is on it.

mwalimu/7ab6b84e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7ab6b84e.text: A rounded blow. Look at the drying rack.

mwalimu/53f5768d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/53f5768d.text: What did Doris learn at the registry on Tuesday?

mwalimu/867d171b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/867d171b.text: No marriage, and her savings in his name.

mwalimu/462843b4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/462843b4.text: Look the serial up in the register. Then look up the registrar.

mwalimu/8de3e6b8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8de3e6b8.text: Another couple's number. A registrar three years retired.

mwalimu/59d9f873.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/59d9f873.text: Sometimes the paper is the victim's lie.

halima/c93e7bd4.speaker: halima
halima/c93e7bd4.text: Tuesday at the registry. Thursday: a car, shouting, quiet. The first wife at a locked door an hour too late.

halima/f1fa6d3b.speaker: halima
halima/f1fa6d3b.text: Friday morning is her story, not his death.

halima/0c1e450c.speaker: halima
halima/0c1e450c.text: Who knocked at ten, and was the door open?

halima/03ef460d.speaker: halima
halima/03ef460d.text: The sitting room, beside the low table. Yes.

halima/7691cc03.speaker: halima
halima/7691cc03.text: The driver said Runyenjes. The fleet log says otherwise.

halima/81b00e8c.speaker: halima
halima/81b00e8c.text: Agatha got no further than the door.

halima/93c08046.speaker: halima
halima/93c08046.text: Her house, her shouting, her flask, his blood on her tea cloth. That will hold.

halima/4824173c.speaker: halima
halima/4824173c.text: Agatha was at the Runyenjes stage at nine.

halima/a013776c.speaker: halima
halima/a013776c.text: Musili was checking into a Nairobi lodging.

halima/52a35b5d.speaker: halima
halima/52a35b5d.text: A rounded blow and a dented flask. Yes.

halima/ca33a061.speaker: halima
halima/ca33a061.text: A spanner doesn't leave a rounded wound.

halima/7f3e9e34.speaker: halima
halima/7f3e9e34.text: Toxicology is clean. The tea wasn't the weapon. The flask was.

halima/b14840a5.speaker: halima
halima/b14840a5.text: Not a wife, not insured, not on the matatu. That's why.

halima/29d0e8fc.speaker: halima
halima/29d0e8fc.text: His loan repayments were up to date.

halima/84e7e79c.speaker: halima
halima/84e7e79c.text: Twenty-two thousand shillings in his jacket. Not a robbery.

halima/143e2514.speaker: halima
halima/143e2514.text: The paper was his lie. It was her motive.

halima/e68af3cc.speaker: halima
halima/e68af3cc.text: The matatu record is real. That's the problem.

halima/0f1e31a5.speaker: halima
halima/0f1e31a5.text: The ink and the spelling are fine. Look the serial up.

mwalimu/d1d8f4c0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d1d8f4c0.text: When did his mother know, Amani? He told her himself.

mwalimu/5ca40089.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5ca40089.text: 17:10 a text. 20:30 a woman at the gate.

mwalimu/39e0ee13.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/39e0ee13.text: Look at the top of the wall.

mwalimu/03b585cd.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/03b585cd.text: A gap in the top row, and the stone in the hedge.

mwalimu/8ca2ca40.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8ca2ca40.text: An older woman in a church headscarf. Who calls Irene's "no" a death sentence?

mwalimu/af46396b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/af46396b.text: Her phone at the estate, her headscarf on the stone.

mwalimu/aea950f0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/aea950f0.text: What is lying in the hedge?

mwalimu/f688a7de.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f688a7de.text: A rough stone with blood on it.

mwalimu/d9231f18.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d9231f18.text: Read the letter in her bag. Then the memo.

mwalimu/2702a62c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2702a62c.text: Someone else's number, and the police on Monday.

mwalimu/5ed77c4b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5ed77c4b.text: Call the number on the letter. Ask her to send a photo.

mwalimu/44338835.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/44338835.text: Same number, different life. You heard her voice. Remember it.

halima/8e399205.speaker: halima
halima/8e399205.text: Thursday a letter, Friday a text, half past eight a mother at the gate. It was over before nine.

halima/77edd92b.speaker: halima
halima/77edd92b.text: Nine o'clock is a rumour. Check the bar's camera.

halima/ad79de48.speaker: halima
halima/ad79de48.text: When did his mother learn Irene knew?

halima/c7b915cf.speaker: halima
halima/c7b915cf.text: Her own gate, the stone from her own wall. Yes.

halima/a99fe6d2.speaker: halima
halima/a99fe6d2.text: She left the HR office at five.

halima/195bf482.speaker: halima
halima/195bf482.text: Philomena says she was praying at home. Her phone says otherwise.

halima/2352ea28.speaker: halima
halima/2352ea28.text: Her phone at the gate, her headscarf on the stone. That will hold. I'm sorry it does.

halima/1b9c3776.speaker: halima
halima/1b9c3776.text: Melvin was in the lab with two colleagues.

halima/42d9fc9d.speaker: halima
halima/42d9fc9d.text: Kalekye was supervising prep in Kitui.

halima/118fc6fc.speaker: halima
halima/118fc6fc.text: A stone from the top of her own wall. Yes.

halima/51798d4c.speaker: halima
halima/51798d4c.text: Her handbag is still on her arm. Not a robbery.

halima/c8004bc7.speaker: halima
halima/c8004bc7.text: Monday, the police. A mother had one evening.

halima/9021d121.speaker: halima
halima/9021d121.text: Riungu was on night duty in Meru.

halima/69b8df0e.speaker: halima
halima/69b8df0e.text: Kaimenyi's tender went to audit in March. Old news.

halima/c33c2719.speaker: halima
halima/c33c2719.text: Same number, different life. The index number gave it away.

halima/0349ceb3.speaker: halima
halima/0349ceb3.text: The verification letter is the council's own. It's what caught the forgery.

halima/fd64aedf.speaker: halima
halima/fd64aedf.text: Every KCSE certificate is printed. Look at the number.

mwalimu/4bc3c18e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4bc3c18e.text: When did the clerk log off, Amani? She passed someone on the stairs.

mwalimu/854bcee7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/854bcee7.text: Kipng'eno up the stairs at 18:40. Desai's phone there until 21:30.

mwalimu/60e3062e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/60e3062e.text: What on that shelf has a dented corner?

mwalimu/94d08928.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/94d08928.text: The strongbox, in the inner office.

mwalimu/4beecff4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4beecff4.text: He says he went home at six. Ask his phone.

mwalimu/a9c3dc3a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a9c3dc3a.text: In the office until 21:30, and the blood on his cuff.

mwalimu/631270c2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/631270c2.text: A square-edged metal object. Look at the shelf.

mwalimu/2e1c9dc5.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2e1c9dc5.text: Read the last line of his list.

mwalimu/ad05091e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ad05091e.text: "Refund 2.8M by Wed or DCI." And four more parcels.

mwalimu/6fd4e044.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6fd4e044.text: Lay the title's sketch plan over the index map.

mwalimu/96c6b6b4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/96c6b6b4.text: 2208, then 2210. The plan sits on someone else's farm.

mwalimu/a716a603.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a716a603.text: A seal marked MV. Write that down. ...Then put it somewhere safe.

halima/661dba3e.speaker: halima
halima/661dba3e.text: A survey nobody walked in February. A map on Thursday. A man on the stairs at twenty to seven. Desai's phone in the office until half past nine.

halima/c6f013cd.speaker: halima
halima/c6f013cd.text: Six o'clock is the agent's story. His phone tells another.

halima/56ff153e.speaker: halima
halima/56ff153e.text: When did the clerk pass him on the stairs?

halima/e84fb208.speaker: halima
halima/e84fb208.text: The inner office, beside the strongbox. Yes.

halima/33636472.speaker: halima
halima/33636472.text: A fall down the stairs doesn't leave a man in the inner office.

halima/cb4538cd.speaker: halima
halima/cb4538cd.text: The plot doesn't exist. He couldn't have died there.

halima/aabf0c38.speaker: halima
halima/aabf0c38.text: His phone in the office, his seal on the title, the victim's blood on his cuff. That will hold, advocate or no advocate.

halima/743c7bc6.speaker: halima
halima/743c7bc6.text: The clerk was on a matatu to Likii at 18:50.

halima/c87aac97.speaker: halima
halima/c87aac97.text: A square-edged corner, dented and wiped. Yes.

halima/c40e070d.speaker: halima
halima/c40e070d.text: A hundred and fifty thousand still in the box. Not a robbery.

halima/f9f7daab.speaker: halima
halima/f9f7daab.text: Wednesday or the DCI, and four more parcels on his list. That's why.

halima/166427e0.speaker: halima
halima/166427e0.text: Ekidor was paying his debt every month.

halima/b2dc605a.speaker: halima
halima/b2dc605a.text: The fee was paid in full. The quarrel was about the land not existing.

halima/013c08a4.speaker: halima
halima/013c08a4.text: A title for nothing. The map was never lost.

halima/1764992e.speaker: halima
halima/1764992e.text: The surveyor sold his signature, but the survey is his. The title is what was forged.

halima/bcc6353d.speaker: halima
halima/bcc6353d.text: The registrar is in post. Look at the map.

mwalimu/2e73835c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2e73835c.text: Radio the hut, Amani. Who went up, and who came back?

mwalimu/30146f58.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/30146f58.text: Two out at 02:30, one back at 08:40. A payment at 17:05.

mwalimu/005dd085.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/005dd085.text: Nobody saw the guide's face at the gate. Then where is she?

mwalimu/63dac670.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/63dac670.text: Below the summit path. The porter knows.

mwalimu/e8b090d8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e8b090d8.text: Why would a client pay a porter twenty thousand at the gate?

mwalimu/b8ec2b57.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b8ec2b57.text: Her pole's tip, and her hand on the register.

mwalimu/3c4dc14c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3c4dc14c.text: Her own poles are intact. Whose tip is in the rocks?

mwalimu/9e29a64d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9e29a64d.text: A carbide tip, and two narrow blows before the fall.

mwalimu/bc999a22.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bc999a22.text: Look in the incident archive under her surname.

mwalimu/09341929.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/09341929.text: Her brother, three years ago. Nkatha was his guide.

mwalimu/6a26a218.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6a26a218.text: Trace her entry signature. Slide it over the exit.

mwalimu/ca21935e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ca21935e.text: The mountain keeps what it's given. Sleep, Amani.

halima/fd4f5a02.speaker: halima
halima/fd4f5a02.text: Out at half past two, dead at dawn, the client back alone at twenty to nine, a forged line at twenty past four and a payment at five past five.

halima/d8d66d24.speaker: halima
halima/d8d66d24.text: Who came back to the hut at 08:40, and how many of them?

halima/264abf67.speaker: halima
halima/264abf67.text: The ridge, and the scree below it. She never came down.

halima/06272ecb.speaker: halima
halima/06272ecb.text: The gate saw a signature, not a guide.

halima/e248d99b.speaker: halima
halima/e248d99b.text: Murimi was in the porters' room at Mackinder's.

halima/804d74c0.speaker: halima
halima/804d74c0.text: Alone with her on the ridge, back alone, her hand on the register, her pole's tip beside the body. That will hold.

halima/ec639be5.speaker: halima
halima/ec639be5.text: The porter was in the hut with a bad knee.

halima/c6648cac.speaker: halima
halima/c6648cac.text: Mwirigi was on the other side of the mountain.

halima/636c8351.speaker: halima
halima/636c8351.text: Two blows with a narrow point before the fall. Her pole, not the mountain.

halima/8302ee40.speaker: halima
halima/8302ee40.text: She was struck before she fell.

halima/82c23d37.speaker: halima
halima/82c23d37.text: Nobody on that trip carried an ice axe.

halima/a29122c6.speaker: halima
halima/a29122c6.text: Three years of grief, booked by name. The inquiry cleared Nkatha. Wakio never did.

halima/db03d96b.speaker: halima
halima/db03d96b.text: The porter was paid in full, and then some.

halima/cfb8642d.speaker: halima
halima/cfb8642d.text: Six thousand shillings in her pack.

halima/53347b40.speaker: halima
halima/53347b40.text: Trace the loops. They don't line up. Nkatha never signed out.

halima/f19f37e2.speaker: halima
halima/f19f37e2.text: The hut log is the hut keeper's. It's what tells the truth.

halima/8a50bbb1.speaker: halima
halima/8a50bbb1.text: A gate register has no seal. Compare the signatures.

mwalimu/53f89a36.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/53f89a36.text: The last house on the river path, Amani. Who walked past, and who came back?

mwalimu/a3388758.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a3388758.text: Two went down at 20:30. One came back at 21:15.

mwalimu/8d3c7f79.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8d3c7f79.text: Where does the compound's path meet the river?

mwalimu/fda596dc.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fda596dc.text: The landing, and its sand in the stick.

mwalimu/167bcbaa.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/167bcbaa.text: An old man with his stick and a younger man, going down.

mwalimu/779858b8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/779858b8.text: Water in his lungs, and a blow before it.

mwalimu/f8999665.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f8999665.text: Struck, then put in the river.

mwalimu/c541d089.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c541d089.text: Who has been living at the back of the compound?

mwalimu/b9234802.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b9234802.text: Half the money, or he tells the insurer it was Jane.

mwalimu/94f42e81.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/94f42e81.text: Call the hospital in Tororo. Ask for the patient, and the doctor.

mwalimu/47166445.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/47166445.text: No patient. A doctor retired eight years.

mwalimu/1aecb0f3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1aecb0f3.text: A dead man's file is still a file. Close it properly.

halima/5cd854b3.speaker: halima
halima/5cd854b3.text: Dead on paper two years ago. A demand on Friday. A walk to the river on Saturday, and an old man walking back alone.

halima/2c3f4c81.speaker: halima
halima/2c3f4c81.text: Monday is when he was found, not when he died.

halima/1117981d.speaker: halima
halima/1117981d.text: When did Laban come back up the path, and with whom?

halima/87e8270e.speaker: halima
halima/87e8270e.text: The landing below the compound, where the path meets the river.

halima/38499792.speaker: halima
halima/38499792.text: He lived in the back house. He died at the river.

halima/4dfd19a9.speaker: halima
halima/4dfd19a9.text: Busia is where he "died" the first time.

halima/5cf5c116.speaker: halima
halima/5cf5c116.text: Seen walking him down, seen walking back alone, river sand in his stick. That will hold, and I wish it didn't.

halima/6cfb1bf8.speaker: halima
halima/6cfb1bf8.text: Jane was in the kitchen with her mother.

halima/9d069f18.speaker: halima
halima/9d069f18.text: Hellen was working at the salon until nine.

halima/95f80755.speaker: halima
halima/95f80755.text: A rounded blow before the water. The stick, then the river.

halima/6c85224d.speaker: halima
halima/6c85224d.text: A barge hull leaves an edge, not a round wound.

halima/b7126463.speaker: halima
halima/b7126463.text: Half the money, or prison for his daughter. A father's reason.

halima/dbd8a853.speaker: halima
halima/dbd8a853.text: The money was paid to Jane alone. Laban gets nothing.

halima/6156e664.speaker: halima
halima/6156e664.text: Gichuki was playing cards at the camp.

halima/faab754c.speaker: halima
halima/faab754c.text: A retired doctor and a patient who never was. He died on paper in a hospital that never saw him.

halima/854c57d6.speaker: halima
halima/854c57d6.text: The national ID record is how we know who he is.

halima/9f9ded24.speaker: halima
halima/9f9ded24.text: The stamp is real ink. Call Tororo.

mwalimu/b043ea18.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b043ea18.text: A bank camera faces the door, Amani.

mwalimu/95b09161.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/95b09161.text: In at 16:58, out at 17:25 with a soda. A sedative signed out at 17:10.

mwalimu/1c4e244e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1c4e244e.text: She died in the car. Where did she get the soda?

mwalimu/50ed63ea.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/50ed63ea.text: Whose initials are in the register at 17:10?

mwalimu/47b8f3db.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/47b8f3db.text: B.J., and her prints on the bottle.

mwalimu/77378e28.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/77378e28.text: Count the sodas in the crate.

mwalimu/2eba2f3c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2eba2f3c.text: One missing, and a sedative in the bottle.

mwalimu/58475f32.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/58475f32.text: Read the carbon copy of the notice she never got to keep.

mwalimu/f528247c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f528247c.text: Closed at nine on Friday, invoices seized.

mwalimu/64319e7d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/64319e7d.text: Type the batch numbers in. Then type in a control.

mwalimu/8ce650a6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8ce650a6.text: Not found, and a series that ended in 2023.

mwalimu/426851ab.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/426851ab.text: Check the control before you trust the "not found".

halima/33dd41cb.speaker: halima
halima/33dd41cb.text: In at two minutes to five, batches at five past, a sedative signed out at ten past, out with a soda at twenty-five past. Dead within the half-hour.

halima/cf17358b.speaker: halima
halima/cf17358b.text: Sunset is a hawker's guess. Read the toxicology.

halima/fdf7ab52.speaker: halima
halima/fdf7ab52.text: When was the sedative signed out, and by whom?

halima/3f7cb2b5.speaker: halima
halima/3f7cb2b5.text: She died in the car, but she was poisoned at the counter. Tumaini.

halima/9d8e2aba.speaker: halima
halima/9d8e2aba.text: She drove fifty metres and parked. Where did she drink?

halima/d271acc9.speaker: halima
halima/d271acc9.text: The bus park is where the stock came from, not the soda.

halima/024e2f87.speaker: halima
halima/024e2f87.text: Her initials in the register, her prints on the bottle, the notice in her ash pan. That will hold.

halima/2b2e642c.speaker: halima
halima/2b2e642c.text: Mark watched; his prints aren't on the bottle.

halima/7b4f2886.speaker: halima
halima/7b4f2886.text: Silas hasn't been to Meru in a month.

halima/878321f3.speaker: halima
halima/878321f3.text: Twenty tablets from her own cabinet, in a cold soda.

halima/41d54860.speaker: halima
halima/41d54860.text: The engine was off and the windows were down.

halima/272ac97d.speaker: halima
halima/272ac97d.text: She took no medicine. The sedative was genuine cabinet stock.

halima/da95973d.speaker: halima
halima/da95973d.text: Closed at nine on Friday, invoices seized. She had one evening.

halima/e131a5d0.speaker: halima
halima/e131a5d0.text: Abdikadir was in Nyeri all afternoon.

halima/5dbd80f9.speaker: halima
halima/5dbd80f9.text: Mark was afraid. He didn't act.

halima/7f8fc9ba.speaker: halima
halima/7f8fc9ba.text: Batches that don't exist, from a series that ended years ago. Check the control sample first, as Kanini did.

halima/b69e9955.speaker: halima
halima/b69e9955.text: The controlled-drugs register is genuine. That's what makes it damning.

halima/1bf55956.speaker: halima
halima/1bf55956.text: The signature is hers, on purpose. Look at the numbers.

mwalimu/c52b7cd8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c52b7cd8.text: This strip spans months. Start with where Kiama was in March.

mwalimu/6cb7ace6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6cb7ace6.text: A coma from the third. And a silver car at eight on Wednesday.

mwalimu/44ec1c5a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/44ec1c5a.text: Floor polish keeps a record, Amani. Follow the scuffs.

mwalimu/6fe77694.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6fe77694.text: From the study, where the blood is under the rug, to the stairs.

mwalimu/72dbbeee.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/72dbbeee.text: Ask the watchman whose car came.

mwalimu/371c19f6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/371c19f6.text: Her phone at the estate, her print in the doorstop.

mwalimu/0ba28a9a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0ba28a9a.text: Something heavy is missing from the study. Ask Njogu where it went.

mwalimu/40f58429.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/40f58429.text: The brass coffee bean, in the soak-pit.

mwalimu/69d41ce3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/69d41ce3.text: Who was she going to see on Friday?

mwalimu/64576a7a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/64576a7a.text: Halima, about a forged will. With the hospital records in her hand.

mwalimu/95489f0a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/95489f0a.text: Lay the will's date on the hospital file.

mwalimu/7b35e845.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7b35e845.text: A coma that day. And a witness who doesn't exist.

mwalimu/f9cd94fb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f9cd94fb.text: Ink Doreen's seized stamp and press it beside the will's.

mwalimu/500a4e13.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/500a4e13.text: Her own stamp. From the safe in Narok.

halima/17e36213.speaker: halima
halima/17e36213.text: A coma on the third, a signature on the fourteenth, a filing on the second of April. Records on Monday, my office on Tuesday, dead on Wednesday.

halima/142d4ded.speaker: halima
halima/142d4ded.text: Thursday morning is when she was found, not when she died.

halima/41f62dd9.speaker: halima
halima/41f62dd9.text: What date is on the will, and where was Kiama that day?

halima/638667dd.speaker: halima
halima/638667dd.text: Killed in the study, dragged to the stairs. The floor polish kept the record.

halima/60fe4a14.speaker: halima
halima/60fe4a14.text: No fall injuries. She didn't die on the stairs.

halima/e24643b1.speaker: halima
halima/e24643b1.text: The doorstop went into the soak-pit. She didn't.

halima/fb236946.speaker: halima
halima/fb236946.text: Her car at eight, her phone at the estate, the hospital copies in her shredder, her print in the doorstop. That will hold.

halima/e43866e1.speaker: halima
halima/e43866e1.text: Gakuya was drinking in Nyeri town all evening.

halima/91fa97f1.speaker: halima
halima/91fa97f1.text: Gichuhi took her bribe, but he was in Nanyuki.

halima/ac34ffc1.speaker: halima
halima/ac34ffc1.text: A ridged brass coffee bean, and a fall that never happened.

halima/681c111f.speaker: halima
halima/681c111f.text: A fall down stairs breaks wrists and bruises arms. She has neither.

halima/44867375.speaker: halima
halima/44867375.text: A walking stick doesn't leave a ridged wound.

halima/4c6cec36.speaker: halima
halima/4c6cec36.text: An objection on Thursday, my office on Friday. She couldn't let Veronica reach either.

halima/12fb5332.speaker: halima
halima/12fb5332.text: The tout was paid in full on 2 April.

halima/7f9ec977.speaker: halima
halima/7f9ec977.text: A man in a coma does not sign wills. And a witness who doesn't exist doesn't witness them.

halima/d346fe2e.speaker: halima
halima/d346fe2e.text: The 2019 will is in Advocate Wairagu's strongroom, sealed.

halima/fd84e0e4.speaker: halima
halima/fd84e0e4.text: The stamp is real ink. That's the worse problem.

halima/84ac84ea.speaker: halima
halima/84ac84ea.text: Doreen's own stamp. Mvua rented a real advocate. That's worse than a fake one.

halima/4ea25b5c.speaker: halima
halima/4ea25b5c.text: Mvua made the oval MV seal, yes. But this impression is a real advocate's stamp.

halima/3b1fb14b.speaker: halima
halima/3b1fb14b.text: Read Ayugi's report on the impression again.

c071-p_kaltuma/26858571.speaker: c071-p_kaltuma
c071-p_kaltuma/26858571.text: I fed the dogs at half past five and went home. I was home all night.

c071-p_kaltuma/cb2fe3be.speaker: c071-p_kaltuma
c071-p_kaltuma/cb2fe3be.text: I don't remember picking up the stick. I never touched it.

c071-p_kaltuma/c8054ff8.speaker: c071-p_kaltuma
c071-p_kaltuma/c8054ff8.text: I went back to beg for Jillo. The dogs know me. I fed them so they'd be quiet. He said Friday, the police.

c071-p_jillo/87f0435b.speaker: c071-p_jillo
c071-p_jillo/87f0435b.text: I never sold the boss's goats.

c071-p_jillo/27cf7016.speaker: c071-p_jillo
c071-p_jillo/27cf7016.text: I sold them. I owed money to men who don't wait. My sister called me at night crying and said 'it's finished'. I thought she meant my job.

c071-p_dahir/fe937fd5.speaker: c071-p_dahir
c071-p_dahir/fe937fd5.text: We fought over a truck. I was on the Garissa road.

c071-p_yasin/94f5fded.speaker: c071-p_yasin
c071-p_yasin/94f5fded.text: I was in Nairobi. Father argued with everyone about money. He never hurt anyone.

c071-p_yasin/f28d8f32.speaker: c071-p_yasin
c071-p_yasin/f28d8f32.text: Father carried it everywhere. Kaltuma moved it every day to sweep. Only he and Kaltuma have gate keys.

c071-p_safiya/e4b8846d.speaker: c071-p_safiya
c071-p_safiya/e4b8846d.text: Those dogs. Let me tell you about those dogs.

c072-p_loice/63ebae51.speaker: c072-p_loice
c072-p_loice/63ebae51.text: I was at home all night. I didn't see Ekal after Friday. And Sibiloi Fresh doesn't worry me. My fishermen are loyal.

c072-p_loice/1839c5c0.speaker: c072-p_loice
c072-p_loice/1839c5c0.text: I was at home all night. I didn't see Ekal after Friday.

c072-p_loice/dfdf56a9.speaker: c072-p_loice
c072-p_loice/dfdf56a9.text: Sibiloi Fresh doesn't worry me. My fishermen are loyal.

c072-p_loice/cfae0815.speaker: c072-p_loice
c072-p_loice/cfae0815.text: I went to talk business. He laughed at me in front of my own debts. That's all I'll say.

c072-p_loice/faf4265f.speaker: c072-p_loice
c072-p_loice/faf4265f.text: Thirty-eight of them owe me, Thirty-eight.

c072-p_lomulen/dcbfe707.speaker: c072-p_lomulen
c072-p_lomulen/dcbfe707.text: We went out together at eight. The wind turned the boat over and he went in. I swam to shore.

c072-p_lomulen/f253625c.speaker: c072-p_lomulen
c072-p_lomulen/f253625c.text: I was drunk. I never went to the beach. When they found him I was afraid they'd say I left him alone. I said the first thing.

c072-p_lokol/09028e9b.speaker: c072-p_lokol
c072-p_lokol/09028e9b.text: The boat was our father's. We fought about it. I was at a wedding.

c072-p_joyce/fcf31a01.speaker: c072-p_joyce
c072-p_joyce/fcf31a01.text: He accused me of a shortfall. I found the money. I was at the mission.

c072-p_joyce/7bb282f4.speaker: c072-p_joyce
c072-p_joyce/7bb282f4.text: Loice came to the co-op on Saturday shouting that Ekal would starve the shore.

c073-p_lekishon/22b2a370.speaker: c073-p_lekishon
c073-p_lekishon/22b2a370.text: I went to her homestead at half past six to talk. She was cooking. Then I drove to the lodge bar.

c073-p_lekishon/c7025ecd.speaker: c073-p_lekishon
c073-p_lekishon/c7025ecd.text: I never raised my rungu to her.

c073-p_lekishon/cbfbaff2.speaker: c073-p_lekishon
c073-p_lekishon/cbfbaff2.text: I went to the lugga. I wanted her to say it to my face, without the women. She said it. I have nothing more.

c073-p_moses/36c13f68.speaker: c073-p_moses
c073-p_moses/36c13f68.text: Lekishon came in at six and drank all evening.

c073-p_moses/769f74a1.speaker: c073-p_moses
c073-p_moses/769f74a1.text: He came at half past seven. He sent me two thousand and said, 'If they ask, it was six.' I didn't know what for.

c073-p_mueni/ba360587.speaker: c073-p_mueni
c073-p_mueni/ba360587.text: She took my lodge order fairly. I was at church.

c073-p_victor/155f0ded.speaker: c073-p_victor
c073-p_victor/155f0ded.text: She complained about me to head office. She was right. I was suspended on Friday. I didn't leave the lodge.

c073-p_nolari/047d8b75.speaker: c073-p_nolari
c073-p_nolari/047d8b75.text: I can tell you her day. I can tell you it to the minute.

c074-p_dabaso/0b6eebe2.speaker: c074-p_dabaso
c074-p_dabaso/0b6eebe2.text: I will translate for you, Amani. I left Boru at nine, healthy. I took my flask home.

c074-p_dabaso/dc10f745.speaker: c074-p_dabaso
c074-p_dabaso/dc10f745.text: I left Boru at nine, healthy. I took my flask home.

c074-p_dabaso/55bf65b5.speaker: c074-p_dabaso
c074-p_dabaso/55bf65b5.text: Page eleven? Torn out by the company's people when they broke into the office in May.

c074-p_dabaso/ca153d7d.speaker: c074-p_dabaso
c074-p_dabaso/ca153d7d.text: I've never taken a shilling from Waso Range.

c074-p_dabaso/f29e6936.speaker: c074-p_dabaso
c074-p_dabaso/f29e6936.text: That flask held tea. Only tea.

c074-p_dabaso/4ab17137.speaker: c074-p_dabaso
c074-p_dabaso/4ab17137.text: Dabaso looks at the tally sheets in Hawo's handwriting, 212 to 41, and puts his beads away.

c074-p_dabaso/2a69b5cf.speaker: c074-p_dabaso
c074-p_dabaso/2a69b5cf.text: Three million shillings. My cows died in the drought, Amani. All of them. Boru had ninety camels and his pride.

c074-p_kennedy/f6f7600b.speaker: c074-p_kennedy
c074-p_kennedy/f6f7600b.text: Waso Range never paid anyone on the committee.

c074-p_kennedy/da70e15d.speaker: c074-p_kennedy
c074-p_kennedy/da70e15d.text: The payment came from a facilitation account in Nairobi. I was told the minutes were 'sorted'. I don't ask how things are sorted.

c074-p_galgalo/a4233609.speaker: c074-p_galgalo
c074-p_galgalo/a4233609.text: I argued with my father. I was in Isiolo. I never signed anything with Waso Range.

c074-p_galgalo/34c8c54d.speaker: c074-p_galgalo
c074-p_galgalo/34c8c54d.text: I argued with my father. I was in Isiolo.

c074-p_galgalo/734bd444.speaker: c074-p_galgalo
c074-p_galgalo/734bd444.text: I never signed anything with Waso Range.

c074-p_galgalo/06346f0c.speaker: c074-p_galgalo
c074-p_galgalo/06346f0c.text: I signed for my share. Two hundred thousand. Father would have disowned me. I didn't kill him.

c074-p_mercy/9d1626de.speaker: c074-p_mercy
c074-p_mercy/9d1626de.text: I filed what the secretary brought me. I was in Meru.

c074-p_mercy/18318850.speaker: c074-p_mercy
c074-p_mercy/18318850.text: The registration file was withdrawn by Nairobi. That happens. It's never happened twice in a month before.

c075-p_aliyo/c05c0d5d.speaker: c075-p_aliyo
c075-p_aliyo/c05c0d5d.text: He didn't stop at my kiosk last night. I heard brakes screaming and men shouting at the bend: bandits.

c075-p_aliyo/28f2195e.speaker: c075-p_aliyo
c075-p_aliyo/28f2195e.text: He stopped. He laughed about the children on the road. My son was on the road. I've waited nine years for him to stop at my kiosk and laugh.

c075-p_abduba/f9d34d05.speaker: c075-p_abduba
c075-p_abduba/f9d34d05.text: Bandits stopped us at Logologo earlier and threatened the boss. They followed us.

c075-p_abduba/75e388ad.speaker: c075-p_abduba
c075-p_abduba/75e388ad.text: The owner told me to say bandits. The insurance pays for bandits. I wasn't even in the lorry. Boss dropped me in town at six to see my girl.

c075-p_murithi/f1c0ff63.speaker: c075-p_murithi
c075-p_murithi/f1c0ff63.text: The lorry was serviced. I was in Isiolo.

c075-p_murithi/813c35b5.speaker: c075-p_murithi
c075-p_murithi/813c35b5.text: Yes, I told the boy to say bandits. I'm ashamed. I've lost a driver and I was thinking of insurance.

c075-p_ogom/f35fab18.speaker: c075-p_ogom
c075-p_ogom/f35fab18.text: She called me at nine last night. She said, 'It's done. Lokho can rest.' I thought she meant she'd finished mourning.

c076-p_dennis/55b5f34f.speaker: c076-p_dennis
c076-p_dennis/55b5f34f.text: I dropped her at her gate at a quarter to eight. She walked in. Then I went back to the stage.

c076-p_dennis/ee733e3f.speaker: c076-p_dennis
c076-p_dennis/ee733e3f.text: I never touched her bag. Anyone could have put it in my room.

c076-p_dennis/d5603b09.speaker: c076-p_dennis
c076-p_dennis/d5603b09.text: I asked her to give me time. She said Monday. I didn't mean to... I don't want to say any more.

c076-p_kevin/e5f4e943.speaker: c076-p_kevin
c076-p_kevin/e5f4e943.text: Dennis was with me at the stage from a quarter to eight.

c076-p_kevin/3b329c16.speaker: c076-p_kevin
c076-p_kevin/3b329c16.text: He called at nine past eight and said, 'If anyone asks, I was with you from quarter to eight.' I'm his guarantor. If his bike goes, I pay. I said yes.

c076-p_mary/299eea9e.speaker: c076-p_mary
c076-p_mary/299eea9e.text: The float was full every night.

c076-p_mary/883cef4b.speaker: c076-p_mary
c076-p_mary/883cef4b.text: I took a little, a few hundred at a time, for my mother's medicine. I was going to put it back. I was at choir.

c076-p_ekeno/f228f919.speaker: c076-p_ekeno
c076-p_ekeno/f228f919.text: We fought about fees. I was on the bus to Kakuma.

c077-p_shanko/aee270c8.speaker: c077-p_shanko
c077-p_shanko/aee270c8.text: Ubah left at dawn on Thursday to drive to North Horr. I warned her about the sand.

c077-p_shanko/82319684.speaker: c077-p_shanko
c077-p_shanko/82319684.text: I gave her nothing but camel milk.

c077-p_shanko/d6567a4f.speaker: c077-p_shanko
c077-p_shanko/d6567a4f.text: She was going to put my son in prison for a child the elders had already settled. The family forgave. The camels were paid. Why should Marsabit undo what the elders did?

c077-p_arero/051e0932.speaker: c077-p_arero
c077-p_arero/051e0932.text: I never hit any child. The boy fell from a cart.

c077-p_arero/5d4ed1fe.speaker: c077-p_arero
c077-p_arero/5d4ed1fe.text: I hit him. At the watering point, in the dusk. I've seen him every night since. My mother arranged everything.

c077-p_peter/c14495d7.speaker: c077-p_peter
c077-p_peter/c14495d7.text: Shanko paid me fifty thousand. I changed the form. I've been waiting for someone to notice for a year.

c077-p_elema/9431e5b1.speaker: c077-p_elema
c077-p_elema/9431e5b1.text: We accepted the elders' settlement. My son is with God.

c077-p_elema/d6d61fd8.speaker: c077-p_elema
c077-p_elema/d6d61fd8.text: The bowser hit him. Everyone knew. If the law wants to know how my son died, I want to know too.

c078-p_nakiru/8e1e947f.speaker: c078-p_nakiru
c078-p_nakiru/8e1e947f.text: I finished in the kitchen at nine and went to bed. I was only Mr. Wanyonyi's cook.

c078-p_nakiru/b93c1aa3.speaker: c078-p_nakiru
c078-p_nakiru/b93c1aa3.text: The paddle broke weeks ago. I burned it for firewood.

c078-p_nakiru/5a5487c2.speaker: c078-p_nakiru
c078-p_nakiru/5a5487c2.text: Three years. He was going to burn them in front of me like rubbish. I wanted my letters. That's all I'll say about that night.

c078-p_sarah/25a2db3c.speaker: c078-p_sarah
c078-p_sarah/25a2db3c.text: I left Lokichar on Wednesday afternoon. I came back this morning when the head teacher called me.

c078-p_sarah/7f05c80c.speaker: c078-p_sarah
c078-p_sarah/7f05c80c.text: I stayed to see her. I walked past at nine. The kitchen was lit and a woman was in there working. Ronald's window was dark. I went back to the lodge and cried.

c078-p_collins/c3d7966f.speaker: c078-p_collins
c078-p_collins/c3d7966f.text: I was disappointed about the post. I was at the bar watching the match.

c078-p_collins/b7768253.speaker: c078-p_collins
c078-p_collins/b7768253.text: Lokaale was with me. Don't tell the head teacher.

c078-p_lokaale/0a31b2fd.speaker: c078-p_lokaale
c078-p_lokaale/0a31b2fd.text: I patrolled the compound all night.

c078-p_lokaale/8dc16dee.speaker: c078-p_lokaale
c078-p_lokaale/8dc16dee.text: I went to watch the match. I came back at half past four and smelled smoke at five.

c078-p_pauline/1c610dc6.speaker: c078-p_pauline
c078-p_pauline/1c610dc6.text: I was at home with my husband. With the power out I didn't go anywhere.

c079-p_mahat/a920a520.speaker: c079-p_mahat
c079-p_mahat/a920a520.text: I sat with my brother in casualty until morning. I never went near the lab.

c079-p_mahat/e8226494.speaker: c079-p_mahat
c079-p_mahat/e8226494.text: My brother made one mistake. That sample was ten years of his life. I asked her nicely first.

c079-p_yusuf/2a1d58a4.speaker: c079-p_yusuf
c079-p_yusuf/2a1d58a4.text: I hadn't been drinking. The old man walked into the road.

c079-p_yusuf/23c3d0ed.speaker: c079-p_yusuf
c079-p_yusuf/23c3d0ed.text: I was drunk. I killed Mzee Bonsa. My brother kept saying 'I'll fix it.' I was asleep from four with the drip.

c079-p_adano/2703772f.speaker: c079-p_adano
c079-p_adano/2703772f.text: I patrolled. Nobody went into the annex.

c079-p_adano/b8b76c50.speaker: c079-p_adano
c079-p_adano/b8b76c50.text: Mahat called and sent five thousand. He said a family matter, his brother's papers. I opened the side door at twenty to four and went to the gate. I didn't know.

c079-p_fatma/5531fc85.speaker: c079-p_fatma
c079-p_fatma/5531fc85.text: We argued about rotas. I was at home.

c079-p_daniel/2bad6a26.speaker: c079-p_daniel
c079-p_daniel/2bad6a26.text: We were finished. I was in camp.

c080-p_emojong/bfa7b1f1.speaker: c080-p_emojong
c080-p_emojong/bfa7b1f1.text: My client is a senior civil servant on official duty. No comment.

c080-p_emojong/e9670640.speaker: c080-p_emojong
c080-p_emojong/e9670640.text: You think I'm the desk. I'm a drawer, Detective. Drawers get opened. Desks don't." Advocate Kiprop ends the interview.

c080-p_emojong/91599c7d.speaker: c080-p_emojong
c080-p_emojong/91599c7d.text: I left the registry at eight with archive boxes and drove straight to the guesthouse.

c080-p_emojong/7f6e4ee1.speaker: c080-p_emojong
c080-p_emojong/7f6e4ee1.text: Every file I've touched is accounted for in the dispatch book.

c080-p_emojong/f171a8d0.speaker: c080-p_emojong
c080-p_emojong/f171a8d0.text: I never saw Abdia after five.

c080-p_emojong/a0431889.speaker: c080-p_emojong
c080-p_emojong/a0431889.text: I have never handled the team's binding equipment.

c080-p_emojong/ce70026b.speaker: c080-p_emojong
c080-p_emojong/ce70026b.text: My client has nothing to add.

c080-p_emojong/d8c3ffb4.speaker: c080-p_emojong
c080-p_emojong/d8c3ffb4.text: The ministry will account for its files.

c080-p_emojong/7ae13d88.speaker: c080-p_emojong
c080-p_emojong/7ae13d88.text: For the first time he doesn't answer at once. Advocate Kiprop puts a hand on his sleeve.

c080-p_guracha/29ff7430.speaker: c080-p_guracha
c080-p_guracha/29ff7430.text: Every file that left this registry had a dispatch note and a line in the book.

c080-p_guracha/cec56ff9.speaker: c080-p_guracha
c080-p_guracha/cec56ff9.text: Nairobi said the team was urgent and I should pre-sign dispatch forms so they wouldn't wait for me. I signed twenty. I didn't think. Abdia asked me about the missing files last week and I told her not to make trouble.

c080-p_omar/c4f05364.speaker: c080-p_omar
c080-p_omar/c4f05364.text: The vehicle was parked at the guesthouse all weekend.

c080-p_omar/82b3222f.speaker: c080-p_omar
c080-p_omar/82b3222f.text: Mr. Emojong asked for the key at seven on Friday and gave me ten thousand. He said a private errand, don't write it. He brought it back at half past nine. There was murram dust on the tyres.

c080-p_jattani/05b0d463.speaker: c080-p_jattani
c080-p_jattani/05b0d463.text: Our families argued about the bride price. I was in Garissa.

c080-p_jattani/7f52e300.speaker: c080-p_jattani
c080-p_jattani/7f52e300.text: She said there was a man at work who was 'eating files'. She laughed about it.

c080-p_kennedy/ba09ffd8.speaker: c080-p_kennedy
c080-p_kennedy/ba09ffd8.text: I came to give her the minutes copy. I was at the police station until seven.

c080-p_kennedy/193c5c86.speaker: c080-p_kennedy
c080-p_kennedy/193c5c86.text: She told me a Nairobi officer had already taken the Garba Tula file. She was angry.

c080-p_florence/b06794d1.speaker: c080-p_florence
c080-p_florence/b06794d1.text: I scan. Mr. Emojong keeps the drawers.

c080-p_florence/96bdbe54.speaker: c080-p_florence
c080-p_florence/96bdbe54.text: Sometimes he'd tell me to rescan a file and the first scan number would be gone. I thought it was the software.

rc-kennedy-mulwa/5b6ee4c4.speaker: rc-kennedy-mulwa
rc-kennedy-mulwa/5b6ee4c4.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

rc-kennedy-mulwa/5e0637aa.speaker: rc-kennedy-mulwa
rc-kennedy-mulwa/5e0637aa.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

rc-kennedy-mulwa/55c2cb6b.speaker: rc-kennedy-mulwa
rc-kennedy-mulwa/55c2cb6b.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

rc-julius-emojong/f9fa0715.speaker: rc-julius-emojong
rc-julius-emojong/f9fa0715.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

rc-julius-emojong/3c6f8cc7.speaker: rc-julius-emojong
rc-julius-emojong/3c6f8cc7.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

rc-julius-emojong/8e4d9bbc.speaker: rc-julius-emojong
rc-julius-emojong/8e4d9bbc.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

mwalimu/f76eafb6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f76eafb6.text: Who rides to Bula Pesa at night, Amani? Ask the boda stage.

mwalimu/39a4172d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/39a4172d.text: Dropped in the lane at 21:05. A call to her brother at 21:42.

mwalimu/61379828.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/61379828.text: In his own yard, by the door.

mwalimu/2d0ea6f2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2d0ea6f2.text: Somebody fed the dogs after dark.

mwalimu/b780d874.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b780d874.text: The bowls were full again, and her wool is in the stick.

mwalimu/c8ce12bf.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c8ce12bf.text: A stick he carried every day, with no prints at all.

mwalimu/79642785.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/79642785.text: Wiped, and a rounded wooden blow.

mwalimu/752c11cc.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/752c11cc.text: Read Saturday's sale register. Whose mark?

mwalimu/0711be4e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0711be4e.text: Hussein's goats, Jillo's hands. Friday, the police.

mwalimu/febd179b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/febd179b.text: Ask the neighbour about the dogs. Then write down what didn't happen.

mwalimu/9e580512.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9e580512.text: They bark at everyone. Last night, nothing.

mwalimu/2a0a6732.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2a0a6732.text: What didn't happen is evidence too. ...Amani.

halima/076bed8b.speaker: halima
halima/076bed8b.text: Fed at half past five, back at five past nine, a call to her brother at twenty to ten. The dogs never said a word.

halima/707fe395.speaker: halima
halima/707fe395.text: After midnight is too late. Read the post-mortem.

halima/87831d44.speaker: halima
halima/87831d44.text: When did the boda drop her in the lane?

halima/a8d9fda1.speaker: halima
halima/a8d9fda1.text: His own yard, by his own door. Yes.

halima/c0d886e6.speaker: halima
halima/c0d886e6.text: She came in by the lane. She didn't kill him in it.

halima/a797a6d7.speaker: halima
halima/a797a6d7.text: Dahir was on the Garissa road. The killing wasn't.

halima/9f1d6eab.speaker: halima
halima/9f1d6eab.text: The dogs' friend, a key, a purple shawl in the lane and on the stick. That will hold.

halima/5c1db5b2.speaker: halima
halima/5c1db5b2.text: Jillo was at the camp with two herders.

halima/0062eb67.speaker: halima
halima/0062eb67.text: Godana has no key, and the dogs bark at him.

halima/18f6aebe.speaker: halima
halima/18f6aebe.text: A rounded wooden blow, and his own stick wiped clean.

halima/65286778.speaker: halima
halima/65286778.text: A metal bar doesn't leave wool in a wooden grip.

halima/734ed0a1.speaker: halima
halima/734ed0a1.text: Stock theft carries years. A sister had one night.

halima/bf807420.speaker: halima
halima/bf807420.text: Forty-seven thousand in his drawer. Not a robbery.

halima/64cb352b.speaker: halima
halima/64cb352b.text: She was paid to the end of the month.

halima/dac4e033.speaker: halima
halima/dac4e033.text: The dogs that bark at the bread boy said nothing. They knew who came. Write that on a dotted card, Amani.

halima/cd0d09a9.speaker: halima
halima/cd0d09a9.text: No climbing marks says nobody climbed. It doesn't say who the dogs knew.

halima/a07b35cf.speaker: halima
halima/a07b35cf.text: Nothing was stolen. That's against a robbery, not for it.

mwalimu/cf7c5bfc.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/cf7c5bfc.text: Ask Ewoi how old the drag marks are, Amani.

mwalimu/6269154c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6269154c.text: Dead by ten. Dragged after the wind dropped.

mwalimu/0adc460c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0adc460c.text: Why sweep fresh sand over a store floor?

mwalimu/e644ffb9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e644ffb9.text: The stain, and the tracks starting at the door.

mwalimu/32377cf8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/32377cf8.text: Who loses most from Friday's agreement?

mwalimu/a7a45157.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a7a45157.text: Her sandals on the beach, his blood on her mat.

mwalimu/fdd95b21.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fdd95b21.text: Count the clubs on the rack.

mwalimu/b7f92189.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b7f92189.text: Eleven, and a heavy wooden blow.

mwalimu/47050d23.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/47050d23.text: Her advances repaid in cash, and her hold on the shore gone.

mwalimu/59323969.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/59323969.text: What does a boat look like after a windy night's fishing? Ask Akuwom.

mwalimu/bdc104cc.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bdc104cc.text: Dry nets, no register line, no crust.

halima/85fc58d5.speaker: halima
halima/85fc58d5.text: Signed Friday, argued Sunday evening, dead by ten, the driver warned at twelve past four, the body dragged once the wind dropped.

halima/bae81945.speaker: halima
halima/bae81945.text: The boat never went out at eight. Ask the register.

halima/663324f6.speaker: halima
halima/663324f6.text: When were the tracks made? Ask Ewoi about the edges.

halima/9c54a090.speaker: halima
halima/9c54a090.text: The store, with sand thrown over his blood. Yes.

halima/95d32849.speaker: halima
halima/95d32849.text: He went into the water dead. He didn't die there.

halima/8cded445.speaker: halima
halima/8cded445.text: The tracks start at the store door.

halima/c7ea1574.speaker: halima
halima/c7ea1574.text: Her sandals on the beach, his blood on her mat, the club behind her sacks. That will hold.

halima/285dd426.speaker: halima
halima/285dd426.text: Lomulen slept on a bar bench.

halima/ec72f53e.speaker: halima
halima/ec72f53e.text: Akuwom closed the book at half past seven and went home.

halima/d9b67cc5.speaker: halima
halima/d9b67cc5.text: The oars are clean and the gunwale too.

halima/7f6c59c1.speaker: halima
halima/7f6c59c1.text: One point four million in advances, and a notice saying pay her in cash. That's her hold on half the shore, gone.

halima/2e67e8ea.speaker: halima
halima/2e67e8ea.text: Dry nets, no line in the book, no crust on his collar. He never left the shore.

halima/eff8e5fb.speaker: halima
halima/eff8e5fb.text: No water in his lungs says dead before the water. Not that he never went out.

halima/fa6e4ad5.speaker: halima
halima/fa6e4ad5.text: No drifted sand says when he was moved, not where he'd been.

mwalimu/09ab4675.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/09ab4675.text: Her day ran to the minute, Amani. Ask Nolari what should have happened at dusk.

mwalimu/adc84a7d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/adc84a7d.text: She left at a quarter past five. Nothing after that happened.

mwalimu/c1ba6f51.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c1ba6f51.text: At the lugga, one filled. Her footprints in.

mwalimu/ecdab927.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ecdab927.text: A pickup with a worn tyre came to the crossing.

mwalimu/cb5084f6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/cb5084f6.text: A rounded wooden blow. What do men carry here?

mwalimu/1c2eb304.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1c2eb304.text: What did Nashipai change on Friday?

mwalimu/7e8f921a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7e8f921a.text: The money into the group's own account. Then his threat.

mwalimu/061b3dde.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/061b3dde.text: Look at what she did every evening. Then at what she didn't do.

mwalimu/2feb0b1a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2feb0b1a.text: No fire, no milking, no meal.

mwalimu/db7fa59b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/db7fa59b.text: Cold ash. Unmilked goats. Write down what's missing.

halima/1c0ecfb6.speaker: halima
halima/1c0ecfb6.text: A contract on Friday, a threat that night, water at a quarter past five, and never home. He bought his six o'clock at ten past eight.

halima/f8117608.speaker: halima
halima/f8117608.text: She wasn't cooking at half past six. Look at the hearth.

halima/449a35e4.speaker: halima
halima/449a35e4.text: When did his first drink ring through the till?

halima/36f7ac7c.speaker: halima
halima/36f7ac7c.text: The lugga, where she drew water every afternoon. Yes.

halima/887d9c6f.speaker: halima
halima/887d9c6f.text: She never came home. The homestead isn't the scene.

halima/598997d7.speaker: halima
halima/598997d7.text: The bar is where he bought his alibi.

halima/eda27d9a.speaker: halima
halima/eda27d9a.text: His threat, his tyre at the crossing, her blood in his rungu. That will hold.

halima/8a5d310f.speaker: halima
halima/8a5d310f.text: Moses was behind the bar from four.

halima/efbf6429.speaker: halima
halima/efbf6429.text: Nolari milked in full view of the women.

halima/0aae5ceb.speaker: halima
halima/0aae5ceb.text: A rounded wooden blow, and a washed rungu. Yes.

halima/9d16c985.speaker: halima
halima/9d16c985.text: The lugga is flat sand. She didn't fall against anything.

halima/a71ab147.speaker: halima
halima/a71ab147.text: Six years of a "manager's share", ended in front of the whole village. That's why.

halima/32757f44.speaker: halima
halima/32757f44.text: Her phone and her money are on her.

halima/c53e680f.speaker: halima
halima/c53e680f.text: No fire, no milking, no meal. She never came home from the water.

halima/5495caac.speaker: halima
halima/5495caac.text: One empty jerrycan says she was interrupted, not when.

halima/cf2c0c8a.speaker: halima
halima/cf2c0c8a.text: Nothing taken says not a robbery. It doesn't tell me the time.

mwalimu/ec881ac1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ec881ac1.text: This strip starts in April, Amani. Follow the vote, then the money.

mwalimu/6c427a2a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6c427a2a.text: Three million on 12 May. A red flask at eight on Thursday.

mwalimu/2873d41c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2873d41c.text: Ask Mama Darmi again, without a translator.

mwalimu/d9980263.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d9980263.text: Tea in his sitting room, eight to nine.

mwalimu/95d4c65b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/95d4c65b.text: Where does Dabaso always leave his flask?

mwalimu/9eb68311.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9eb68311.text: Not at the office this time. And the poison in its seal.

mwalimu/55affdc0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/55affdc0.text: What was signed out of the dip store on Wednesday?

mwalimu/641937ba.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/641937ba.text: Dip concentrate to "D.T.", and organophosphate poisoning.

mwalimu/70dc07da.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/70dc07da.text: Compare what the county holds with Hawo's tally.

mwalimu/08e580df.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/08e580df.text: Lay this year's stamp beside the one on the minutes.

mwalimu/9f45bf10.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9f45bf10.text: Grazing Committee: the old name, retired.

mwalimu/e628c441.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e628c441.text: Count the pages. Then check the door.

mwalimu/8e310e6d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8e310e6d.text: Page eleven gone, the lock never forced.

halima/63213d13.speaker: halima
halima/63213d13.text: A vote in April, a payment and a filing in May, a torn page found on Tuesday, a flask on Thursday. He planned the poisoning around the assembly.

halima/d55304e3.speaker: halima
halima/d55304e3.text: When did the money arrive, and when were the minutes filed?

halima/3114a0ea.speaker: halima
halima/3114a0ea.text: His own sitting room, his cousin's tea. Yes.

halima/e7ab3e1b.speaker: halima
halima/e7ab3e1b.text: The dip came from the store. He drank it at home.

halima/3a4796fa.speaker: halima
halima/3a4796fa.text: The minutes were forged in Isiolo. He died in Garba Tula.

halima/dde02382.speaker: halima
halima/dde02382.text: His flask, his dip bottle, his old stamp, his three million. And he translated for you all morning.

halima/f59ca275.speaker: halima
halima/f59ca275.text: Kennedy was at dinner in Isiolo.

halima/9d34cb7e.speaker: halima
halima/9d34cb7e.text: Mama Darmi drinks no camel milk, and nursed him all night.

halima/f6e781ef.speaker: halima
halima/f6e781ef.text: Cattle dip in camel-milk tea. Yes.

halima/2ef28d1c.speaker: halima
halima/2ef28d1c.text: Mama Darmi ate the same meal and was well.

halima/2e9658ed.speaker: halima
halima/2e9658ed.text: The book was going to the assembly on Saturday and the police after. That's why.

halima/1bace0cd.speaker: halima
halima/1bace0cd.text: Galgalo was bought, but he was in Isiolo.

halima/40358508.speaker: halima
halima/40358508.text: The cousins were close. No feud.

halima/1aba2a6d.speaker: halima
halima/1aba2a6d.text: A stamp retired with the old law. Nobody uses it but the man who kept it.

halima/b63ccfc8.speaker: halima
halima/b63ccfc8.text: The tally sheets are Hawo's and the chief's.

halima/acc23eb8.speaker: halima
halima/acc23eb8.text: The date is real. Look at the stamp.

halima/570cded1.speaker: halima
halima/570cded1.text: A torn page and an unforced door. It came out from inside.

halima/9e3fe7a0.speaker: halima
halima/9e3fe7a0.text: A missing flask says who brought the tea, not who tore the book.

halima/08fd2ca1.speaker: halima
halima/08fd2ca1.text: The file was withdrawn by Nairobi. That's another hand.

mwalimu/fb802bbb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fb802bbb.text: His last call tells you where he stopped, Amani.

mwalimu/5de96419.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5de96419.text: Tea at 20:31. His phone dead at 20:44.

mwalimu/2e325e7c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2e325e7c.text: Where was the lorry before it rolled? Ask Ewoi.

mwalimu/b80026f9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b80026f9.text: Parked on the shoulder by the kiosk.

mwalimu/3afe2e96.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3afe2e96.text: One set of footprints went to the cab and came back.

mwalimu/ac92eab0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ac92eab0.text: Her sandals, and his blood on her poker.

mwalimu/7ab7f7d8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7ab7f7d8.text: Look at the handbrake and the engine switch.

mwalimu/93e07935.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/93e07935.text: Handbrake down, engine off, and a blow before the crash.

mwalimu/e753cd0c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e753cd0c.text: Look at the old photographs in the transporters' office.

mwalimu/d8d2b4ac.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d8d2b4ac.text: A dent repaired the day after a child died at the bend.

mwalimu/83bc72c9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/83bc72c9.text: What should a lorry losing its brakes leave on the road?

mwalimu/43126b37.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/43126b37.text: No skid marks. No bleeding in the injuries.

mwalimu/4d2442ed.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4d2442ed.text: Two files on one desk. Close both, Amani.

halima/85c74786.speaker: halima
halima/85c74786.text: A child nine years ago, a repair the next day. Logologo at five past seven, tea at half past eight, the drop by quarter to nine.

halima/753002ad.speaker: halima
halima/753002ad.text: Midnight is Aliyo's story. His phone died at 20:44.

halima/d7a08bc7.speaker: halima
halima/d7a08bc7.text: When did he call his wife, and from where?

halima/a922cc35.speaker: halima
halima/a922cc35.text: Outside her kiosk, on the shoulder, before the lorry ever moved.

halima/12f4a0f8.speaker: halima
halima/12f4a0f8.text: He was dead before the drop. Read the post-mortem.

halima/1e1af608.speaker: halima
halima/1e1af608.text: Her kiosk, her sandals to his door, his blood on her poker. That will hold. Nine years of it.

halima/1a0cf254.speaker: halima
halima/1a0cf254.text: Abduba was in town with his girl.

halima/0325d882.speaker: halima
halima/0325d882.text: Ogom was at the camp. She called him there.

halima/3c8bd02f.speaker: halima
halima/3c8bd02f.text: A narrow iron bar, then a handbrake let off. Yes.

halima/b1cd12d4.speaker: halima
halima/b1cd12d4.text: No bandits for two years, and no other tyre tracks.

halima/86118df1.speaker: halima
halima/86118df1.text: A red lorry with a white stripe, and a dent repaired the next day.

halima/7babf1de.speaker: halima
halima/7babf1de.text: The owner wanted insurance money, not a dead driver.

halima/85fd9e45.speaker: halima
halima/85fd9e45.text: No skid, no fault, no blood in the injuries. He never braked because he couldn't.

halima/b7c70784.speaker: halima
halima/b7c70784.text: No turnboy says he drove alone, not why he didn't brake.

halima/63684fbe.speaker: halima
halima/63684fbe.text: No bandits clears the herders. It doesn't tell me why the lorry rolled.

mwalimu/2a54ab2a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2a54ab2a.text: What did he do the moment it was over, Amani?

mwalimu/9d6b5229.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9d6b5229.text: Float closed at 19:28. A call to Kevin at 20:09.

mwalimu/cfb74613.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/cfb74613.text: Where did the motorbike stop? Ewoi knows.

mwalimu/4eedf14b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4eedf14b.text: One boda stood on the laga track. Her shoes two steps from it.

mwalimu/1c667cc9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1c667cc9.text: Look at the racks at the stage. Whose is bare?

mwalimu/f8e596d1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f8e596d1.text: Her cash bag under his mattress, with his prints on the clasp.

mwalimu/10d8e7ef.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/10d8e7ef.text: Follow the bike out of the laga.

mwalimu/1ccc5a0c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1ccc5a0c.text: A 3 cm moulded strap. Her hair in the buckle.

mwalimu/1399c144.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/1399c144.text: Ask the chairman for the loan file.

mwalimu/97ba366f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/97ba366f.text: Repossess Monday. And his page burned in a tin.

mwalimu/dd5e684d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/dd5e684d.text: Napeyo swept at six. What should be in her yard if he dropped Akai at the gate?

mwalimu/0f8bf385.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0f8bf385.text: No footprints. No tyre. The pattern is perfect.

mwalimu/922ad210.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/922ad210.text: A broom is a good witness. Better than most.

halima/668afba8.speaker: halima
halima/668afba8.text: A note on Friday, a broom at six, the float closed at 19:28, and the alibi bought at 20:09. She died in between.

halima/eb8d969e.speaker: halima
halima/eb8d969e.text: She was dead long before ten.

halima/2550edf0.speaker: halima
halima/2550edf0.text: What did he do at nine minutes past eight?

halima/d351b6db.speaker: halima
halima/d351b6db.text: On the laga track, out of sight of the road, where the bike stood.

halima/6315fbdd.speaker: halima
halima/6315fbdd.text: Nobody crossed her yard. She never got to the gate.

halima/5a3a4f67.speaker: halima
halima/5a3a4f67.text: The shop was tidy when Mary locked it.

halima/48354e82.speaker: halima
halima/48354e82.text: His lift, his strap, her bag under his mattress with his prints on it.

halima/4c48155f.speaker: halima
halima/4c48155f.text: Kevin was at the stage all evening; he only lied for him.

halima/1f9f6c92.speaker: halima
halima/1f9f6c92.text: A 3 cm moulded strap, with her hair in the buckle.

halima/423e1494.speaker: halima
halima/423e1494.text: Her scarf is soft and a centimetre wide. The mark is three.

halima/41bb1811.speaker: halima
halima/41bb1811.text: One hundred and eighty thousand owed and the bike gone on Monday. And his page burned in a tin.

halima/455c9ed9.speaker: halima
halima/455c9ed9.text: Mary's few hundred were never discovered.

halima/db93779b.speaker: halima
halima/db93779b.text: Kevin feared paying, but he never left the stage.

halima/f70f6209.speaker: halima
halima/f70f6209.text: Napeyo's broom is the best witness in Lodwar. Nobody crossed that yard.

halima/f2fa05ed.speaker: halima
halima/f2fa05ed.text: A missing bag tells me she was robbed, not where she went.

halima/85d35b1d.speaker: halima
halima/85d35b1d.text: The strap tells me how. I asked whether she got home.

mwalimu/bc9ece58.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bc9ece58.text: When did her phone leave Kalacha, Amani?

mwalimu/86551de2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/86551de2.text: 01:08. And she was dead by then.

mwalimu/b679a407.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b679a407.text: Look at her bed. Count the pillowcases.

mwalimu/62abb8c8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/62abb8c8.text: Dead before the car left. Two pillows, no cases.

mwalimu/bdbf7afd.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bdbf7afd.text: Sit in the driver's seat. Who fits?

mwalimu/a0482d62.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a0482d62.text: A short woman's seat, her sandals, her pillowcase.

mwalimu/4add506a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4add506a.text: Dr. Chebii says it wasn't the heat. What was it?

mwalimu/136edfd0.speaker: mwalimu
