mwalimu/136edfd0.text: A sedative in the blood, then a pillow.

mwalimu/f78b14b1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f78b14b1.text: Report Thursday. And Shanko's son drove the bowser.

mwalimu/7ea577ab.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7ea577ab.text: Put the referral form under a raking light.

mwalimu/c5fd8db0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c5fd8db0.text: What does someone stranded in the Chalbi do first?

mwalimu/9739ec22.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9739ec22.text: Full bottles. No digging. Not one footprint of hers.

mwalimu/ae3e7050.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ae3e7050.text: Abdia Golicha. Remember the name. ...I'm sorry. You already did.

halima/62b6e890.speaker: halima
halima/62b6e890.text: A child a year ago, a draft at ten past seven, dinner, and a car leaving at eight minutes past one with a dead woman in it.

halima/1b74eff8.speaker: halima
halima/1b74eff8.text: Dawn is Shanko's word. The mast says 01:08.

halima/2b8b5eb2.speaker: halima
halima/2b8b5eb2.text: In a guesthouse bed, not in the desert.

halima/38804b9f.speaker: halima
halima/38804b9f.text: She was dead before the car moved.

halima/95e01124.speaker: halima
halima/95e01124.text: North Horr is where Shanko said she was going.

halima/c48a620c.speaker: halima
halima/c48a620c.text: Her tablets in the blood, her pillowcase in the nose, her sandals walking home. And a seat set for a short woman.

halima/8ffeeb07.speaker: halima
halima/8ffeeb07.text: Arero was at North Horr with the bowser.

halima/a6aacce8.speaker: halima
halima/a6aacce8.text: Peter sat up with a sick child all night.

halima/16f027d2.speaker: halima
halima/16f027d2.text: A sedative, yes, but the eyes and lips say a pillow.

halima/f4986827.speaker: halima
halima/f4986827.text: "Report to OCS Marsabit Thursday." She didn't live to Thursday.

halima/f23a5aa0.speaker: halima
halima/f23a5aa0.text: Elema accepted the settlement and never met her.

halima/ca9539ab.speaker: halima
halima/ca9539ab.text: The cash is in the glovebox.

halima/8de1dff2.speaker: halima
halima/8de1dff2.text: RTA under "fall", in another ink. The register is a lie, but this is the paper that was changed.

halima/bff24eaf.speaker: halima
halima/bff24eaf.text: The register was written once, in one ink. It's false, not altered.

halima/0971b844.speaker: halima
halima/0971b844.text: Peter's own notes are the truth.

halima/b9c5766b.speaker: halima
halima/b9c5766b.text: Full bottles, clean wheels, no footprints of hers. She never sat by that car alive.

halima/ad458913.speaker: halima
halima/ad458913.text: No check-out tells me Shanko lied, not where Ubah died.

halima/54d1f985.speaker: halima
halima/54d1f985.text: No call for help? Nobody calls when they're already dead.

mwalimu/0712cb7b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0712cb7b.text: His phone melted, Amani. The network didn't.

mwalimu/4ca5c366.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4ca5c366.text: "I'm coming" at 21:58. The fire around two.

mwalimu/69c6ecc8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/69c6ecc8.text: By the sofa in his own sitting room.

mwalimu/6fb1d972.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6fb1d972.text: Count the paddles in the kitchen.

mwalimu/b2236006.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b2236006.text: The only kitchen key, his blood on the grip, her letters in her room.

mwalimu/491c0f1e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/491c0f1e.text: Dr. Chebii says broad and flat, and wooden.

mwalimu/3b4228a7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3b4228a7.text: A porridge paddle in the stove ash.

mwalimu/b83e5cb7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b83e5cb7.text: What did he keep under the bed?

mwalimu/fb0e6cd4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fb0e6cd4.text: "Don't burn them." And a transfer home.

mwalimu/a37e1448.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a37e1448.text: What should a living man's lungs show after a fire?

mwalimu/9eb98a93.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9eb98a93.text: No soot. No carbon monoxide. He wasn't breathing.

mwalimu/bf771f90.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bf771f90.text: The furious ones are usually only furious.

halima/72f4f9d6.speaker: halima
halima/72f4f9d6.text: A transfer on Monday, a long call on Tuesday, a wife in a lodge on Wednesday. "I'm coming" at two minutes to ten, and the fire four hours later.

halima/7a738f52.speaker: halima
halima/7a738f52.text: He breathed no smoke. He was dead long before five.

halima/ee4531fb.speaker: halima
halima/ee4531fb.text: In his own sitting room, by the sofa she later set alight.

halima/55a9642c.speaker: halima
halima/55a9642c.text: She took the paddle back to the kitchen. He died in House 4.

halima/d96deb3a.speaker: halima
halima/d96deb3a.text: Sarah was in the lodge by ten to ten.

halima/062b865f.speaker: halima
halima/062b865f.text: Her text, her paddle, her letters in her room, his blood on the grip.

halima/546c4395.speaker: halima
halima/546c4395.text: Sarah lied about leaving, and then she was in the lodge drinking tea.

halima/e34739ab.speaker: halima
halima/e34739ab.text: The watchman was at the football.

halima/8bc943a8.speaker: halima
halima/8bc943a8.text: A broad flat wooden blade, and a cloth soaked in his own lamp's paraffin.

halima/a6f3f6c5.speaker: halima
halima/a6f3f6c5.text: No soot. He breathed no smoke.

halima/293bb38d.speaker: halima
halima/293bb38d.text: A jembe leaves a narrow edge. This was broad and flat.

halima/b37cdc3f.speaker: halima
halima/b37cdc3f.text: "Don't burn them." Three years, a transfer, and a fire for the letters.

halima/4e2f6111.speaker: halima
halima/4e2f6111.text: The wallet and laptop are untouched.

halima/c9ee9a15.speaker: halima
halima/c9ee9a15.text: Collins lost the post four years ago, and he was at the bar.

halima/c00261ef.speaker: halima
halima/c00261ef.text: Clean lungs. A man breathes in a fire if he can. He couldn't.

halima/77c7aeeb.speaker: halima
halima/77c7aeeb.text: An unburned wick tells me the fuel was poured. It doesn't tell me he was dead. Find me the lungs.

halima/63bb3137.speaker: halima
halima/63bb3137.text: An empty tin tells me why, not when.

mwalimu/c136e685.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c136e685.text: Money moves on the clock too, Amani.

mwalimu/284ef49e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/284ef49e.text: Five thousand at 03:25. A side door at 03:40.

mwalimu/75d0a52d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/75d0a52d.text: At the fridge, in the annex. Where she lay.

mwalimu/8673d10a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8673d10a.text: Ask the other night nurse who came back with wet sleeves.

mwalimu/dab3b2f6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/dab3b2f6.text: Mahat at 03:55. The label in his car. His print under the trigger.

mwalimu/821d1cf8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/821d1cf8.text: Something left its bracket in the corridor.

mwalimu/86a1729d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/86a1729d.text: His brother's blood alcohol, after a fatal crash.

mwalimu/e599416a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e599416a.text: Lay the custody book over the rack.

mwalimu/8caaee71.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8caaee71.text: B4 logged at 02:10. Empty. No signature.

mwalimu/4984f760.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4984f760.text: Lay the book over the rack. Always.

halima/bfbf087e.speaker: halima
halima/bfbf087e.text: A crash at half past one, a sample at ten past two, a refusal at three, five thousand shillings at twenty-five past, and a side door at twenty to four.

halima/5c23d450.speaker: halima
halima/5c23d450.text: Five o'clock is the slip story. Her last fridge entry was 03:38.

halima/0f00789a.speaker: halima
halima/0f00789a.text: When did the watchman open the door?

halima/d72ff76e.speaker: halima
halima/d72ff76e.text: In the annex, by the fridge she was guarding.

halima/1a8328de.speaker: halima
halima/1a8328de.text: The extinguisher came from the corridor. She died in the annex.

halima/e90cb1d4.speaker: halima
halima/e90cb1d4.text: His car carried the label away, not her.

halima/bfb61b5b.speaker: halima
halima/bfb61b5b.text: His call, his five thousand, his print under the trigger, and her blood on his car mat with the label.

halima/c9b205bd.speaker: halima
halima/c9b205bd.text: Yusuf was asleep on a drip.

halima/99716968.speaker: halima
halima/99716968.text: Adano opened a door and went to the gate.

halima/4cfeaaae.speaker: halima
halima/4cfeaaae.text: A curved steel base, wiped, and a jerrycan emptied to make a slip.

halima/4439e172.speaker: halima
halima/4439e172.text: The bench edge is square; the wound is curved.

halima/6c4f6c36.speaker: halima
halima/6c4f6c36.text: Eleven beers and a dead man on the road. That sample was his brother's ten years.

halima/5cb33cb7.speaker: halima
halima/5cb33cb7.text: The drugs cupboard is locked and full.

halima/758a373c.speaker: halima
halima/758a373c.text: Fatma was at home; Daniel was in camp.

halima/7e57cf53.speaker: halima
halima/7e57cf53.text: Logged into B4 at 02:10, never signed out, never on the vehicle. Someone took it.

halima/0b9461cb.speaker: halima
halima/0b9461cb.text: An unforced door tells me someone had a key, not what they took.

halima/d03996ef.speaker: halima
halima/d03996ef.text: No sink tells me the water was poured. What was missing from the fridge?

mwalimu/6b679098.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6b679098.text: Ask Galma who came back in, Amani.

mwalimu/8680820c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8680820c.text: Emojong back in at 18:25. Her phone off at 18:41.

mwalimu/be54c536.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/be54c536.text: Look at the floor of the digitisation room. Then follow the vehicle.

mwalimu/04a50b10.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/04a50b10.text: Her blood in the grout. Her body at km 32.

mwalimu/b6713528.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b6713528.text: A government vehicle that went nowhere has 64 km on it.

mwalimu/0644066c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0644066c.text: He bought the key from Omar. His print is under the punch.

mwalimu/fefc201f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fefc201f.text: Something on the scanning table has been wiped.

mwalimu/a798cb31.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a798cb31.text: A narrow steel edge: the binding punch.

mwalimu/aa3aa640.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/aa3aa640.text: Thirty-seven "not back". All thirty-seven in his drawer.

mwalimu/d7c6bb67.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d7c6bb67.text: Put a used dispatch note under a raking light.

mwalimu/ef9f2b9c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ef9f2b9c.text: The typing lies on top of the signature.

mwalimu/9097ecad.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9097ecad.text: Run a ruler down the scan numbers.

mwalimu/2e74ebad.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2e74ebad.text: Thirty-seven gaps, thirty-seven empty shelf places, no dispatch lines.

mwalimu/5bc06e94.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5bc06e94.text: Ask Nakuru for the slip from case 40.

mwalimu/fd096b89.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fd096b89.text: J.E./SRO/0331. Your father's field book, eleven years ago.

halima/f84ec7fd.speaker: halima
halima/f84ec7fd.text: A field book eleven years ago, a list begun three months ago, a phone call on Thursday, a phone switched off at 18:41, and a trolley at five to eight.

halima/7ad07b19.speaker: halima
halima/7ad07b19.text: Five o'clock is what the guard assumed. The book says otherwise.

halima/19b56500.speaker: halima
halima/19b56500.text: When did he come back in?

halima/5c52d24a.speaker: halima
halima/5c52d24a.text: Killed at his own scanning table. Carried out in his archive box, and left 32 km out in a murram pit.

halima/1f992d52.speaker: halima
halima/1f992d52.text: Her blood is in the digitisation room's grout.

halima/ba855910.speaker: halima
halima/ba855910.text: Drawer 14 held her notebook and her phone. Not her.

halima/163f6551.speaker: halima
halima/163f6551.text: Back in at 18:25, out at 19:55 with a trolley, 64 km on a vehicle that went nowhere, and his print under the punch.

halima/e4bd7dd0.speaker: halima
halima/e4bd7dd0.text: Guracha signed blank forms; he was at the mosque.

halima/348ee28f.speaker: halima
halima/348ee28f.text: Omar sold a key; he was at the guesthouse.

halima/588407ff.speaker: halima
halima/588407ff.text: A narrow steel edge. The punch, wiped.

halima/997ae377.speaker: halima
halima/997ae377.text: Drawer edges are rolled. The wound is narrow.

halima/e28e2ad2.speaker: halima
halima/e28e2ad2.text: Thirty-seven files, "not back". She wrote them down because nobody else would.

halima/0dea5f9c.speaker: halima
halima/0dea5f9c.text: Jattani was in Garissa, and the families settled on Thursday.

halima/91a21765.speaker: halima
halima/91a21765.text: Kennedy was at the police station helping us.

halima/aabccbd4.speaker: halima
halima/aabccbd4.text: Signed blank, typed later. The registrar signed a lie in advance and Nairobi filled it in.

halima/892407bc.speaker: halima
halima/892407bc.text: The scan log is honest. It's the gaps that talk.

halima/f65b2ca3.speaker: halima
halima/f65b2ca3.text: The requisition is genuinely his. That's why it convicts him.

halima/d66ba2f6.speaker: halima
halima/d66ba2f6.text: Thirty-seven numbers missing, thirty-seven holes on the shelf, not one line in the book. Removed from inside.

halima/dd8b2aed.speaker: halima
halima/dd8b2aed.text: The vehicle and his phone belong to the WHERE, Amani. I asked about the files.

halima/53a1c683.speaker: halima
halima/53a1c683.text: Her phone not moving tells me where she died. Not what was taken.

halima/28e8dd25.speaker: halima
halima/28e8dd25.text: J.E./SRO/0331. The same hand withdrew your father's field book.

halima/bbc26d14.speaker: halima
halima/bbc26d14.text: Doreen's stamp was Mvua's tool. This is the registry's own officer code.

halima/c1af9026.speaker: halima
halima/c1af9026.text: Read Ayugi's report on the two withdrawals.

c081-p_lilian/3bee88b4.speaker: c081-p_lilian
c081-p_lilian/3bee88b4.text: I went to bed at ten and didn't leave my room all night. Stephen came in drunk and went to bed.

c081-p_lilian/b8b59b6c.speaker: c081-p_lilian
c081-p_lilian/b8b59b6c.text: I have never had a key to his room. Only Mzee and Rehema.

c081-p_lilian/d17bd771.speaker: c081-p_lilian
c081-p_lilian/d17bd771.text: I've washed that old man, fed him, counted his tablets for six years. And on Monday he would give the land to strangers' children.

c081-p_brian/77759963.speaker: c081-p_brian
c081-p_brian/77759963.text: I never touched Grandpa's key. I was in Westlands all afternoon.

c081-p_brian/61ca2398.speaker: c081-p_brian
c081-p_brian/61ca2398.text: Mum asked me to get a copy. She said one day he'd fall behind that door and we couldn't reach him. On Sunday morning she called and said 'throw it away'. I threw it in the old latrine. I knew then.

c081-p_stephen/212ccd39.speaker: c081-p_stephen
c081-p_stephen/212ccd39.text: I was at my club until one in the morning.

c081-p_stephen/529259cc.speaker: c081-p_stephen
c081-p_stephen/529259cc.text: I came home at half past ten and begged him for two acres. He said no. I went to my room and drank. I didn't go near him after that, I swear it.

c081-p_rehema/41a23009.speaker: c081-p_rehema
c081-p_rehema/41a23009.text: I lent the key to Brian for the glasses and he brought it back.

c081-p_mbithi/8e55d1fc.speaker: c081-p_mbithi
c081-p_mbithi/8e55d1fc.text: His death kills the sale. The trust gains nothing from it.

c082-p_felix/5308a37e.speaker: c082-p_felix
c082-p_felix/5308a37e.text: I came home from the office at seven and didn't go out again.

c082-p_felix/28ba59c5.speaker: c082-p_felix
c082-p_felix/28ba59c5.text: I have never touched my wife's second phone. I didn't know it existed.

c082-p_felix/167729a7.speaker: c082-p_felix
c082-p_felix/167729a7.text: I found the phone on Sunday. I read six months of my marriage in an evening. I wanted to see his face when I told him I knew.

c082-p_josphat/a14f2e1d.speaker: c082-p_josphat
c082-p_josphat/a14f2e1d.text: I drove Bwana home from the office at seven. He never left.

c082-p_josphat/c0ad6c8a.speaker: c082-p_josphat
c082-p_josphat/c0ad6c8a.text: He told me, 'Drive to Kileleshwa, wait in the lane, lights off.' He came back with his hands in his pockets. In the morning he said, 'You drove me home at seven.' Eight years I've driven him. I said it. I knew it was wrong when I saw the news.

c082-p_nyokabi/ba763be2.speaker: c082-p_nyokabi
c082-p_nyokabi/ba763be2.text: Andrew was my trainer. Nothing more. I was at book club.

c082-p_nyokabi/97bedae2.speaker: c082-p_nyokabi
c082-p_nyokabi/97bedae2.text: Yes. Six months. But I didn't send that text. My second phone was in my drawer at home. I was at the café with eleven women.

c082-p_ian/4b8eef33.speaker: c082-p_ian
c082-p_ian/4b8eef33.text: I owed him money. I was in Mombasa.

c082-p_grace/f65c6757.speaker: c082-p_grace
c082-p_grace/f65c6757.text: Andrew always opened that side door himself. Nobody else has a key.

c083-p_priya/93f153e5.speaker: c083-p_priya
c083-p_priya/93f153e5.text: My client has been bereaved and is not a suspect. No comment.

c083-p_priya/fd2a677d.speaker: c083-p_priya
c083-p_priya/fd2a677d.text: I went home at six and didn't come back.

c083-p_priya/cc0f14d2.speaker: c083-p_priya
c083-p_priya/cc0f14d2.text: Kevin was stealing. Wakesho found out and fired him.

c083-p_priya/a64df1d6.speaker: c083-p_priya
c083-p_priya/a64df1d6.text: She was alive when I left.

c083-p_priya/3576ca3e.speaker: c083-p_priya
c083-p_priya/3576ca3e.text: I came back for a file. That's enough, Priya. You're thorough, Detective. Be careful who notices.

c083-p_priya/34a360c4.speaker: c083-p_priya
c083-p_priya/34a360c4.text: Priya looks at the ledger ticks in Wakesho's pencil and says nothing. Kiprop writes a note.

c083-p_kevin/a3373db7.speaker: c083-p_kevin
c083-p_kevin/a3373db7.text: I never went near that building on Thursday.

c083-p_kevin/b486c5af.speaker: c083-p_kevin
c083-p_kevin/b486c5af.text: I went for my final dues at half past six. I left at seven. I lied because I knew they'd say it was me. They always say it's the one who was fired.

c083-p_hezron/0203d4bf.speaker: c083-p_hezron
c083-p_hezron/0203d4bf.text: Kevin Otieno came in at five past nine. I wrote it myself.

c083-p_hezron/d5e54725.speaker: c083-p_hezron
c083-p_hezron/d5e54725.text: Madam Priya gave me five thousand and said write Kevin came for his tools, for HR to close his file. I didn't know. I swear I didn't know what for.

c083-p_lenny/12742f25.speaker: c083-p_lenny
c083-p_lenny/12742f25.text: I owed her maintenance. I was on the Mombasa bus.

c084-p_desmond/61667883.speaker: c084-p_desmond
c084-p_desmond/61667883.text: Joyce made the drinks. I only carried the tray.

c084-p_desmond/70015027.speaker: c084-p_desmond
c084-p_desmond/70015027.text: I made nothing special for anyone.

c084-p_desmond/a56a968b.speaker: c084-p_desmond
c084-p_desmond/a56a968b.text: Joyce has been with us fifteen years,

c084-p_marcus/b36f8255.speaker: c084-p_marcus
c084-p_marcus/b36f8255.text: I'm a friend of the family. Chloe and I are on good terms.

c084-p_marcus/cd8b293d.speaker: c084-p_marcus
c084-p_marcus/cd8b293d.text: It was a business arrangement. She had money, I had a video. Nobody got hurt.

c084-p_chloe/3ad1dbde.speaker: c084-p_chloe
c084-p_chloe/3ad1dbde.text: In June I drove home drunk and hit a parked car. Marcus filmed it. I told Grandpa on Saturday night. All of it. He held my hand and said, 'Leave it with me.'

c084-p_fiona/78a298a9.speaker: c084-p_fiona
c084-p_fiona/78a298a9.text: I sat beside Beatrice. I didn't see who took which glass.

c084-p_fiona/112b0b0b.speaker: c084-p_fiona
c084-p_fiona/112b0b0b.text: Daddy was strange all morning. He went to the hedge twice.

c084-p_tobias/37e867f4.speaker: c084-p_tobias
c084-p_tobias/37e867f4.text: I inherit her house. I was in Kisumu.

c085-p_allan/590d241d.speaker: c085-p_allan
c085-p_allan/590d241d.text: I jumped in at about ten past two for a dare. Faisal wasn't there. I never saw him by the pool.

c085-p_allan/f8afabe3.speaker: c085-p_allan
c085-p_allan/f8afabe3.text: I never laid a hand on him.

c085-p_allan/817c084b.speaker: c085-p_allan
c085-p_allan/817c084b.text: He was going to put my name on a list on Tuesday. My contract has a morality clause. I'd lose everything.

c085-p_michelle/357a1e4e.speaker: c085-p_michelle
c085-p_michelle/357a1e4e.text: I was in the house all night. I never went to the pool. I lost the nail dancing.

c085-p_michelle/82e28f44.speaker: c085-p_michelle
c085-p_michelle/82e28f44.text: I was in the house all night. I never went to the pool.

c085-p_michelle/3c41e9e4.speaker: c085-p_michelle
c085-p_michelle/3c41e9e4.text: I switched the camera off. That's all I did. I didn't think Allan… I held his hands. He was grabbing the edge.

c085-p_michelle/15bc012e.speaker: c085-p_michelle
c085-p_michelle/15bc012e.text: Michelle looks at her own hand on the table, at the bare ring finger, and closes it.

c085-p_kaps/7d47bcff.speaker: c085-p_kaps
c085-p_kaps/7d47bcff.text: I never left the decks after midnight.

c085-p_kaps/f252ac6d.speaker: c085-p_kaps
c085-p_kaps/f252ac6d.text: I went to my car to cool off after the fee fight. I was gone forty minutes. I didn't want you thinking what you're thinking.

c085-p_hamza/a0d2aad6.speaker: c085-p_hamza
c085-p_hamza/a0d2aad6.text: He threw me out of my own company. I wasn't there.

c085-p_sasha/43196c30.speaker: c085-p_sasha
c085-p_sasha/43196c30.text: I threw a drink at him and left.

c086-p_mwamburi/d9711b5d.speaker: c086-p_mwamburi
c086-p_mwamburi/d9711b5d.text: Dr. Mwamburi is a witness, not a suspect. No comment.

c086-p_mwamburi/3363ea48.speaker: c086-p_mwamburi
c086-p_mwamburi/3363ea48.text: I left at seven and never came back.

c086-p_mwamburi/77dda724.speaker: c086-p_mwamburi
c086-p_mwamburi/77dda724.text: Every stent we billed was fitted.

c086-p_mwamburi/db1bcce5.speaker: c086-p_mwamburi
c086-p_mwamburi/db1bcce5.text: Mrs. Mumbua was alive when I left.

c086-p_mwamburi/5504b41f.speaker: c086-p_mwamburi
c086-p_mwamburi/5504b41f.text: I came back for a file. You've cost my clients a great deal this month, Detective.

c086-p_mwamburi/79a265a3.speaker: c086-p_mwamburi
c086-p_mwamburi/79a265a3.text: My client will address billing with the insurer.

c086-p_benson/16aeeafb.speaker: c086-p_benson
c086-p_benson/16aeeafb.text: Every procedure in my log was performed.

c086-p_benson/ba3b9975.speaker: c086-p_benson
c086-p_benson/ba3b9975.text: Daktari told me what to write. The lab was closed and I wrote stents. I didn't hurt anyone.

c086-p_elvis/87a25d4e.speaker: c086-p_elvis
c086-p_elvis/87a25d4e.text: I wasn't at that plaza last night.

c086-p_elvis/da2edba3.speaker: c086-p_elvis
c086-p_elvis/da2edba3.text: I stood outside with my sign like every Tuesday. I left at seven. I lost my car key at that reception two weeks ago and they told me it wasn't there when I asked.

c086-p_joan/cd30bb89.speaker: c086-p_joan
c086-p_joan/cd30bb89.text: Grace thought I was hiding files. I was at choir.

c086-p_joan/62a1de9e.speaker: c086-p_joan
c086-p_joan/62a1de9e.text: Daktari told me to give her only the copies. She insisted on originals.

c087-p_ifrah/ba9a3ca9.speaker: c087-p_ifrah
c087-p_ifrah/ba9a3ca9.text: I came to the club at eight for practice. I never went into the tack room. And you should read this.

c087-p_ifrah/ffc98d1c.speaker: c087-p_ifrah
c087-p_ifrah/ffc98d1c.text: I came to the club at eight for practice. I never went into the tack room.

c087-p_ifrah/ba7537b3.speaker: c087-p_ifrah
c087-p_ifrah/ba7537b3.text: I have never held a seam ripper in my life.

c087-p_ifrah/51fda53f.speaker: c087-p_ifrah
c087-p_ifrah/51fda53f.text: Gerald sold my boy a broken horse and swore it was safe. My son will never walk. Tajeu… Tajeu was never supposed to be on that horse.

c087-p_gerald/3df21687.speaker: c087-p_gerald
c087-p_gerald/3df21687.text: I never knew Shamal had any problem. That fall was bad luck.

c087-p_gerald/3686c58e.speaker: c087-p_gerald
c087-p_gerald/3686c58e.text: I had the report. I sold him anyway. It was a lot of money. It was meant for me. It should have been me.

c087-p_nicholas/e7d941ca.speaker: c087-p_nicholas
c087-p_nicholas/e7d941ca.text: I never went near the tack room.

c087-p_nicholas/dede103e.speaker: c087-p_nicholas
c087-p_nicholas/dede103e.text: I borrowed a bridle without asking. I was embarrassed. That's all.

c087-p_susan/786fe15c.speaker: c087-p_susan
c087-p_susan/786fe15c.text: Gerald gets migraines after a whisky night. He had one on Friday.

c088-p_nduku/527b74d4.speaker: c088-p_nduku
c088-p_nduku/527b74d4.text: My client is a grieving widow. No comment.

c088-p_nduku/5c57bfd6.speaker: c088-p_nduku
c088-p_nduku/5c57bfd6.text: I never touched his money or his watch.

c088-p_nduku/999af203.speaker: c088-p_nduku
c088-p_nduku/999af203.text: He packed a bag in front of me and said the house was his company's. Twenty years. I don't remember picking up the award. Nothing further.

c088-p_nduku/aa5bd515.speaker: c088-p_nduku
c088-p_nduku/aa5bd515.text: Nduku looks at the nursery video, at Nekesa singing to her daughter, and turns her face away.

c088-p_nekesa/5fb66b7a.speaker: c088-p_nekesa
c088-p_nekesa/5fb66b7a.text: I never took anything. I was with the baby.

c088-p_nekesa/fae4d059.speaker: c088-p_nekesa
c088-p_nekesa/fae4d059.text: I'm from Bungoma. If they say a nanny stole, who'll believe me?

c088-p_mwikali/5c1d53d8.speaker: c088-p_mwikali
c088-p_mwikali/5c1d53d8.text: Nduku didn't call me that night.

c088-p_mwikali/e111e3dd.speaker: c088-p_mwikali
c088-p_mwikali/e111e3dd.text: She called at half eleven crying. She said, 'Jeff fell. I've done something terrible. I'll handle it.' I told her to call the police. She said no.

c088-p_sheila/d67ddac3.speaker: c088-p_sheila
c088-p_sheila/d67ddac3.text: Jeff wasn't coming to me. We'd ended it.

c088-p_sheila/0dfcd856.speaker: c088-p_sheila
c088-p_sheila/0dfcd856.text: He was coming. I booked the taxi. I waited until two. I thought he'd changed his mind.

c088-p_tom/a2cdc7cc.speaker: c088-p_tom
c088-p_tom/a2cdc7cc.text: Jeff told me on Friday he was leaving her. He was afraid of how she'd take it.

c089-p_mukami/eff8aca8.speaker: c089-p_mukami
c089-p_mukami/eff8aca8.text: I never went onto the service terrace. Tracy was drunk; Ezekiel told me she climbed the railing.

c089-p_mukami/6898da86.speaker: c089-p_mukami
c089-p_mukami/6898da86.text: I never touched her camera or her card.

c089-p_mukami/3f8b0566.speaker: c089-p_mukami
c089-p_mukami/3f8b0566.text: She was going to end my company over one bad night in March. Nobody died in March. I just wanted the card.

c089-p_ezekiel/815c0f0e.speaker: c089-p_ezekiel
c089-p_ezekiel/815c0f0e.text: Tracy was very drunk. I saw her climb the railing to get a skyline photo.

c089-p_ezekiel/061db3c9.speaker: c089-p_ezekiel
c089-p_ezekiel/061db3c9.text: Madam came to me shaking and said Tracy fell and the camera mustn't show her there. I deleted it. She sent me sixty thousand at quarter past one. I'm not a killer. I'm a man who did what his boss said.

c089-p_duncan/9cbf43dc.speaker: c089-p_duncan
c089-p_duncan/9cbf43dc.text: We were under capacity all night.

c089-p_duncan/1b6a5788.speaker: c089-p_duncan
c089-p_duncan/1b6a5788.text: Four hundred and twelve. The promoter pays us per head. I didn't want a fine. That girl didn't fall because of a crowd.

c089-p_morris/2ce96a60.speaker: c089-p_morris
c089-p_morris/2ce96a60.text: We argued about getting back together. I left before midnight.

c089-p_wesley/e7b617f3.speaker: c089-p_wesley
c089-p_wesley/e7b617f3.text: I wanted my photos deleted. I was at the bar.

c090-p_mwita/49d12564.speaker: c090-p_mwita
c090-p_mwita/49d12564.text: I was at home on Sunday night. My company's records show nothing unusual. I've never spoken to Advocate Kiprop except about building security.

c090-p_mwita/86cb30ba.speaker: c090-p_mwita
c090-p_mwita/86cb30ba.text: I was at home on Sunday night. My company's records show nothing unusual.

c090-p_mwita/684af011.speaker: c090-p_mwita
c090-p_mwita/684af011.text: I've never spoken to Advocate Kiprop except about building security.

c090-p_mwita/53feb7a2.speaker: c090-p_mwita
c090-p_mwita/53feb7a2.text: I didn't set foot on the ninth floor that night.

c090-p_mwita/d87f1be8.speaker: c090-p_mwita
c090-p_mwita/d87f1be8.text: I secure buildings for people who pay. I don't ask who's paying the people who pay me.

c090-p_cynthia/b83b0702.speaker: c090-p_cynthia
c090-p_cynthia/b83b0702.text: I never touched Prosecutor Abdi's desk. I don't know any Major.

c090-p_cynthia/b44c5e7f.speaker: c090-p_cynthia
c090-p_cynthia/b44c5e7f.text: He paid me to tell him what files she was working on. A year. Then on Friday he said bring the pen and some paper she'd touched. On Sunday he gave me a SIM and told me what to type. I didn't know he'd kill her. I thought it was to embarrass Madam Halima.

c090-p_patrick/448a54e1.speaker: c090-p_patrick
c090-p_patrick/448a54e1.text: Prosecutor Abdi signed in at quarter to ten.

c090-p_patrick/fccdcd39.speaker: c090-p_patrick
c090-p_patrick/fccdcd39.text: The Major told me on Monday morning to change it to 21:45 'so the record matches the camera'. I didn't look at the camera. I changed it. On Sunday he also told me the service-lift camera was under maintenance.

c090-p_halima/c294aa61.speaker: c090-p_halima
c090-p_halima/c294aa61.text: I went at nine because someone signing as S.K. asked me to. I left at quarter past. I've never threatened anyone in writing in my life.

c090-p_halima/1ca03b20.speaker: c090-p_halima
c090-p_halima/1ca03b20.text: To you, alone: "Don't be careful with me because you like me. Be careful because they're good at this.

c090-p_kenneth/6caf076a.speaker: c090-p_kenneth
c090-p_kenneth/6caf076a.text: We were splitting the firm. I was in Nanyuki.

c090-p_kenneth/092b9515.speaker: c090-p_kenneth
c090-p_kenneth/092b9515.text: She'd started taking clients I didn't want to know about. That's why I was leaving.

c090-p_lydia/9e05aa80.speaker: c090-p_lydia
c090-p_lydia/9e05aa80.text: She sold my husband out. I was at a vigil.

c090-p_lydia/f2f7d34d.speaker: c090-p_lydia
c090-p_lydia/f2f7d34d.text: Julius told me in remand: 'Sharon is talking.' I thought he meant to the press.

pool-european-f-any-3/35f55f3f.speaker: pool-european-f-any-3
pool-european-f-any-3/35f55f3f.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

pool-european-f-any-3/05a550a9.speaker: pool-european-f-any-3
pool-european-f-any-3/05a550a9.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

pool-european-f-any-3/b9c3a042.speaker: pool-european-f-any-3
pool-european-f-any-3/b9c3a042.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

rc-halima/e4b714fb.speaker: rc-halima
rc-halima/e4b714fb.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

rc-halima/4b872cf5.speaker: rc-halima
rc-halima/4b872cf5.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

rc-halima/d226cca6.speaker: rc-halima
rc-halima/d226cca6.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

mwalimu/50cdc483.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/50cdc483.text: The alarm saw everything that moved inside, Amani.

mwalimu/c791f0da.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c791f0da.text: A key cut at 16:12. The corridor at 23:34.

mwalimu/a9b877d8.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a9b877d8.text: The door was locked. Who could open it?

mwalimu/a2808422.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a2808422.text: His bedroom, behind a mortice lock with two keys.

mwalimu/7055445b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7055445b.text: Who called the boy before he went for the key?

mwalimu/64d9be8b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/64d9be8b.text: Most people who kill don't do it alone. Find who held the door.

mwalimu/a6350d88.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a6350d88.text: Brian had the spare copied. Rehema only lent it.

mwalimu/c8b5b264.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c8b5b264.text: A vet logs his doses. Read where he puts them.

mwalimu/8f54528d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8f54528d.text: Always the stomach. The second mark is in his arm.

mwalimu/4cf1ca20.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4cf1ca20.text: What was he signing on Monday?

mwalimu/c402de35.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c402de35.text: The land, sold to a school. "Look at my family."

mwalimu/23af2a41.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/23af2a41.text: Most people who kill don't do it alone. Have you eaten, Amani?

halima/affe8af9.speaker: halima
halima/affe8af9.text: A call at twenty to four, a key at twelve minutes past, a shouting son at half ten, a sensor at 23:34, and an old man dead before dawn.

halima/d757ba74.speaker: halima
halima/d757ba74.text: One in the morning is Stephen's lie.

halima/40dfaf90.speaker: halima
halima/40dfaf90.text: When did someone stand at his door?

halima/b93a86d6.speaker: halima
halima/b93a86d6.text: The key was cut at the kiosk. He died in his bed.

halima/9dc0c1dd.speaker: halima
halima/9dc0c1dd.text: Stephen shouted in the sitting room. Nobody hurt him there.

halima/88f60e80.speaker: halima
halima/88f60e80.text: Her call, her son's key, the sensor at his door, and his insulin in his arm.

halima/86e5aa5f.speaker: halima
halima/86e5aa5f.text: Brian was behind his own gate in Westlands from nine.

halima/a40db48c.speaker: halima
halima/a40db48c.text: Most people who kill don't do it alone. He held the door open by having it copied.

halima/0be1670f.speaker: halima
halima/0be1670f.text: Rehema lent the key for reading glasses and told you so at once. She didn't know.

halima/0bc3a5ca.speaker: halima
halima/0bc3a5ca.text: Stephen lied for himself, not for her.

halima/9580c334.speaker: halima
halima/9580c334.text: His own pen, in an arm he never used.

halima/606d1e6a.speaker: halima
halima/606d1e6a.text: He logged every dose for six years. Always the stomach.

halima/9162a5c8.speaker: halima
halima/9162a5c8.text: Low blood sugar, and insulin pooled at the arm. Not his heart.

halima/01ab716e.speaker: halima
halima/01ab716e.text: Monday he signed. Saturday night he died. The land stays in the family.

halima/b092581e.speaker: halima
halima/b092581e.text: The trust gains nothing: the sale dies with him.

halima/177d3394.speaker: halima
halima/177d3394.text: Stephen shouted, but he never left his wing.

mwalimu/c80b44b2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c80b44b2.text: Rich men's cars keep diaries, Amani.

mwalimu/081efbc7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/081efbc7.text: Text at 20:12 from Lavington. In the lane 20:52 to 21:20.

mwalimu/28554bd4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/28554bd4.text: Count the clean handles on the rack.

mwalimu/39056099.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/39056099.text: One wiped kettlebell, in his own studio.

mwalimu/9711d005.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9711d005.text: A phone has a holder as well as an owner.

mwalimu/7d4bd475.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7d4bd475.text: His thumb on her phone. His car in the lane.

mwalimu/3465d599.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3465d599.text: Who sat in the car with the lights off?

mwalimu/54227abc.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/54227abc.text: The driver never got out. Then he lied.

mwalimu/043f69cd.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/043f69cd.text: Rounded, heavy, iron. Look at the rack.

mwalimu/b5336076.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b5336076.text: A phone is a thing. Ask who held it.

halima/83911e83.speaker: halima
halima/83911e83.text: A phone found on Sunday, a text at 20:12 from his own house, out at 20:40, in the lane till 21:20, home at 21:33.

halima/d5f2312c.speaker: halima
halima/d5f2312c.text: Seven o'clock is the driver's story.

halima/f7269128.speaker: halima
halima/f7269128.text: Where was the "N." phone when it sent the text?

halima/eb187957.speaker: halima
halima/eb187957.text: In his own studio, among his own kettlebells.

halima/79627946.speaker: halima
halima/79627946.text: The car waited in the lane. The killing was inside.

halima/99992d7d.speaker: halima
halima/99992d7d.text: The text came from the house. He died in Kileleshwa.

halima/7f6a5542.speaker: halima
halima/7f6a5542.text: His car in the lane, his thumb on her phone, the studio's chalk and Andrew's blood on his mat.

halima/af0fd739.speaker: halima
halima/af0fd739.text: Nyokabi was in front of eleven women in Westlands.

halima/37628df4.speaker: halima
halima/37628df4.text: Josphat never got out of the car.

halima/f60bd917.speaker: halima
halima/f60bd917.text: Eight years of loyalty, a lane with the lights off, and a lie the next morning. He knew.

halima/8cf9e314.speaker: halima
halima/8cf9e314.text: Her phone sent it. She didn't. Read the masts.

halima/ee735ed5.speaker: halima
halima/ee735ed5.text: A rounded iron weight, and the only clean handle on the rack.

halima/2c4d33d0.speaker: halima
halima/2c4d33d0.text: A plate has an edge. This wound is rounded.

halima/ca7e944d.speaker: halima
halima/ca7e944d.text: Read the post-mortem: a blow, not his heart.

halima/a95a059a.speaker: halima
halima/a95a059a.text: Six months of his marriage, read in one evening.

halima/46312d1c.speaker: halima
halima/46312d1c.text: The lovers didn't quarrel. She was at book club.

halima/e5e6edb8.speaker: halima
halima/e5e6edb8.text: Ian owed him money from Mombasa.

mwalimu/a0d40580.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a0d40580.text: In a building like that, every card leaves a time, Amani.

mwalimu/32b28931.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/32b28931.text: Kevin down at 19:02. Priya's card in at 21:12, out at 22:04.

mwalimu/76d7819e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/76d7819e.text: Where was she when it started?

mwalimu/ebdb50d5.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ebdb50d5.text: At her own bench, with the mandrel at her feet.

mwalimu/4a0fe95f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4a0fe95f.text: Who could open Kevin's locker after he handed in his key?

mwalimu/6ebd09bc.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6ebd09bc.text: Only the partners had the master key. And her gloves.

mwalimu/cda23001.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/cda23001.text: Narrow and tapered. Look on the floor.

mwalimu/c75089a0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c75089a0.text: Read the pencil ticks in the ledger.

mwalimu/927c8b6a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/927c8b6a.text: Short weights in Priya's batches, and a client leaving with her.

mwalimu/9e70cdf3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9e70cdf3.text: Put the apron under a magnifier. How did the blood get there?

mwalimu/57bb38c6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/57bb38c6.text: Wiped, not spattered. And Kevin had handed in his key.

mwalimu/fcbf9c5e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fcbf9c5e.text: Check before you accuse. They're counting on you not to.

halima/110e2680.speaker: halima
halima/110e2680.text: Ticks on Wednesday, Kevin gone at two minutes past seven, Priya's card in at 21:12 and out at 22:04.

halima/adf807c1.speaker: halima
halima/adf807c1.text: 21:05 is a line Hezron was paid to write.

halima/1c73fb6a.speaker: halima
halima/1c73fb6a.text: When did a card open the barrier?

halima/c2edaa12.speaker: halima
halima/c2edaa12.text: At her own bench, working late.

halima/7bee48b9.speaker: halima
halima/7bee48b9.text: The apron was put in the locker afterwards.

halima/64b064b7.speaker: halima
halima/64b064b7.text: The basement is where she parked.

halima/8c78f1ec.speaker: halima
halima/8c78f1ec.text: Her card in the basement, her master key, her gloves with Wakesho's blood.

halima/64960c09.speaker: halima
halima/64960c09.text: Kevin was home in Kangemi with his door shut.

halima/1ebeca7a.speaker: halima
halima/1ebeca7a.text: Hezron wrote a line. He never left his desk.

halima/1336a1cc.speaker: halima
halima/1336a1cc.text: The hammers hang clean on their pegs.

halima/da1c4f5a.speaker: halima
halima/da1c4f5a.text: A year of short weights, a stolen client, and a lawyer on Friday.

halima/a815cbaa.speaker: halima
halima/a815cbaa.text: Kevin didn't take the gold. Wakesho said so herself.

halima/f52d8f05.speaker: halima
halima/f52d8f05.text: Nobody wears a wiped apron to a killing. And Kevin had handed in his key.

halima/be472a0f.speaker: halima
halima/be472a0f.text: The sign-in line is false, but it was written, not placed. Hezron's lie covers it.

halima/a1b71884.speaker: halima
halima/a1b71884.text: The mandrel is the real weapon.

mwalimu/181993d7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/181993d7.text: Ask Joyce who carried the tray this Sunday, Amani.

mwalimu/7e37f59f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7e37f59f.text: Desmond, at ten to one. Beatrice had a glass before Joyce brought hers.

mwalimu/91ae5f2e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/91ae5f2e.text: Count the ice rings on Sunday's glasses.

mwalimu/9dca4228.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9dca4228.text: One glass without ice, poisoned, drunk at the veranda table.

mwalimu/792e4ade.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/792e4ade.text: Who keeps a jug at the back of the pantry?

mwalimu/96ce73e3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/96ce73e3.text: Only his prints on the jug. And a stripped hedge.

mwalimu/761cd969.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/761cd969.text: "Seeing yellow." Ask Dr. Chebii what does that.

mwalimu/a968ca1a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a968ca1a.text: Why did a young man invite himself to Sunday lunch?

mwalimu/4f94e972.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4f94e972.text: A million shillings, or a video.

mwalimu/38dec1fa.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/38dec1fa.text: Who asked for his juice without ice?

mwalimu/4ec044ff.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4ec044ff.text: Marcus did. Beatrice never takes ice, so Joyce always keeps hers back.

mwalimu/0ebfd302.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0ebfd302.text: The one who died isn't always the one who was meant to.

halima/ae321d08.speaker: halima
halima/ae321d08.text: A crash in June, a demand on Friday, a confession on Saturday, a tray at ten to one, and a death at half past nine.

halima/e1670199.speaker: halima
halima/e1670199.text: Four o'clock is when she felt ill. When did she drink?

halima/3fd78f0a.speaker: halima
halima/3fd78f0a.text: Who carried the tray, and when?

halima/0085845e.speaker: halima
halima/0085845e.text: On the veranda, from a tray he carried himself.

halima/cc3bbbe6.speaker: halima
halima/cc3bbbe6.text: The poison was made in the pantry. She drank it on the veranda.

halima/d3d98acf.speaker: halima
halima/d3d98acf.text: She died at home; she was poisoned at lunch.

halima/1e745576.speaker: halima
halima/1e745576.text: His tray, his jug, his hedge, his sieve. Only his prints on the jug.

halima/af92c9cd.speaker: halima
halima/af92c9cd.text: Marcus was on the phone on the lawn.

halima/5a75e994.speaker: halima
halima/5a75e994.text: Joyce's glasses were all iced, and she never touched the jug.

halima/8c68d035.speaker: halima
halima/8c68d035.text: Oleander, from his own hedge, in one glass of passion juice.

halima/a0c56686.speaker: halima
halima/a0c56686.text: Seven people ate the same lunch.

halima/36c5daa4.speaker: halima
halima/36c5daa4.text: No heart disease. Read the toxicology.

halima/cee41cd6.speaker: halima
halima/cee41cd6.text: A million shillings or the video. "Leave it with me."

halima/048808ae.speaker: halima
halima/048808ae.text: Beatrice never knew there was a video.

halima/a04b0714.speaker: halima
halima/a04b0714.text: One glass without ice, for the man who asked for no ice. The one person who always takes no ice got there first.

halima/1403b142.speaker: halima
halima/1403b142.text: Twenty years of Sunday lunches. Nobody at that table wanted Beatrice dead.

halima/9970d334.speaker: halima
halima/9970d334.text: Chloe always takes ice. She's the one he was protecting.

mwalimu/92ec989b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/92ec989b.text: Even a switched-off camera leaves a log, Amani.

mwalimu/215e7da1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/215e7da1.text: Off at 01:52. Allan back wet at quarter past two.

mwalimu/d12ae77e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d12ae77e.text: Where would two people need to stand to do this?

mwalimu/cb15ff3b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/cb15ff3b.text: At the edge of the deep end.

mwalimu/eb7df7a3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/eb7df7a3.text: Count the hands on him. Then measure them.

mwalimu/581b2012.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/581b2012.text: A big grip with rugby-top fibres, and small hands with acrylic nails.

mwalimu/d50941d6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d50941d6.text: Dr. Chebii says drowning. Ask her about the bruises.

mwalimu/b5a00a31.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b5a00a31.text: Held under by the shoulders and the wrists.

mwalimu/154240e1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/154240e1.text: A lender to famous people keeps a ledger.

mwalimu/6df70f76.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6df70f76.text: Seven million between them, due Monday.

mwalimu/8803432c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8803432c.text: Wilson says the pool camera never stops. It stopped.

mwalimu/7ab664ac.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7ab664ac.text: 01:52 to 02:31, switched off from his own phone.

mwalimu/32f71032.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/32f71032.text: Two hands on the shoulders, two on the wrists. Count the hands.

halima/9de4a7c4.speaker: halima
halima/9de4a7c4.text: An ultimatum on Friday, a camera off at 01:52, a splash at two, a wet rugby player at quarter past, and a taxi for two at 02:45.

halima/c684f143.speaker: halima
halima/c684f143.text: When did the camera go off, and from whose phone?

halima/d560e98d.speaker: halima
halima/d560e98d.text: In the deep end, held under.

halima/c1413296.speaker: halima
halima/c1413296.text: Michelle's gloves came out of the bathroom. Faisal didn't die there.

halima/8f3e24e2.speaker: halima
halima/8f3e24e2.text: The DJ was in the driveway.

halima/8839bb00.speaker: halima
halima/8839bb00.text: Two grips: his on the shoulders, hers on the wrists. She switched the camera off and then she held his hands. That's not helping. That's killing.

halima/d912077f.speaker: halima
halima/d912077f.text: "Allan, helped by Michelle" won't do. She held his wrists while he drowned.

halima/4bf1becc.speaker: halima
halima/4bf1becc.text: The DJ was at his car in the driveway the whole time.

halima/5f65bcd9.speaker: halima
halima/5f65bcd9.text: Held under by four hands until he stopped.

halima/41dc5456.speaker: halima
halima/41dc5456.text: Drunk men drown alone. They don't get bruised from behind.

halima/212f07a2.speaker: halima
halima/212f07a2.text: Seven million shillings between them, and a list going up on Tuesday.

halima/be791d97.speaker: halima
halima/be791d97.text: Hamza never came into the estate.

halima/09178b05.speaker: halima
halima/09178b05.text: Sasha was home by quarter to one.

halima/ed644a9d.speaker: halima
halima/ed644a9d.text: Thirty-nine minutes of nothing, switched off from his own phone. Someone knew his PIN.

halima/92357d10.speaker: halima
halima/92357d10.text: A missing nail tells me who was in the pool, not who switched the camera off.

halima/2ee3c58a.speaker: halima
halima/2ee3c58a.text: The DJ's forty minutes are his alibi, not his guilt.

mwalimu/08009fde.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/08009fde.text: His card tells you when he came back, Amani.

mwalimu/8ac95abc.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8ac95abc.text: In at 20:31. A bang at quarter to nine. Out at 21:15.

mwalimu/e4fb0807.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e4fb0807.text: Where did Eunice hear the stand fall?

mwalimu/20f5b6a0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/20f5b6a0.text: Who holds the key to the lost-and-found box?

mwalimu/b2a316a9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b2a316a9.text: The master ring on his desk, and her blood on his cuff.

mwalimu/4ee9c0e1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4ee9c0e1.text: Something heavy and round was wiped in the corridor.

mwalimu/5753ff96.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5753ff96.text: Read what Grace came to check.

mwalimu/96f955af.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/96f955af.text: 61 stents on days the lab was shut. KSh 38 million.

mwalimu/0570f118.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0570f118.text: Lay the servicing dates over the procedure dates.

mwalimu/ea340c81.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ea340c81.text: Every stent on a day the lab was closed.

mwalimu/96b14aa4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/96b14aa4.text: Where had that fob been for two weeks?

mwalimu/ca0e2213.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ca0e2213.text: In the reception box. It still carries the box's dust.

mwalimu/939ecff1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/939ecff1.text: Fourth floor. Lands House. Look at the faces, Amani. Don't stare.

halima/a47a00b4.speaker: halima
halima/a47a00b4.text: A fob lost two weeks ago, a placard at six, a card back at 20:31, a bang at quarter to nine, and the car park at 21:15.

halima/f4e5dcc0.speaker: halima
halima/f4e5dcc0.text: Grace signed in at half seven. He came back an hour later.

halima/99e1b480.speaker: halima
halima/99e1b480.text: When did Eunice hear the stand fall?

halima/59deaa2b.speaker: halima
halima/59deaa2b.text: In the records room, among the originals she came to see.

halima/d67f214e.speaker: halima
halima/d67f214e.text: The coat was in his office. She died in the records room.

halima/4c694a00.speaker: halima
halima/4c694a00.text: The fob came from reception. She didn't.

halima/e2da962f.speaker: halima
halima/e2da962f.text: His card on the floor, his words to the cleaner, Grace's blood on his cuff.

halima/3603540d.speaker: halima
halima/3603540d.text: Elvis was in South B with his sister.

halima/fe410fbe.speaker: halima
halima/fe410fbe.text: Benson wrote lies in a log, then went to the football.

halima/7b24d819.speaker: halima
halima/7b24d819.text: A heavy round base, wiped. The drip stand.

halima/01856361.speaker: halima
halima/01856361.text: The defibrillators are sealed and logged.

halima/c3f6e0c3.speaker: halima
halima/c3f6e0c3.text: Sixty-one stents, thirty-eight million shillings, and an investigator with the originals in her hands.

halima/e4ebeeb8.speaker: halima
halima/e4ebeeb8.text: Elvis's anger was at the doctor, not the insurer, and he was in South B.

halima/142a39f9.speaker: halima
halima/142a39f9.text: Stents fitted in a lab that was shut for servicing. And the blanks were signed before anyone typed them.

halima/38083b32.speaker: halima
halima/38083b32.text: The log is false, but Benson wrote it as told. The reports are the forged paper.

halima/81f69460.speaker: halima
halima/81f69460.text: The servicing record is the servicing company's own copy.

halima/dbb91eb4.speaker: halima
halima/dbb91eb4.text: Reception dust on a fob that never left the box. Until someone with the box key took it out.

halima/1f3a1384.speaker: halima
halima/1f3a1384.text: The drip stand is the weapon. It wasn't placed; it was used.

halima/fca2e0db.speaker: halima
halima/fca2e0db.text: Elvis really wrote those posts. Anger isn't evidence.

mwalimu/ddc1cbed.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ddc1cbed.text: Was the saddle cut before or after he cancelled, Amani?

mwalimu/418ad2a0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/418ad2a0.text: Her car left at 06:31. He cancelled at 06:45.

mwalimu/5966af5a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5966af5a.text: Where does the saddle hang overnight?

mwalimu/5e04e4c4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5e04e4c4.text: On Gerald's peg in the tack room, thread snippets under it.

mwalimu/3bfe5090.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3bfe5090.text: Ask the groom how long Madam looked at her mare.

mwalimu/d21a3aed.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d21a3aed.text: One minute, then the tack room. And the seam ripper.

mwalimu/bba4efe1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bba4efe1.text: Lift the flap. Cut, or torn?

mwalimu/a4daeaec.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a4daeaec.text: Two-thirds cut, then torn at speed.

mwalimu/fcb3632d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fcb3632d.text: What did Gerald know before he sold that horse?

mwalimu/9fd48391.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9fd48391.text: Whose saddle was it, and who was meant to ride?

mwalimu/2e70ae94.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2e70ae94.text: Gerald's, every Saturday. He cancelled at 06:45.

mwalimu/3d089869.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3d089869.text: Cut or torn. It's always one or the other.

halima/47e87bce.speaker: halima
halima/47e87bce.text: A boy thrown two years ago. A seam ripper at quarter past six. A migraine at quarter to seven. A saddle on at seven. A fall at ten to eight.

halima/ae7b1916.speaker: halima
halima/ae7b1916.text: Was the girth cut before or after Gerald cancelled?

halima/6ddd2174.speaker: halima
halima/6ddd2174.text: The crime was done in the tack room. The polo ground is only where it went off.

halima/b93b6cdd.speaker: halima
halima/b93b6cdd.text: He died on the polo ground, but the killing was done before anyone mounted.

halima/0e2a4099.speaker: halima
halima/0e2a4099.text: Kioko tacked up in the stable block and only checked the tightness.

halima/f9e009c6.speaker: halima
halima/f9e009c6.text: Twenty minutes alone at the tack room, a call home that said "It's done", and a seam ripper with his saddle's thread in it.

halima/a4db0738.speaker: halima
halima/a4db0738.text: Nicholas was in the tack room for one minute, for a bridle.

halima/d56e3ab2.speaker: halima
halima/d56e3ab2.text: Two-thirds cut, so it would hold at a walk and go at a canter.

halima/43fc5c43.speaker: halima
halima/43fc5c43.text: A worn girth tears along its whole length.

halima/90929ba2.speaker: halima
halima/90929ba2.text: The saddle came off first; the horse stood.

halima/97db5d95.speaker: halima
halima/97db5d95.text: "Bombproof." With the vet's report in his drawer.

halima/1f454a66.speaker: halima
halima/1f454a66.text: Nobody knew Tajeu would ride until 06:45.

halima/6369ce1f.speaker: halima
halima/6369ce1f.text: His saddle, his horse, his Saturday ride. He cancelled sixteen minutes after she drove away.

halima/6814dc75.speaker: halima
halima/6814dc75.text: The saddle was cut before 06:31. Nobody knew Tajeu would ride it until 06:45.

mwalimu/39d02556.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/39d02556.text: The baby monitor was listening, Amani.

mwalimu/301318b4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/301318b4.text: Shouting from 23:05, a thud at 23:08, a call to her sister at 23:30.

mwalimu/cad64fdb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/cad64fdb.text: Where was the bag when he fell?

mwalimu/3b738095.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3b738095.text: At the top of the stairs, in the hallway the monitor heard.

mwalimu/7878586a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7878586a.text: Who did she call at half past eleven?

mwalimu/6c0fd5a9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6c0fd5a9.text: Did the fall come first, or the blow?

mwalimu/d6788daf.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d6788daf.text: The blow. His blood in the award's chip.

mwalimu/b000e900.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b000e900.text: "Packing now. Telling her." He was leaving at eleven.

mwalimu/adf8fd8d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/adf8fd8d.text: Look at the dust under the award, and on it.

mwalimu/91c37ea3.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/91c37ea3.text: Dust under it, none on it. It went there last night.

mwalimu/0dbce266.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0dbce266.text: Listen to the recording twice. The second time, listen for who isn't speaking.

halima/764a1b31.speaker: halima
halima/764a1b31.text: A bag at nine, a taxi at ten to eleven, shouting at five past, a thud at eight minutes past, a sister at half past, and the police at quarter past six.

halima/a684ac3c.speaker: halima
halima/a684ac3c.text: Three in the morning is the robbery story. Read the post-mortem.

halima/82943bf2.speaker: halima
halima/82943bf2.text: When did the monitor hear the thud?

halima/3037b36e.speaker: halima
halima/3037b36e.text: At the top of the stairs, beside his packed bag.

halima/23567a2c.speaker: halima
halima/23567a2c.text: The nursery is where the witness was.

halima/9bb29f58.speaker: halima
halima/9bb29f58.text: The award went under the nanny's bed afterwards.

halima/fc6e982c.speaker: halima
halima/fc6e982c.text: A woman's voice at the top of the stairs, her award with his blood, her prints on the envelope, and her midnight call to her sister.

halima/33ae38f8.speaker: halima
halima/33ae38f8.text: Nekesa is on camera with the baby the whole time.

halima/98fd94d1.speaker: halima
halima/98fd94d1.text: Sheila's taxi left empty. She never came.

halima/07b13999.speaker: halima
halima/07b13999.text: A sharp-edged heavy blow first, then the stairs.

halima/ea419fdb.speaker: halima
halima/ea419fdb.text: The blow came before the fall.

halima/87fa1cde.speaker: halima
halima/87fa1cde.text: No forced entry. Nothing else taken.

halima/7cc089db.speaker: halima
halima/7cc089db.text: "Packing now. Telling her." And the house in his company's name.

halima/4e7fe0bd.speaker: halima
halima/4e7fe0bd.text: Clean on top, dust undisturbed beneath. It went under that bed last night. And her prints, not the nanny's, are on the envelope.

halima/05e7e979.speaker: halima
halima/05e7e979.text: The packed bag is Jeff's own.

halima/4932a6af.speaker: halima
halima/4932a6af.text: The baby monitor is the one honest witness in that house.

mwalimu/58eb3e38.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/58eb3e38.text: A deleted file still leaves a log, Amani.

mwalimu/c5d389df.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c5d389df.text: A text at 00:25. A deletion at 00:48.

mwalimu/4584c824.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/4584c824.text: Where did she say she was going?

mwalimu/a1e57aeb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a1e57aeb.text: The service terrace. Her jacket on its rail.

mwalimu/f34a2b81.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f34a2b81.text: The bar camera wasn't deleted. Watch the staff door.

mwalimu/19648606.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/19648606.text: Mukami through at 00:25, back alone at 00:31. Her face in the last frame.

mwalimu/997388d6.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/997388d6.text: Whose account deleted the terrace footage?

mwalimu/b244b87b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b244b87b.text: Climbers scrape their palms. Look at hers.

mwalimu/23721d3b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/23721d3b.text: No scrapes, chest bruising, the back of her jacket on the rail.

mwalimu/84c669e7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/84c669e7.text: Ask her sister for the March photos.

mwalimu/441db14c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/441db14c.text: A padlocked fire exit, and Monday.

mwalimu/94ebbe66.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/94ebbe66.text: They say she was very drunk. Is she?

mwalimu/a377be87.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a377be87.text: A deletion has an author. Find the account.

halima/4df0e855.speaker: halima
halima/4df0e855.text: A padlock in March, a text at 00:25, a push a minute later, a deletion at 00:48, and sixty thousand shillings at 01:15.

halima/7b5f054d.speaker: halima
halima/7b5f054d.text: She was dead before one, and sober.

halima/2e9ad612.speaker: halima
halima/2e9ad612.text: When did the delete log run?

halima/94c991a1.speaker: halima
halima/94c991a1.text: On the service terrace, where she was told to come and talk.

halima/ff361d23.speaker: halima
halima/ff361d23.text: She landed in the street. She was pushed from the terrace.

halima/92625f11.speaker: halima
halima/92625f11.text: The security office is where the footage died.

halima/3a390297.speaker: halima
halima/3a390297.text: Her text to the journalist, the bar camera at the staff door, her face in the last frame, the card in her bag.

halima/84399f86.speaker: halima
halima/84399f86.text: Ezekiel was at the rooftop door until 00:33.

halima/b44d077a.speaker: halima
halima/b44d077a.text: HEAD_SEC at 00:48, "very drunk" to the police, and sixty thousand for it. He knew.

halima/cd93ffd0.speaker: halima
halima/cd93ffd0.text: Duncan lied about capacity. The delete log names the head bouncer.

halima/417abb20.speaker: halima
halima/417abb20.text: Tracy's own text says Mukami asked to meet. Nobody else lured her.

halima/70e5dda9.speaker: halima
halima/70e5dda9.text: Two hands on her chest, and the back of her jacket on the rail.

halima/91fed651.speaker: halima
halima/91fed651.text: Climbers scrape their palms. She has none.

halima/fdd54d1f.speaker: halima
halima/fdd54d1f.text: Nobody else was on that terrace to crush her.

halima/fe389d02.speaker: halima
halima/fe389d02.text: "Padlock the fire exit." Fourteen people hurt, and a Monday deadline.

halima/def8bb41.speaker: halima
halima/def8bb41.text: The camera went over the railing. Only the card was taken.

halima/c9e090b1.speaker: halima
halima/c9e090b1.text: Duncan's fine is about capacity, not a death.

halima/ebf4166d.speaker: halima
halima/ebf4166d.text: No drink in her, no scrapes on her. Their story needs both.

halima/79c56725.speaker: halima
halima/79c56725.text: The missing footage tells you someone deleted it. That belongs in the ACCOMPLICE line.

halima/4c073aad.speaker: halima
halima/4c073aad.text: A missing card tells you what was taken, not how she fell.

mwalimu/f99be264.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f99be264.text: The camera saw her leave, Amani. When did Sharon come in?

mwalimu/52d422e1.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/52d422e1.text: Halima out at 21:14. Sharon in at 21:32. The master card up at 21:35.

mwalimu/34eea4e0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/34eea4e0.text: The service lift, "under maintenance" since Friday, and the car park.

mwalimu/fc1a425e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fc1a425e.text: Who called her in about an alarm?

mwalimu/f41fd91b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f41fd91b.text: The Major, at 21:05. Her blood on his shoe covers.

mwalimu/17cefa8e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/17cefa8e.text: Who was alone in Halima's section on Friday afternoon?

mwalimu/fb378c92.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/fb378c92.text: Cynthia. A year on his payroll, and a dead man's SIM.

mwalimu/a106e204.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a106e204.text: Count the bookends on her shelf.

mwalimu/53b40208.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/53b40208.text: Ask Faith what was in the safe.

mwalimu/2ad31569.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2ad31569.text: An envelope for Halima. Two million from the till the next morning.

mwalimu/580001ad.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/580001ad.text: Which came first on that sheet: the fingers or the toner?

mwalimu/32c23e8e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/32c23e8e.text: Her prints under the toner. The pen reported missing on Friday.

mwalimu/262e38c0.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/262e38c0.text: Whose ID is that SIM registered to? You've seen it before.

mwalimu/0ef75d1d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0ef75d1d.text: A man dead ten years. The phone that called Walter Ogada.

halima/1a386f19.speaker: halima
halima/1a386f19.text: An email on Thursday, a pen gone on Friday, a text at ten past eight, a knock at nine, and a service lift at 21:35.

halima/2a3b1b8d.speaker: halima
halima/2a3b1b8d.text: 21:45 was written over 21:00 on Monday morning.

halima/c3bcc57d.speaker: halima
halima/c3bcc57d.text: When did the master card go up?

halima/4b6f282d.speaker: halima
halima/4b6f282d.text: Killed in her own office. In and out by the camera-less service lift and the car park.

halima/4ad81391.speaker: halima
halima/4ad81391.text: No one but Halima and Sharon came through the lobby before 23:00.

halima/863012f0.speaker: halima
halima/863012f0.text: The passenger lift has a camera. He didn't use it.

halima/316ea8d3.speaker: halima
halima/316ea8d3.text: His call that brought her in, his master card up the service lift, her laptop in his safe, her blood on his shoe covers.

halima/f91de86a.speaker: halima
halima/f91de86a.text: Halima left at 21:14. Sharon arrived at 21:32.

halima/21cb469b.speaker: halima
halima/21cb469b.text: A year on his payroll, a pen from Halima's desk, and a dead man's SIM in her phone case.

halima/ae94dfac.speaker: halima
halima/ae94dfac.text: Patrick changed a time on Monday, after the death, and didn't know why. That's not an accomplice.

halima/e10adceb.speaker: halima
halima/e10adceb.text: Faith kept the envelope safe. She's the reason we can read it.

halima/c76ecee3.speaker: halima
halima/c76ecee3.text: One of her own marble bookends.

halima/9be32060.speaker: halima
halima/9be32060.text: The laptop was in his safe, intact.

halima/ee8a85e4.speaker: halima
halima/ee8a85e4.text: The safe is scratched round the dial. No blood.

halima/b6e47332.speaker: halima
halima/b6e47332.text: "Sharon is talking." And two million shillings from the till the next morning.

halima/fa1106b4.speaker: halima
halima/fa1106b4.text: Halima's complaint was a pretext they built for her.

halima/15fad5ce.speaker: halima
halima/15fad5ce.text: Her prints under the toner: she touched a blank sheet. And the pen was reported missing two days before.

halima/b5ed49a7.speaker: halima
halima/b5ed49a7.text: The sign-in entry wasn't planted. It was altered: that's Patrick's lie.

halima/98ea35f7.speaker: halima
halima/98ea35f7.text: The same dead man's ID that set up Walter Ogada. Fundi's people.

halima/ba29ed12.speaker: halima
halima/ba29ed12.text: The till paid for this, yes. The question is the SIM.

c091-p_mwanaisha/0699b8d7.speaker: c091-p_mwanaisha
c091-p_mwanaisha/0699b8d7.text: I left the building at half past eight. I never went to 18. And Msingi Trust is a clean client.

c091-p_mwanaisha/2d6b0a44.speaker: c091-p_mwanaisha
c091-p_mwanaisha/2d6b0a44.text: I left the building at half past eight. I never went to 18.

c091-p_mwanaisha/9a7d3f0d.speaker: c091-p_mwanaisha
c091-p_mwanaisha/9a7d3f0d.text: Msingi Trust is a clean client.

c091-p_mwanaisha/6a1b15d5.speaker: c091-p_mwanaisha
c091-p_mwanaisha/6a1b15d5.text: I've never seen that notice before.

c091-p_mwanaisha/2022c189.speaker: c091-p_mwanaisha
c091-p_mwanaisha/2022c189.text: Four years of commission. Enough to put my children through university abroad. She was going to file in the morning. I asked her for one week.

c091-p_mwanaisha/427f3a43.speaker: c091-p_mwanaisha
c091-p_mwanaisha/427f3a43.text: Mwanaisha looks at four years of payments from the till and folds her scarf in her lap.

c091-p_gideon/8b5a426b.speaker: c091-p_gideon
c091-p_gideon/8b5a426b.text: Nasimiyu never escalated Msingi to me.

c091-p_gideon/f6b172d2.speaker: c091-p_gideon
c091-p_gideon/f6b172d2.text: I told her to hold it. It's our third-largest private client. That's my failing, not a crime. I'll answer for it to the board.

c091-p_kelvin/f00950a2.speaker: c091-p_kelvin
c091-p_kelvin/f00950a2.text: I hadn't seen her for a month.

c091-p_kelvin/43d96ec5.speaker: c091-p_kelvin
c091-p_kelvin/43d96ec5.text: We had lunch. She ended it properly. I was at the football that night; I've got four hundred photos.

c091-p_sylvia/e40a7924.speaker: c091-p_sylvia
c091-p_sylvia/e40a7924.text: I can show you every log.

c091-p_anjali/7b98a51c.speaker: c091-p_anjali
c091-p_anjali/7b98a51c.text: I didn't read her email until Tuesday morning. She was right and she was alone. I'll give you everything the bank holds on Msingi.

c091-p_anjali/85bed4a5.speaker: c091-p_anjali
c091-p_anjali/85bed4a5.text: I was at a dinner in Gigiri until eleven. My phone was in my bag. That's no excuse.

c092-p_daudi/289deaa6.speaker: c092-p_daudi
c092-p_daudi/289deaa6.text: I was asleep from half past seven. I heard nothing. And there is no black book. Jeremiah kept the orders in his head.

c092-p_daudi/04bdc98e.speaker: c092-p_daudi
c092-p_daudi/04bdc98e.text: I was asleep from half past seven. I heard nothing.

c092-p_daudi/74dbe0bf.speaker: c092-p_daudi
c092-p_daudi/74dbe0bf.text: There is no black book. Jeremiah kept the orders in his head.

c092-p_daudi/d65846d2.speaker: c092-p_daudi
c092-p_daudi/d65846d2.text: I haven't touched the embosser since Tuesday.

c092-p_daudi/04a2305b.speaker: c092-p_daudi
c092-p_daudi/04a2305b.text: I don't need light in that room. I've been blind in it for five years. He was going to take my book to the prosecutor and put two old men in prison for cutting brass. Thirty years together.

c092-p_daudi/5ccff8e7.speaker: c092-p_daudi
c092-p_daudi/5ccff8e7.text: Daudi runs his fingers over the black book's cover and says nothing at all.

c092-p_hamisi/1a9b41bd.speaker: c092-p_hamisi
c092-p_hamisi/1a9b41bd.text: I never went to that shop.

c092-p_hamisi/5e53d13f.speaker: c092-p_hamisi
c092-p_hamisi/5e53d13f.text: I went to shout at him. My father died refusing to make that seal, and these men finished it. I left at ten to seven. I'm glad someone will pay. I'm sorry it's like this. Juma told me about the book.

c092-p_juma/60515ae8.speaker: c092-p_juma
c092-p_juma/60515ae8.text: I never told anyone about any book.

c092-p_juma/56d5c7c2.speaker: c092-p_juma
c092-p_juma/56d5c7c2.text: I told Hamisi on Sunday. He's my old boss's son. I thought he deserved to know. I didn't think anyone would die. Again.

c092-p_zainabu/1798e8a6.speaker: c092-p_zainabu
c092-p_zainabu/1798e8a6.text: We argued about rent. I was home.

c093-p_edwin/7c325a81.speaker: c093-p_edwin
c093-p_edwin/7c325a81.text: I was at the border yard all night with my truck.

c093-p_edwin/fba325dc.speaker: c093-p_edwin
c093-p_edwin/fba325dc.text: That lever hasn't been out of the toolbox in months.

c093-p_edwin/f69c6a77.speaker: c093-p_edwin
c093-p_edwin/f69c6a77.text: A voice offered me five hundred thousand for a box. A box! I owe the bank more than that. There was no box. There was only him.

c093-p_fred/334d11a7.speaker: c093-p_fred
c093-p_fred/334d11a7.text: I was home sleeping. My bike didn't move.

c093-p_fred/a7055d4d.speaker: c093-p_fred
c093-p_fred/a7055d4d.text: Edwin said it was a small job, take a box from a house. I waited at the road. When he came out running with a TV and no box, I knew something bad happened.

c093-p_akol/cd6227a5.speaker: c093-p_akol
c093-p_akol/cd6227a5.text: There's no box. I don't know what you're talking about.

c093-p_akol/74f97864.speaker: c093-p_akol
c093-p_akol/74f97864.text: Yes, I knew about Julius's box. Charles made me swear. I lied because I thought you were the people who wanted it.

c093-p_okiror/389b9a2d.speaker: c093-p_okiror
c093-p_okiror/389b9a2d.text: We fought about a boundary for ten years. I was at a wedding.

c093-p_moses/70ce635c.speaker: c093-p_moses
c093-p_moses/70ce635c.text: I owed him money. I was in Nairobi.

c094-p_rhobi/7b4e662e.speaker: c094-p_rhobi
c094-p_rhobi/7b4e662e.text: I visit only my brother, at half past eleven. I've never brought food for anyone else.

c094-p_rhobi/7df1633d.speaker: c094-p_rhobi
c094-p_rhobi/7df1633d.text: The bottle is for my kitchen garden. It never went near any food.

c094-p_rhobi/577cdc5c.speaker: c094-p_rhobi
c094-p_rhobi/577cdc5c.text: My brother said that man would hang him with his mouth. I'm his sister. I did what my brother asked. I didn't know about the cell sharing. I'm sorry for the boy.

c094-p_fundi/ced4cfbf.speaker: c094-p_fundi
c094-p_fundi/ced4cfbf.text: He came in a government car, A Lands House pass.

c094-p_mumo/312e520f.speaker: c094-p_mumo
c094-p_mumo/312e520f.text: I checked every visitor's ID against their face.

c094-p_mumo/d2076717.speaker: c094-p_mumo
c094-p_mumo/d2076717.text: Forty people in the queue and one officer. I looked at a card, not a face. I'll accept the discipline.

c094-p_musa/5d2ea1bd.speaker: c094-p_musa
c094-p_musa/5d2ea1bd.text: I steal food. I was in the punishment block.

c094-p_lucy/f9de9ac3.speaker: c094-p_lucy
c094-p_lucy/f9de9ac3.text: Run the ID number. I'll wait.

c095-p_kadzo/07ad4e3e.speaker: c095-p_kadzo
c095-p_kadzo/07ad4e3e.text: I last visited Mrs. Koech on Saturday. My letter is genuine; Police Headquarters authorised my research.

c095-p_kadzo/ed5be87e.speaker: c095-p_kadzo
c095-p_kadzo/ed5be87e.text: I last visited Mrs. Koech on Saturday.

c095-p_kadzo/c05a0436.speaker: c095-p_kadzo
c095-p_kadzo/c05a0436.text: My letter is genuine. Police Headquarters authorised my research.

c095-p_kadzo/00ee025d.speaker: c095-p_kadzo
c095-p_kadzo/00ee025d.text: Three million shillings for one book. I'm a writer; I've never seen three million in my life. She caught me with it. And then it was the wrong year.

c095-p_kadzo/0c7c2e99.speaker: c095-p_kadzo
c095-p_kadzo/0c7c2e99.text: Kadzo takes off her spectacles and cleans them for a long time.

c095-p_kibet/c15761e6.speaker: c095-p_kibet
c095-p_kibet/c15761e6.text: I never told anyone about Grandpa's diaries.

c095-p_kibet/e6cbccdf.speaker: c095-p_kibet
c095-p_kibet/e6cbccdf.text: She paid me twenty thousand. I thought she wanted to write a book. I sent my grandmother a writer.

c095-p_jepchumba/5c154edf.speaker: c095-p_jepchumba
c095-p_jepchumba/5c154edf.text: I hadn't spoken to Mother in a month. We fought about the house.

c095-p_jepchumba/0fba2aa6.speaker: c095-p_jepchumba
c095-p_jepchumba/0fba2aa6.text: We spoke on Monday evening. We made up. I didn't want you to know because it hurts that it was the last time.

c095-p_kariuki/77c3550e.speaker: c095-p_kariuki
c095-p_kariuki/77c3550e.text: We quarrelled about a hedge. I was at church.

c096-p_pius/27a82d0a.speaker: c096-p_pius
c096-p_pius/27a82d0a.text: I was at home on Monday night. I hardly knew Elijah.

c096-p_pius/2b716ff4.speaker: c096-p_pius
c096-p_pius/2b716ff4.text: I went to pray with him,

c096-p_ivan/dbcffd8a.speaker: c096-p_ivan
c096-p_ivan/dbcffd8a.text: I didn't drive anywhere on Monday night.

c096-p_ivan/d6c46002.speaker: c096-p_ivan
c096-p_ivan/d6c46002.text: Dad said he needed to pray with an old friend in Bahati, urgently. I waited in the car half an hour. He came back without a word and was sick by the road.

c096-p_amos/f3ee7f4a.speaker: c096-p_amos
c096-p_amos/f3ee7f4a.text: I was at the bar. I wanted to sell some land. Grandpa said no. I'd never touch him.

c096-p_nyambura/b9f0fc07.speaker: c096-p_nyambura
c096-p_nyambura/b9f0fc07.text: His goats ate my maize for ten years. I was at prayers.

c096-p_winnie/0607ca14.speaker: c096-p_winnie
c096-p_winnie/0607ca14.text: I only wrote 'an old man remembers things'.

c096-p_winnie/da40a956.speaker: c096-p_winnie
c096-p_winnie/da40a956.text: I only wrote 'an old man remembers things'. I got him killed with a sentence.

c097-p_sagal/3f9df5ff.speaker: c097-p_sagal
c097-p_sagal/3f9df5ff.text: The steam room was at normal temperature all morning. Mr. Rotich must have had a heart attack.

c097-p_sagal/3e75dfe4.speaker: c097-p_sagal
c097-p_sagal/3e75dfe4.text: I've never been paid by anyone but the club.

c097-p_sagal/eec385ba.speaker: c097-p_sagal
c097-p_sagal/eec385ba.text: I sent Ibrahim for towels, and I set it to the top.

c097-p_ibrahim/e388776f.speaker: c097-p_ibrahim
c097-p_ibrahim/e388776f.text: I checked the steam room every fifteen minutes.

c097-p_ibrahim/cd95fef8.speaker: c097-p_ibrahim
c097-p_ibrahim/cd95fef8.text: Madam sent me to count towels at six. I came back at ten to seven. When I saw my initials on the sheet in her writing I was afraid to say.

c097-p_ezra/75142013.speaker: c097-p_ezra
c097-p_ezra/75142013.text: I didn't go to the club on Saturday.

c097-p_ezra/42124b6c.speaker: c097-p_ezra
c097-p_ezra/42124b6c.text: We argued about the firm. He said, 'After today, nothing will be the same, for any of us.' I left at two minutes past six. Those were his last words to me.

c097-p_kabiru/717cc269.speaker: c097-p_kabiru
c097-p_kabiru/717cc269.text: Stanley and I served together twenty years. I was at breakfast with my donors when Gladys came running. He'd been troubled lately. We all are, at our age.

c097-p_oduya/563c606c.speaker: c097-p_oduya
c097-p_oduya/563c606c.text: I was at the DCI, as you know.

c098-p_oduya/16524258.speaker: c098-p_oduya
c098-p_oduya/16524258.text: I was with my wife all evening. Mrs. Kioko resigned last week; she had been unwell.

c098-p_oduya/30160825.speaker: c098-p_oduya
c098-p_oduya/30160825.text: I was with my wife all evening.

c098-p_oduya/b18cf175.speaker: c098-p_oduya
c098-p_oduya/b18cf175.text: Mrs. Kioko resigned last week. She had been unwell.

c098-p_oduya/10227bdd.speaker: c098-p_oduya
c098-p_oduya/10227bdd.text: I never received instructions from anyone. I was a director. I gave them.

c098-p_oduya/bc3edbcb.speaker: c098-p_oduya
c098-p_oduya/bc3edbcb.text: Senior Counsel Kimathi leans across and says something in his client's ear. Oduya says nothing.

c098-p_oduya/f31540db.speaker: c098-p_oduya
c098-p_oduya/f31540db.text: Oduya looks at the two signatures side by side, and takes off his glasses.

c098-p_okoth/5df2c1e9.speaker: c098-p_okoth
c098-p_okoth/5df2c1e9.text: I was in town all night. I didn't go to my uncle's.

c098-p_okoth/84ca9815.speaker: c098-p_okoth
c098-p_okoth/84ca9815.text: He called and said, 'Come now, bring nothing.' He was standing on the terrace. He said burn the book and take the bird to the lake. I'm a director of a trust I've never seen the accounts of.

c098-p_akinyi/373756df.speaker: c098-p_akinyi
c098-p_akinyi/373756df.text: My husband was with me all evening.

c098-p_akinyi/41d35b92.speaker: c098-p_akinyi
c098-p_akinyi/41d35b92.text: I was at fellowship. I said what a wife says. I didn't know what he'd done.

c098-p_benson/4736227e.speaker: c098-p_benson
c098-p_benson/4736227e.text: No car left the compound on Friday night.

c098-p_benson/a2580ebd.speaker: c098-p_benson
c098-p_benson/a2580ebd.text: Okoth told me at midnight: 'No car came, no car left.' I said it. I didn't ask why.

c098-p_mutua/d7322fc2.speaker: c098-p_mutua
c098-p_mutua/d7322fc2.text: We quarrelled about her house. I was in Machakos.

c098-p_jared/98227a88.speaker: c098-p_jared
c098-p_jared/98227a88.text: Our road quarrel is ten years old. I was home.

c099-p_maina/9b888f32.speaker: c099-p_maina
c099-p_maina/9b888f32.text: I went home at six on Thursday. Every grant was approved by the Chair.

c099-p_maina/40ca2a3e.speaker: c099-p_maina
c099-p_maina/40ca2a3e.text: I went home at six on Thursday.

c099-p_maina/cb227eae.speaker: c099-p_maina
c099-p_maina/cb227eae.text: Every grant was approved by the Chair.

c099-p_maina/0c6815c8.speaker: c099-p_maina
c099-p_maina/0c6815c8.text: Maina looks at the fob log, then at his advocate, and says nothing.

c099-p_maina/8361493b.speaker: c099-p_maina
c099-p_maina/8361493b.text: Shosh said, 'Fix it, Maina.' I've been fixing things for her since I was nineteen. Envelopes, grants, people. I didn't know how to fix Zipporah.

c099-p_tony/2940d40e.speaker: c099-p_tony
c099-p_tony/2940d40e.text: The backups failed on their own.

c099-p_tony/17650823.speaker: c099-p_tony
c099-p_tony/17650823.text: Maina opened a ticket at eight saying they were full. I cleared them. I'm a contractor; I do tickets.

c099-p_nderitu/a7e9d14c.speaker: c099-p_nderitu
c099-p_nderitu/a7e9d14c.text: The foundation has never paid any PesaPap till.

c099-p_nderitu/4c27857a.speaker: c099-p_nderitu
c099-p_nderitu/4c27857a.text: I'm going to need my own lawyer, Detective.

c099-p_philip/a45f4850.speaker: c099-p_philip
c099-p_philip/a45f4850.text: I wasn't at the office on Thursday evening.

c099-p_philip/b961e4b7.speaker: c099-p_philip
c099-p_philip/b961e4b7.text: I came back to clear my desk quietly before resigning. I never went near the archive.

c099-p_geoffrey/871640c4.speaker: c099-p_geoffrey
c099-p_geoffrey/871640c4.text: We were having a hard year. I was at choir.

c099-p_kabiru/64485ca6.speaker: c099-p_kabiru
c099-p_kabiru/64485ca6.text: I have given forty years to this country, Detective. I hope you'll remember that when you write your report.

c099-p_kabiru/774c692c.speaker: c099-p_kabiru
c099-p_kabiru/774c692c.text: I was in Mombasa. Maina is unwell; he has been for years. The foundation's finances are a matter for its officers.

c100-p_kabiru/0a4f678c.speaker: c100-p_kabiru
c100-p_kabiru/0a4f678c.text: 4.12 was a shared line. Anyone could use it. And I never met a surveyor called Joseph Mwenda.

c100-p_kabiru/5876c166.speaker: c100-p_kabiru
c100-p_kabiru/5876c166.text: 4.12 was a shared line. Anyone could use it.

c100-p_kabiru/ccb9104a.speaker: c100-p_kabiru
c100-p_kabiru/ccb9104a.text: I never met a surveyor called Joseph Mwenda.

c100-p_kabiru/dc03498b.speaker: c100-p_kabiru
c100-p_kabiru/dc03498b.text: The foundation's grants were its officers' business.

c100-p_kabiru/9813ac6e.speaker: c100-p_kabiru
c100-p_kabiru/9813ac6e.text: Senior Counsel Wambugu reads the directory line twice. Kabiru doesn't look at it.

c100-p_kabiru/e5252a52.speaker: c100-p_kabiru
c100-p_kabiru/e5252a52.text: Kabiru looks at Joseph's handwriting for a long time, and smooths her gloves.

c100-p_okemwa/ac065753.speaker: c100-p_okemwa
c100-p_okemwa/ac065753.text: 4.12 was a shared line for the whole Records section.

c100-p_okemwa/3bf5e4a3.speaker: c100-p_okemwa
c100-p_okemwa/3bf5e4a3.text: I said 'shared' because I didn't want to say her name. She ran Records. I ran the title. I was in Kisii that month, and I have been glad of it every day since.

c100-p_leah/bab2e082.speaker: c100-p_leah
c100-p_leah/bab2e082.text: I kept no records. Switchboards don't.

c100-p_leah/51e06b90.speaker: c100-p_leah
c100-p_leah/51e06b90.text: I kept the printouts because Lands owed me a pension for eight years and I wanted proof of my overtime. I didn't know what was in them. I knew what floor I worked on.

c100-p_oduya/57833143.speaker: c100-p_oduya
c100-p_oduya/57833143.text: The envelopes came from the Permanent Secretary, Dr. Mwangangi.

c100-p_oduya/186a32f8.speaker: c100-p_oduya
c100-p_oduya/186a32f8.text: Very well. 4.12. Always 4.12, then the foundation. I said 'tell her' in the car because I was frightened of her. I still am.

c100-p_fundi/d5576153.speaker: c100-p_fundi
c100-p_fundi/d5576153.text: A desk. I didn't know it had a name.
