c100-p_pius/19db0e47.speaker: c100-p_pius
c100-p_pius/19db0e47.text: I drove. I have said it all.

c100-p_emojong/836cd8a2.speaker: c100-p_emojong
c100-p_emojong/836cd8a2.text: The withdrawal was on Records' authority, through Adjudication.

c100-p_mwalimu/9045ffdb.speaker: c100-p_mwalimu
c100-p_mwalimu/9045ffdb.text: Office 4.12. Go and get her before nine.

rc-mehta/ce4fed5e.speaker: rc-mehta
rc-mehta/ce4fed5e.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

rc-mehta/af09fefc.speaker: rc-mehta
rc-mehta/af09fefc.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

rc-mehta/e69dd301.speaker: rc-mehta
rc-mehta/e69dd301.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

rc-pius-cheruiyot/f6e90d7d.speaker: rc-pius-cheruiyot
rc-pius-cheruiyot/f6e90d7d.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

rc-pius-cheruiyot/20ab7aaf.speaker: rc-pius-cheruiyot
rc-pius-cheruiyot/20ab7aaf.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

rc-pius-cheruiyot/d6d31164.speaker: rc-pius-cheruiyot
rc-pius-cheruiyot/d6d31164.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.

rc-kabiru/6f070cfd.speaker: rc-kabiru
rc-kabiru/6f070cfd.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

rc-kabiru/72ac562f.speaker: rc-kabiru

mwalimu/b78e4c4d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b78e4c4d.text: Sagal's, and her hand on the check sheet.

mwalimu/d93339da.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d93339da.text: What does the core temperature say?

mwalimu/77b5a591.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/77b5a591.text: Half a million, from a young man at the foundation.

mwalimu/bf139a98.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/bf139a98.text: Whose prints are on the bottle?

mwalimu/2e87435c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2e87435c.text: Where have you seen that foundation before?

mwalimu/c44a59bc.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c44a59bc.text: He decided to stop. Remember that about him too.

halima/28487bac.speaker: halima
halima/28487bac.text: Money on Wednesday, cash on Thursday, the dial at twelve past six, death by quarter to seven, and a "discovery" at five to.

halima/e843a63c.speaker: halima
halima/e843a63c.text: Ezra had gone before his father left the pool.

halima/d986eb2b.speaker: halima
halima/d986eb2b.text: In the steam room, behind a wedged door.

halima/232f3e32.speaker: halima
halima/232f3e32.text: The office is where she turned the dial.

halima/72d67071.speaker: halima
halima/72d67071.text: Her code on the panel, her hand on the sheet, her prints on the wedge, the foundation's envelope in her wardrobe.

halima/32ec0268.speaker: halima
halima/32ec0268.text: Kabiru was hosting breakfast in front of twenty people.

halima/3b995f90.speaker: halima
halima/3b995f90.text: Maximum heat, a wedged door, a man with a heart.

halima/f8bf8dee.speaker: halima
halima/f8bf8dee.text: A heart attack doesn't raise a man's core temperature like that.

halima/a4476383.speaker: halima
halima/a4476383.text: He'd already taken Saturday's pills at home.

halima/009a538d.speaker: halima
halima/009a538d.text: Half a million, three days before his letter reached us.

halima/6e6a468d.speaker: halima
halima/6e6a468d.text: Ezra left before the dial moved.

halima/8f96f7cf.speaker: halima
halima/8f96f7cf.text: There was no grudge. There was an envelope.

halima/50205939.speaker: halima
halima/50205939.text: A man reaching for his pills leaves his prints. This bottle had none.

halima/558b6198.speaker: halima
halima/558b6198.text: The missing checks tell you the attendant was away.

halima/4ef42373.speaker: halima
halima/4ef42373.text: A cold room tells you someone turned it down.

halima/566e00c5.speaker: halima
halima/566e00c5.text: No prints, and a prescription stopped six months ago.

halima/99c47b46.speaker: halima
halima/99c47b46.text: The initials were forged, not planted.

halima/a0b5de55.speaker: halima
halima/a0b5de55.text: The wedge was thrown away, not left to be found.

halima/23711bb0.speaker: halima
halima/23711bb0.text: The Ukarimu Foundation again: a writer's grant in Nakuru, a spa's "sponsorship" in Muthaiga.

halima/5985c41b.speaker: halima
halima/5985c41b.text: Mlinzi Bora was paid by Mvua, not by a foundation.

mwalimu/2e3d81d4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/2e3d81d4.text: When did Rosa hear the thud, and the car?

mwalimu/18094113.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/18094113.text: Half past nine; ten past ten.

mwalimu/b57b6a69.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/b57b6a69.text: What's missing from the terrace table?

mwalimu/5cf46c8e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/5cf46c8e.text: A stone bird. The blow came before the fall.

mwalimu/3ed9ebee.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/3ed9ebee.text: And then he called his nephew.

mwalimu/8a28cadb.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/8a28cadb.text: Whose car went to the lake?

mwalimu/c5d34d96.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c5d34d96.text: Okoth burned the book and took the bird.

mwalimu/e0df635e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/e0df635e.text: Smooth, rounded stone, before the fall.

mwalimu/6eb2192d.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/6eb2192d.text: Read the photocopies in her bag.

mwalimu/74d64421.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/74d64421.text: She was taking the log to the prosecutor.

mwalimu/d5f7ab6f.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/d5f7ab6f.text: Put the two signatures side by side.

mwalimu/9c49227e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/9c49227e.text: Read the scrap from the ash.

mwalimu/26c31e88.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/26c31e88.text: "From 4.12 (Records)": the fourth floor in Supt. Koech's diary.

mwalimu/7bb4f5ac.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7bb4f5ac.text: Office 4.12. The corner office by the window. I told you I knew the corridor.

halima/1fd6a148.speaker: halima
halima/1fd6a148.text: Notice in the afternoon, the thud at half past nine, Okoth at ten past ten, the fire at eleven, and a "resignation" over breakfast.

halima/2d2984d7.speaker: halima
halima/2d2984d7.text: The letter was written on Saturday morning, after she was dead.

halima/947bcc24.speaker: halima
halima/947bcc24.text: When did Rosa hear the thud?

halima/8a652891.speaker: halima
halima/8a652891.text: On the terrace, where the bird stood on the table.

halima/d4ed4244.speaker: halima
halima/d4ed4244.text: She was struck before she fell down the steps.

halima/0938be5e.speaker: halima
halima/0938be5e.text: The incinerator is where the log went.

halima/d28560d8.speaker: halima
halima/d28560d8.text: "Monday, Raphael." Then the thud, then the call to his nephew, then a letter with her signature pasted in.

halima/3b4b3ea3.speaker: halima
halima/3b4b3ea3.text: Okoth came at ten past ten.

halima/8ce52914.speaker: halima
halima/8ce52914.text: Akinyi was at fellowship all night.

halima/994da48b.speaker: halima
halima/994da48b.text: Okoth burned the book and took the bird to the lake.

halima/007b3b12.speaker: halima
halima/007b3b12.text: Benson repeated a lie after the fact, not knowing why.

halima/56eb6513.speaker: halima
halima/56eb6513.text: Akinyi lied, but she wasn't there and helped nothing.

halima/03a67748.speaker: halima
halima/03a67748.text: Smooth, rounded stone, before the fall. The soapstone bird.

halima/de6e3a7d.speaker: halima
halima/de6e3a7d.text: A fall doesn't explain the earlier blow.

halima/405c0f64.speaker: halima
halima/405c0f64.text: She's at the foot of the steps, not under the wall.

halima/758969c0.speaker: halima
halima/758969c0.text: "I typed your life for twenty-two years. I won't go to prison for it."

halima/9662def3.speaker: halima
halima/9662def3.text: She never resigned: the letter was made on Saturday.

halima/62f4f860.speaker: halima
halima/62f4f860.text: Her bag and its photocopies were untouched.

halima/dcf035f1.speaker: halima
halima/dcf035f1.text: Real signatures vary. This one is a copy down to the ink blot.

halima/53cd3833.speaker: halima
halima/53cd3833.text: The log is real; that's why they burned it.

halima/3c9425ad.speaker: halima
halima/3c9425ad.text: "From 4.12 (Records)." The fourth floor, again. Oduya only ever received them.

halima/aec150d6.speaker: halima
halima/aec150d6.text: The log shows Oduya receiving each envelope before sending it on.

halima/634680bf.speaker: halima
halima/634680bf.text: The till is money, not envelopes.

mwalimu/78f64a91.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/78f64a91.text: When did each fob go in and out?

mwalimu/78fc088e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/78fc088e.text: Whose fob followed hers into the archive?

mwalimu/cc62d7c7.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/cc62d7c7.text: Maina's; and her lanyard in his flat.

mwalimu/f86219e2.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f86219e2.text: A centimetre and a half, flat: a lanyard.

mwalimu/54786215.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/54786215.text: Nine years of grants to the Mvua till.

mwalimu/7148d9d4.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/7148d9d4.text: Look at the Chair's signature on two pages.

mwalimu/f81dee26.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f81dee26.text: Ninety days of backups, on Maina's ticket.

mwalimu/f3dc5417.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f3dc5417.text: Where did the monthly grants go?

mwalimu/0991ad0e.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/0991ad0e.text: Till 880 214: the till in Rashid's order book.

mwalimu/46c8482b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/46c8482b.text: Office 4.12. Go and get her before nine. And Amani: take your father's file with you.

halima/1fae56d8.speaker: halima
halima/1fae56d8.text: Wednesday the warning; 20:40 she goes in; 20:52 he follows; 21:20 he calls his grandmother; 08:12 the backups go.

halima/f35deb5b.speaker: halima
halima/f35deb5b.text: She was dead long before dawn.

halima/5b4eb093.speaker: halima
halima/5b4eb093.text: When did his fob go in?

halima/dde94b68.speaker: halima
halima/dde94b68.text: Among the shelves of approvals she'd pulled out.

halima/19eeb1ae.speaker: halima
halima/19eeb1ae.text: Philip never left the main house.

halima/309be3e7.speaker: halima
halima/309be3e7.text: The flat is where the laptop went.

halima/bfc0144a.speaker: halima
halima/bfc0144a.text: His fob in and out, his ticket, her laptop and her lanyard in his flat.

halima/78698b8e.speaker: halima
halima/78698b8e.text: Tony was in Thika; he only did a ticket.

halima/d52bed72.speaker: halima
halima/d52bed72.text: The Chair was on stage in Mombasa.

halima/78ccd254.speaker: halima
halima/78ccd254.text: A flat cord a centimetre and a half wide. Her own lanyard.

halima/89033b61.speaker: halima
halima/89033b61.text: A cable leaves a round mark.

halima/34b73cad.speaker: halima
halima/34b73cad.text: Two hundred and fourteen million to the Mvua till, and she was taking it to the board.

halima/acff9fc9.speaker: halima
halima/acff9fc9.text: Philip was writing his own resignation.

halima/f4dd97b4.speaker: halima
halima/f4dd97b4.text: The laptop wasn't stolen for itself; it was hidden.

halima/d3c4e1fd.speaker: halima
halima/d3c4e1fd.text: The same ink halo, the same nick in the M, on every page for nine years.

halima/e2b83c8b.speaker: halima
halima/e2b83c8b.text: The ticket is genuine; it's what he asked for.

halima/8eb07810.speaker: halima
halima/8eb07810.text: It's a stamp, not a copied signature.

halima/78f0baae.speaker: halima
halima/78f0baae.text: Ninety days of backups, never cleared in nine years, gone the morning after.

halima/55efbd61.speaker: halima
halima/55efbd61.text: No visitor at the gate means a fob, not a reason.

halima/1ca92f66.speaker: halima
halima/1ca92f66.text: Till 880 214. The till in Rashid's order book in case 10, paid every month by a foundation for scholarships.

halima/2387ac8f.speaker: halima
halima/2387ac8f.text: Kadzo and the spa were one-off payments, not monthly grants.

halima/13a74d5d.speaker: halima
halima/13a74d5d.text: The seal and the paper were bought, not granted.

mwalimu/35ce291b.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/35ce291b.text: Two days after the complaint; the afternoon he died.

mwalimu/81f4b67c.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/81f4b67c.text: Who sat in the back seat?

mwalimu/ba28502a.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/ba28502a.text: Dr. Chebii has read the old notes.

mwalimu/eb5c8277.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/eb5c8277.text: Read the entry two months before he died.

mwalimu/c66bf764.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/c66bf764.text: Look at the date beside his signature.

mwalimu/a3912617.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/a3912617.text: Watch and cash left; the book taken.

mwalimu/f3cd5ec9.speaker: mwalimu
mwalimu/f3cd5ec9.text: Close the drawer, Amani. Go home and sleep. He'd have been proud of how you did it. By the book.

halima/d241e33d.speaker: halima
halima/d241e33d.text: A refusal, a call to close it, a call to 4.03, the road, and his own name forged five weeks later.

halima/e0904871.speaker: halima
halima/e0904871.text: A robbery? Nothing of value was taken.

halima/6c406552.speaker: halima
halima/6c406552.text: Killed on the Bahati road. Ordered from the corner office by the window.

halima/341c0bd3.speaker: halima
halima/341c0bd3.text: The desk was in 4.12 then; it moved to Runda nine years later.

halima/3bb3fcb4.speaker: halima
halima/3bb3fcb4.text: 4.03 received the call. It didn't make it.

halima/1f431707.speaker: halima
halima/1f431707.text: The desk never touched the bar.

halima/85e1bda2.speaker: halima
halima/85e1bda2.text: Oduya in the back seat, with the envelope and the order.

halima/5a5c49ba.speaker: halima
halima/5a5c49ba.text: Emojong withdrew the book a year later.

halima/3746ba45.speaker: halima
halima/3746ba45.text: Oduya was the passenger, not the driver.

halima/bfca551c.speaker: halima
halima/bfca551c.text: From behind, with a tyre lever, and a wallet taken for show.

halima/e102de9f.speaker: halima
halima/e102de9f.text: No defence injuries: there was no fight.

halima/4681fd93.speaker: halima
halima/4681fd93.text: The watch and the cash stayed in his pocket.

halima/4d06d908.speaker: halima
halima/4d06d908.text: His name, five weeks after his funeral, and not in his hand.

halima/ef4ff9ec.speaker: halima
halima/ef4ff9ec.text: The slip is genuine: it's how we know whose authority.

halima/a3e45091.speaker: halima
halima/a3e45091.text: A robber takes the watch. They took the book.

halima/482c3d7f.speaker: halima
halima/482c3d7f.text: No defence injuries tells you how, not why.

halima/28e128e2.speaker: halima
halima/28e128e2.text: The empty file tells you about the police, not the killers.

halima/9fc352e8.speaker: halima
halima/9fc352e8.text: A desk is furniture. Look at the asset tag.

halima/38062853.speaker: halima
halima/38062853.text: I can't tell you anything about that.

halima/702a2f2d.speaker: halima
halima/702a2f2d.text: I don't know. Ask someone else.

halima/da50b31e.speaker: halima
halima/da50b31e.text: Nothing. I didn't see anything about that.
